        let rows = t.nelems() / l;
        let out_ty = t.clone();
        let out_ptr = self.copy_tensor_value(inp_v, &TyKind::Tensor(t.clone()));
        let rows_v = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, rows);
        let l_v = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, l);
        self.softmax_rows_v(out_ptr, rows_v, l_v);
        let node = self.ad.as_mut().unwrap().push(
            AdOp::Softmax, vec![inode],
            TyKind::Tensor(out_ty.clone()), out_ptr);
        Ok((out_ptr, TyKind::Tensor(out_ty), node))
    }

    /// Forward-lower `rms_norm(x, gain, eps)` in a @grad body over the LAST axis
    /// (#368). x is `[outer…, D]`, gain is rank-1 `[D]`. Records `AdOp::RmsNorm`
    /// with inputs [x, gain] and `aux = eps`; the VJP flows to both. Static f32
    /// tensors only.
    fn ad_lower_rms_norm(&mut self, args: &[CallArg], span: &Span)
        -> Result<(Value, TyKind, usize), JitError>
    {
        if args.len() != 3 {
            return err(span, "`rms_norm` takes (x, gain, eps)");
        }
        let (x_e, g_e, eps_e) = match (&args[0], &args[1], &args[2]) {
            (CallArg::Positional(a), CallArg::Positional(b), CallArg::Positional(c)) => (a, b, c),
            _ => return unsupported(span, "non-positional args to rms_norm in @grad"),
        };
        let (x_v, x_ty, x_node) = self.ad_lower_expr(x_e, span)?;
        let (g_v, g_ty, g_node) = self.ad_lower_expr(g_e, span)?;
        let (eps_raw, eps_ty) = self.lower_expr(eps_e)?;
        let eps = self.coerce_to(eps_raw, &eps_ty, &TyKind::Scalar(ScalarKind::F32), span)?;
        let xt = x_ty.as_tensor().ok_or_else(|| JitError {
            msg: "rms_norm: x must be a tensor".into(), line: span.line, col: span.col,
        })?.clone();
        let gt = g_ty.as_tensor().ok_or_else(|| JitError {
            msg: "rms_norm: gain must be a tensor".into(), line: span.line, col: span.col,
        })?.clone();
        if xt.elem != ScalarKind::F32 || gt.elem != ScalarKind::F32 {
            return unsupported(span, "@grad rms_norm is f32-only");
        }
        let d_size = *xt.shape.last().unwrap();
        if gt.rank() != 1 || gt.nelems() != d_size {
            return err(span, format!(
                "rms_norm: gain must be rank-1 of length {} (x's last axis)", d_size));
        }
        // Forward y: per-row rms-normalize (same core the builtin uses).
        let out_ty = xt.clone();
        let out_ptr = self.forge_alloc(out_ty.nbytes());
        let outer = xt.nelems() / d_size;
        let zero = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, 0);
        let one = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, 1);
        let d_c = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, d_size);
        let outer_c = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, outer);
        let oh = self.builder.create_block();
        let ob = self.builder.create_block();
        let oe = self.builder.create_block();
        self.builder.append_block_param(oh, cl::I64);
        self.jump(oh, &[zero]);
        self.enter(oh);
        let row = self.builder.block_params(oh)[0];
        let oc = self.builder.ins().icmp(IntCC::SignedLessThan, row, outer_c);
        self.brif(oc, ob, oe);
        self.builder.seal_block(oe);
        self.enter(ob);
        let row_base = self.builder.ins().imul(row, d_c);
        self.rms_norm_one_row(x_v, g_v, out_ptr, row_base, d_size, eps);
        let rnext = self.builder.ins().iadd(row, one);
        self.jump(oh, &[rnext]);
        self.builder.seal_block(ob);
        self.builder.seal_block(oh);
        self.enter(oe);
        let node = self.ad.as_mut().unwrap().push_aux(
            AdOp::RmsNorm, vec![x_node, g_node], TyKind::Tensor(out_ty.clone()), out_ptr, eps);
        Ok((out_ptr, TyKind::Tensor(out_ty), node))
    }

    /// Forward-lower `layer_norm(x, gain, bias, eps)` in a @grad body over the
    /// LAST axis (#368). x is `[outer…, D]`, gain/bias are rank-1 `[D]`. Records
    /// `AdOp::LayerNorm` with inputs [x, gain, bias] and `aux = eps`; the VJP
    /// flows to all three. Static f32 tensors, rank ≥ 2 (the training case).
    fn ad_lower_layer_norm(&mut self, args: &[CallArg], span: &Span)
        -> Result<(Value, TyKind, usize), JitError>
    {
        if args.len() != 4 {
            return err(span, "`layer_norm` takes (x, gain, bias, eps)");
        }
        let (x_e, g_e, b_e, eps_e) = match (&args[0], &args[1], &args[2], &args[3]) {
            (CallArg::Positional(a), CallArg::Positional(b), CallArg::Positional(c),
             CallArg::Positional(d)) => (a, b, c, d),
            _ => return unsupported(span, "non-positional args to layer_norm in @grad"),
        };
        let (x_v, x_ty, x_node) = self.ad_lower_expr(x_e, span)?;
        let (g_v, g_ty, g_node) = self.ad_lower_expr(g_e, span)?;
        let (b_v, b_ty, b_node) = self.ad_lower_expr(b_e, span)?;
        let (eps_raw, eps_ty) = self.lower_expr(eps_e)?;
        let eps = self.coerce_to(eps_raw, &eps_ty, &TyKind::Scalar(ScalarKind::F32), span)?;
        let xt = x_ty.as_tensor().ok_or_else(|| JitError {
            msg: "layer_norm: x must be a tensor".into(), line: span.line, col: span.col,
        })?.clone();
        let gt = g_ty.as_tensor().ok_or_else(|| JitError {
            msg: "layer_norm: gain must be a tensor".into(), line: span.line, col: span.col,
        })?.clone();
        let bt = b_ty.as_tensor().ok_or_else(|| JitError {
            msg: "layer_norm: bias must be a tensor".into(), line: span.line, col: span.col,
        })?.clone();
        if xt.elem != ScalarKind::F32 || gt.elem != ScalarKind::F32 || bt.elem != ScalarKind::F32 {
            return unsupported(span, "@grad layer_norm is f32-only");
        }
        if xt.rank() < 2 {
            return unsupported(span,
                "@grad layer_norm requires a rank ≥ 2 static tensor; use `dmc run`");
        }
        let d_size = *xt.shape.last().unwrap();
        if gt.rank() != 1 || gt.nelems() != d_size || bt.rank() != 1 || bt.nelems() != d_size {
            return err(span, format!(
                "layer_norm: gain and bias must be rank-1 of length {} (x's last axis)", d_size));
        }
        // Forward y: per-row layer-normalize (same core the builtin uses).
        let out_ty = xt.clone();
        let out_ptr = self.forge_alloc(out_ty.nbytes());
        let outer = xt.nelems() / d_size;
        let zero = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, 0);
        let one = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, 1);
        let d_c = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, d_size);
        let outer_c = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, outer);
        let oh = self.builder.create_block();
        let ob = self.builder.create_block();
        let oe = self.builder.create_block();
        self.builder.append_block_param(oh, cl::I64);
        self.jump(oh, &[zero]);
        self.enter(oh);
        let row = self.builder.block_params(oh)[0];
        let oc = self.builder.ins().icmp(IntCC::SignedLessThan, row, outer_c);
        self.brif(oc, ob, oe);
        self.builder.seal_block(oe);
        self.enter(ob);
        let row_base = self.builder.ins().imul(row, d_c);
        self.layer_norm_one_row(x_v, g_v, b_v, out_ptr, row_base, d_size, eps);
        let rnext = self.builder.ins().iadd(row, one);
        self.jump(oh, &[rnext]);
        self.builder.seal_block(ob);
        self.builder.seal_block(oh);
        self.enter(oe);
        let node = self.ad.as_mut().unwrap().push_aux(
            AdOp::LayerNorm, vec![x_node, g_node, b_node],
            TyKind::Tensor(out_ty.clone()), out_ptr, eps);
        Ok((out_ptr, TyKind::Tensor(out_ty), node))
    }

    /// Forward-lower `rope(x, cos, sin)` in a @grad body over the last two axes
    /// `[…, S, D]` (#368). Records `AdOp::Rope` with inputs [x, cos, sin]; the
    /// VJP flows only to `x` (`cos`/`sin` are read-only position tables). The
    /// forward reuses the same rotation kernel as the plain builtin. Static f32
    /// tensors only.
    fn ad_lower_rope(&mut self, args: &[CallArg], span: &Span)
        -> Result<(Value, TyKind, usize), JitError>
    {
        if args.len() != 3 {
            return err(span, "`rope` takes (x, cos, sin)");
        }
        let (x_e, cos_e, sin_e) = match (&args[0], &args[1], &args[2]) {
            (CallArg::Positional(a), CallArg::Positional(b), CallArg::Positional(c)) => (a, b, c),
            _ => return unsupported(span, "non-positional args to rope in @grad"),
        };
        let (x_v, x_ty, x_node) = self.ad_lower_expr(x_e, span)?;
        let (cos_v, cos_ty, cos_node) = self.ad_lower_expr(cos_e, span)?;
        let (sin_v, sin_ty, sin_node) = self.ad_lower_expr(sin_e, span)?;
        let xt = x_ty.as_tensor().ok_or_else(|| JitError {
            msg: "rope: x must be a tensor".into(), line: span.line, col: span.col,
        })?.clone();
        let ct = cos_ty.as_tensor().ok_or_else(|| JitError {
            msg: "rope: cos must be a tensor".into(), line: span.line, col: span.col,
        })?.clone();
        let st = sin_ty.as_tensor().ok_or_else(|| JitError {
            msg: "rope: sin must be a tensor".into(), line: span.line, col: span.col,
        })?.clone();
        if xt.elem != ScalarKind::F32 || ct.elem != ScalarKind::F32 || st.elem != ScalarKind::F32 {
            return unsupported(span, "@grad rope is f32-only");
        }
        if xt.rank() < 2 {
            return unsupported(span, "@grad rope requires a rank ≥ 2 static tensor [..., S, D]; use `dmc run`");
        }
        let rank = xt.rank();
        let s_dim = xt.shape[rank - 2];
        let d_dim = xt.shape[rank - 1];
        if d_dim % 2 != 0 {
            return err(span, format!("rope: D must be even, got {}", d_dim));
        }
        let d2 = d_dim / 2;
        if ct.shape != [s_dim, d2] || st.shape != [s_dim, d2] {
            return err(span, format!("rope: cos/sin must be [S={}, D/2={}]", s_dim, d2));
        }
        // Forward y: copy x, then rotate in place (same kernel as the builtin).
        let out_ty = xt.clone();
        let out_ptr = self.forge_alloc(out_ty.nbytes());
        self.emit_memcpy_loop(out_ptr, x_v, xt.nelems(), 4);
        self.rope_rotate_inplace(out_ptr, cos_v, sin_v, &xt, false);
        let node = self.ad.as_mut().unwrap().push(
            AdOp::Rope, vec![x_node, cos_node, sin_node],
            TyKind::Tensor(out_ty.clone()), out_ptr);
        Ok((out_ptr, TyKind::Tensor(out_ty), node))
    }

    /// Forward-lower `attn(q, k, v, mask?)` / `attn_gqa(...)` in a @grad body
    /// (#368). Records `AdOp::Attn` with inputs [q, k, v]; the VJP flows to
    /// all three. The optional bool mask is lowered outside the tape (it is
    /// read-only — masked positions carry softmax weight 0, so no gradient
    /// crosses them). The forward runs the shared per-head kernel with
    /// `save_p` set, stashing every head's post-softmax [S,S] weights in a
    /// [B,H_q,S,S] buffer (the node's aux) for the backward to replay.
    /// Static f32 rank-4 tensors only; KV-cache operands bail to interp.
    fn ad_lower_attn(&mut self, name: &str, args: &[CallArg], span: &Span)
        -> Result<(Value, TyKind, usize), JitError>
    {
        if args.len() < 3 || args.len() > 4 {
            return err(span, format!("`{}` takes (q, k, v) or (q, k, v, mask)", name));
        }
        let (q_e, k_e, v_e) = match (&args[0], &args[1], &args[2]) {
            (CallArg::Positional(a), CallArg::Positional(b), CallArg::Positional(c)) => (a, b, c),
            _ => return unsupported(span, "non-positional args to attn in @grad"),
        };
        let (q_v, q_ty, q_node) = self.ad_lower_expr(q_e, span)?;
        let (k_v, k_ty, k_node) = self.ad_lower_expr(k_e, span)?;
        let (v_v, v_ty, v_node) = self.ad_lower_expr(v_e, span)?;
        let mask: Option<Value> = match args.get(3) {
            None => None,
            Some(CallArg::Positional(e)) => {
                let (m_ptr, m_ty) = self.lower_expr(e)?;
                match m_ty {
                    TyKind::Scalar(ScalarKind::Nil) => None,
                    TyKind::Tensor(mt) if mt.elem == ScalarKind::Bool && mt.rank() == 2 => {
                        Some(m_ptr)
                    }
                    // The interpreter also accepts numeric 0/1 masks; that
                    // form stays outside the JIT subset rather than erroring.
                    other => return unsupported(span, format!(
                        "@grad attn mask must be a bool [S,S] tensor or nil under the JIT \
                         (got `{}`); use `dmc run`", other.render()).as_str()),
                }
            }
            Some(_) => return unsupported(span, "non-positional mask arg to attn in @grad"),
        };
        let qt = q_ty.as_tensor().ok_or_else(|| JitError {
            msg: format!("{}: q must be a tensor", name), line: span.line, col: span.col })?.clone();
        let kt = k_ty.as_tensor().ok_or_else(|| JitError {
            msg: format!("{}: k must be a tensor (KV-cache operands in @grad need `dmc run`)", name),
            line: span.line, col: span.col })?.clone();
        let vt = v_ty.as_tensor().ok_or_else(|| JitError {
            msg: format!("{}: v must be a tensor (KV-cache operands in @grad need `dmc run`)", name),
            line: span.line, col: span.col })?.clone();
        if qt.rank() != 4 || kt.rank() != 4 || vt.rank() != 4 {
            return err(span, format!("{}: q/k/v must be rank-4 [B,H,S,D]", name));
        }
        if qt.elem != ScalarKind::F32 || kt.elem != ScalarKind::F32 || vt.elem != ScalarKind::F32 {
            return unsupported(span, "@grad attn is f32-only");
        }
        let b   = qt.shape[0];
        let h_q = qt.shape[1];
        let s   = qt.shape[2];
        let d   = qt.shape[3];
        let h_kv = kt.shape[1];
        if kt.shape != [b, h_kv, s, d] || vt.shape != kt.shape {
            return err(span, format!("{}: k/v must be [B, H_kv, S, D]", name));
        }
        if name == "attn" && h_kv != h_q {
            return err(span, "attn: q/k/v must have identical shapes [B,H,S,D]");
        }
        if h_q % h_kv != 0 {
            return err(span, format!(
                "{}: H_q ({}) must be divisible by H_kv ({})", name, h_q, h_kv));
        }
        let out_ty = TensorTy { elem: ScalarKind::F32, shape: vec![b, h_q, s, d] };
        let out_ptr = self.forge_alloc(out_ty.nbytes());
        let p_bytes = b.checked_mul(h_q)
            .and_then(|x| x.checked_mul(s))
            .and_then(|x| x.checked_mul(s))
            .and_then(|x| x.checked_mul(4))
            .ok_or_else(|| JitError {
                msg: format!("{}: B*H*S*S*4 overflows i64 (shape too large for @grad)", name),
                line: span.line, col: span.col })?;
        let p_buf = self.forge_alloc(p_bytes);
        self.emit_attn_gqa_kernel(q_v, k_v, v_v, mask, out_ptr,
                                  b, h_q, h_kv, s, d, Some(p_buf), span)?;
        let node = self.ad.as_mut().unwrap().push_aux(
            AdOp::Attn, vec![q_node, k_node, v_node],
            TyKind::Tensor(out_ty.clone()), out_ptr, p_buf);
        Ok((out_ptr, TyKind::Tensor(out_ty), node))
    }

    fn ad_lower_binop(&mut self, op: &BinOp, lhs: &Expr, rhs: &Expr, span: &Span)
        -> Result<(Value, TyKind, usize), JitError>
    {
        let (lv, lty, ln) = self.ad_lower_expr(lhs, span)?;
        let (rv, rty, rn) = self.ad_lower_expr(rhs, span)?;
        match (&lty, &rty) {
            // Scalar float arithmetic composing the loss. AD works in f32, so
            // coerce mixed float scalars (e.g. an f64 literal accumulator seed
            // like `let !acc = 0.0f32`, which types as f64 under strict numeric
            // rules) to f32 before the op.
            (TyKind::Scalar(ls), TyKind::Scalar(rs)) if ls.is_float() && rs.is_float() => {
                let lf = self.coerce_scalar(lv, *ls, ScalarKind::F32, span)?;
                let rf = self.coerce_scalar(rv, *rs, ScalarKind::F32, span)?;
                let fwd = match op {
                    BinOp::Add => self.builder.ins().fadd(lf, rf),
                    BinOp::Sub => self.builder.ins().fsub(lf, rf),
                    BinOp::Mul => self.builder.ins().fmul(lf, rf),
                    BinOp::Div => self.builder.ins().fdiv(lf, rf),
                    _ => return unsupported(span, "scalar op not differentiable in slice 6"),
                };
                let node = self.ad.as_mut().unwrap().push(
                    AdOp::ScalarBin(op.clone()), vec![ln, rn],
                    TyKind::Scalar(ScalarKind::F32), fwd);
                Ok((fwd, TyKind::Scalar(ScalarKind::F32), node))
            }
            // Matmul.
            (TyKind::Tensor(lt), TyKind::Tensor(rt)) if *op == BinOp::Matmul => {
                let (out, out_ty) = self.lower_matmul(lv, lt, rv, rt, span)?;
                let node = self.ad.as_mut().unwrap().push(
                    AdOp::Matmul, vec![ln, rn], out_ty.clone(), out);
                Ok((out, out_ty, node))
            }
            // Tensor⊙tensor elementwise.
            (TyKind::Tensor(lt), TyKind::Tensor(rt))
                if matches!(op, BinOp::DotAdd | BinOp::DotSub | BinOp::DotMul | BinOp::DotDiv) =>
            {
                let (out, out_ty) = self.lower_elementwise(op, lv, lt, rv, rt, span)?;
                let node = self.ad.as_mut().unwrap().push(
                    AdOp::Elem(op.clone()), vec![ln, rn], out_ty.clone(), out);
                Ok((out, out_ty, node))
            }
            // scalar ⊙ tensor and tensor ⊙ scalar broadcast.
            (TyKind::Scalar(s), TyKind::Tensor(tt))
                if matches!(op, BinOp::DotAdd | BinOp::DotSub | BinOp::DotMul | BinOp::DotDiv) =>
            {
                let sf = self.coerce_scalar(lv, *s, ScalarKind::F32, span)?;
                let (out, out_ty) = self.lower_scalar_tensor_broadcast(
                    op, sf, ScalarKind::F32, rv, tt, span, true)?;
                let node = self.ad.as_mut().unwrap().push(
                    AdOp::ScalarTensor {
                        op: op.clone(), scalar_is_lhs: true, scalar: sf,
                        scalar_node: Some(ln),
                    },
                    vec![rn], out_ty.clone(), out);
                Ok((out, out_ty, node))
            }
            (TyKind::Tensor(tt), TyKind::Scalar(s))
                if matches!(op, BinOp::DotAdd | BinOp::DotSub | BinOp::DotMul | BinOp::DotDiv) =>
            {
                let sf = self.coerce_scalar(rv, *s, ScalarKind::F32, span)?;
                let (out, out_ty) = self.lower_scalar_tensor_broadcast(
                    op, sf, ScalarKind::F32, lv, tt, span, false)?;
                let node = self.ad.as_mut().unwrap().push(
                    AdOp::ScalarTensor {
                        op: op.clone(), scalar_is_lhs: false, scalar: sf,
                        scalar_node: Some(rn),
                    },
                    vec![ln], out_ty.clone(), out);
                Ok((out, out_ty, node))
            }
            _ => unsupported(span, "operand kinds not differentiable in slice 6"),
        }
    }

    /// Emit the reverse pass: seed the loss adjoint to 1.0, propagate
    /// gradients through every recorded node in reverse, then publish each
    /// mut param's accumulated gradient via `__dmc_capture_grad`.
    fn emit_backward(&mut self, span: &Span) -> Result<Vec<(usize, Value)>, JitError> {
        let AdState { nodes, mut adjoint, mut_params, loss, env: _ } =
            self.ad.take().expect("emit_backward without AD state");
        let loss = loss.ok_or_else(|| JitError {
            msg: "no loss node recorded".into(), line: span.line, col: span.col,
        })?;
        let one = self.builder.ins().f32const(1.0_f32);
        adjoint[loss] = Some(one);

        for id in (0..nodes.len()).rev() {
            let adj = match adjoint[id] { Some(v) => v, None => continue };
            let kind = nodes[id].kind.clone();
            let inputs = nodes[id].inputs.clone();
            match kind {
                AdOp::Leaf | AdOp::Const => {}
                AdOp::Sum => {
                    let it = nodes[inputs[0]].ty.as_tensor().unwrap().clone();
                    let contrib = self.broadcast_scalar_to_tensor(adj, &it);
                    self.ad_accumulate(&nodes, &mut adjoint, inputs[0], contrib);
                }
                AdOp::Mean => {
                    let it = nodes[inputs[0]].ty.as_tensor().unwrap().clone();
                    let n = self.builder.ins().f32const(it.nelems() as f32);
                    let scaled = self.builder.ins().fdiv(adj, n);
                    let contrib = self.broadcast_scalar_to_tensor(scaled, &it);
                    self.ad_accumulate(&nodes, &mut adjoint, inputs[0], contrib);
                }
                AdOp::Elem(bop) => {
                    let t = nodes[id].ty.as_tensor().unwrap().clone();
                    let a = inputs[0]; let b = inputs[1];
                    let av = nodes[a].fwd; let bv = nodes[b].fwd;
                    match bop {
                        BinOp::DotAdd => {
                            self.ad_accumulate(&nodes, &mut adjoint, a, adj);
                            self.ad_accumulate(&nodes, &mut adjoint, b, adj);
                        }
                        BinOp::DotSub => {
                            self.ad_accumulate(&nodes, &mut adjoint, a, adj);
                            let neg = self.tensor_scale_const(adj, -1.0, &t);
                            self.ad_accumulate(&nodes, &mut adjoint, b, neg);
                        }
                        BinOp::DotMul => {
                            let da = self.raw_elem(&BinOp::DotMul, bv, adj, &t, span)?;
                            self.ad_accumulate(&nodes, &mut adjoint, a, da);
                            let db = self.raw_elem(&BinOp::DotMul, av, adj, &t, span)?;
                            self.ad_accumulate(&nodes, &mut adjoint, b, db);
                        }
                        BinOp::DotDiv => {
                            // da += g / b
                            let da = self.raw_elem(&BinOp::DotDiv, adj, bv, &t, span)?;
                            self.ad_accumulate(&nodes, &mut adjoint, a, da);
                            // db += -(g * a) / (b*b)
                            let ga = self.raw_elem(&BinOp::DotMul, adj, av, &t, span)?;
                            let bb = self.raw_elem(&BinOp::DotMul, bv, bv, &t, span)?;
                            let q = self.raw_elem(&BinOp::DotDiv, ga, bb, &t, span)?;
                            let db = self.tensor_scale_const(q, -1.0, &t);
                            self.ad_accumulate(&nodes, &mut adjoint, b, db);
                        }
                        _ => unreachable!(),
                    }
                }
                AdOp::ScalarTensor { op: bop, scalar_is_lhs, scalar, scalar_node } => {
                    let t = nodes[id].ty.as_tensor().unwrap().clone();
                    let tnode = inputs[0];
                    let tv = nodes[tnode].fwd;
                    match bop {
                        BinOp::DotAdd => {
                            self.ad_accumulate(&nodes, &mut adjoint, tnode, adj);
                        }
                        BinOp::DotSub => {
                            if scalar_is_lhs {
                                let neg = self.tensor_scale_const(adj, -1.0, &t);
                                self.ad_accumulate(&nodes, &mut adjoint, tnode, neg);
                            } else {
                                self.ad_accumulate(&nodes, &mut adjoint, tnode, adj);
                            }
                        }
                        BinOp::DotMul => {
                            let d = self.tensor_scale_value(adj, scalar, &t);
                            self.ad_accumulate(&nodes, &mut adjoint, tnode, d);
                        }
                        BinOp::DotDiv => {
                            if scalar_is_lhs {
                                // c = s / t -> dc/dt = -s / t^2
                                let t2 = self.raw_elem(&BinOp::DotMul, tv, tv, &t, span)?;
                                let gs = self.tensor_scale_value(adj, scalar, &t);
                                let q = self.raw_elem(&BinOp::DotDiv, gs, t2, &t, span)?;
                                let d = self.tensor_scale_const(q, -1.0, &t);
                                self.ad_accumulate(&nodes, &mut adjoint, tnode, d);
                            } else {
                                // c = t / s -> dc/dt = 1/s
                                let inv = self.recip_scalar(scalar);
                                let d = self.tensor_scale_value(adj, inv, &t);
                                self.ad_accumulate(&nodes, &mut adjoint, tnode, d);
                            }
                        }
                        _ => unreachable!(),
                    }
                    // Gradient into a *traced* scalar operand (e.g. `sum(w)`):
                    // the scalar was broadcast over the tensor, so its adjoint
                    // is the sum of the per-element contributions (#260). Skip
                    // when the scalar is a plain constant (`scalar_node == None`).
                    if let Some(sn) = scalar_node {
                        let n = t.nelems();
                        let s_grad = match bop {
                            // c_i = s + t_i  ->  dL/ds = Σ adj_i
                            BinOp::DotAdd => self.fused_sum(adj, n),
                            // s - t: dL/ds = Σ adj_i ;  t - s: dL/ds = -Σ adj_i
                            BinOp::DotSub => {
                                let s = self.fused_sum(adj, n);
                                if scalar_is_lhs { s } else { self.builder.ins().fneg(s) }
                            }
                            // c_i = s·t_i  ->  dL/ds = Σ adj_i·t_i
                            BinOp::DotMul => {
                                let prod = self.raw_elem(&BinOp::DotMul, adj, tv, &t, span)?;
                                self.fused_sum(prod, n)
                            }
                            BinOp::DotDiv => {
                                if scalar_is_lhs {
                                    // s/t: dL/ds = Σ adj_i / t_i
                                    let q = self.raw_elem(&BinOp::DotDiv, adj, tv, &t, span)?;
                                    self.fused_sum(q, n)
                                } else {
                                    // t/s: dL/ds = -Σ adj_i·t_i / s²
                                    let prod = self.raw_elem(&BinOp::DotMul, adj, tv, &t, span)?;
                                    let s2 = self.fused_sum(prod, n);
                                    let inv = self.recip_scalar(scalar);
                                    let neg = self.builder.ins().fneg(s2);
                                    let inv2 = self.builder.ins().fmul(inv, inv);
                                    self.builder.ins().fmul(neg, inv2)
                                }
                            }
                            _ => unreachable!(),
                        };
                        self.ad_accumulate(&nodes, &mut adjoint, sn, s_grad);
                    }
                }
                AdOp::Transpose => {
                    let out_t = nodes[id].ty.as_tensor().unwrap().clone();
                    // adj has the transposed shape; transpose it back.
                    let (back, _) = self.raw_transpose(adj, &out_t, span)?;
                    self.ad_accumulate(&nodes, &mut adjoint, inputs[0], back);
                }
                AdOp::Matmul => {
                    // c = a @ b ; g : [M,N]
                    let a = inputs[0]; let b = inputs[1];
                    let at = nodes[a].ty.as_tensor().unwrap().clone();
                    let bt = nodes[b].ty.as_tensor().unwrap().clone();
                    let av = nodes[a].fwd; let bv = nodes[b].fwd;
                    let gt = nodes[id].ty.as_tensor().unwrap().clone();
                    // da = g @ b'
                    let (bt_ptr, bt_ty) = self.raw_transpose(bv, &bt, span)?;
                    let (da, _) = self.lower_matmul(adj, &gt, bt_ptr, &bt_ty, span)?;
                    self.ad_accumulate(&nodes, &mut adjoint, a, da);
                    // db = a' @ g
                    let (at_ptr, at_ty) = self.raw_transpose(av, &at, span)?;
                    let (db, _) = self.lower_matmul(at_ptr, &at_ty, adj, &gt, span)?;
                    self.ad_accumulate(&nodes, &mut adjoint, b, db);
                }
                AdOp::ScalarBin(bop) => {
                    let a = inputs[0]; let b = inputs[1];
                    let av = nodes[a].fwd; let bv = nodes[b].fwd;
                    match bop {
                        BinOp::Add => {
                            self.ad_accumulate(&nodes, &mut adjoint, a, adj);
                            self.ad_accumulate(&nodes, &mut adjoint, b, adj);
                        }
                        BinOp::Sub => {
                            self.ad_accumulate(&nodes, &mut adjoint, a, adj);
                            let nb = self.builder.ins().fneg(adj);
                            self.ad_accumulate(&nodes, &mut adjoint, b, nb);
                        }
                        BinOp::Mul => {
                            let da = self.builder.ins().fmul(adj, bv);
                            self.ad_accumulate(&nodes, &mut adjoint, a, da);
                            let db = self.builder.ins().fmul(adj, av);
                            self.ad_accumulate(&nodes, &mut adjoint, b, db);
                        }
                        BinOp::Div => {
                            let da = self.builder.ins().fdiv(adj, bv);
                            self.ad_accumulate(&nodes, &mut adjoint, a, da);
                            // db = -a*g/(b*b)
                            let ag = self.builder.ins().fmul(av, adj);
                            let bb = self.builder.ins().fmul(bv, bv);
                            let q = self.builder.ins().fdiv(ag, bb);
                            let db = self.builder.ins().fneg(q);
                            self.ad_accumulate(&nodes, &mut adjoint, b, db);
                        }
                        _ => unreachable!(),
                    }
                }
                AdOp::Broadcast { ty } => {
                    // Backward of broadcast(scalar, ty): sum all adjoint elements.
                    // The input (node 0 in inputs) is a scalar; d_scalar = sum(adj_tensor).
                    let total = self.fused_sum(adj, ty.nelems());
                    self.ad_accumulate(&nodes, &mut adjoint, inputs[0], total);
                }
                AdOp::Relu | AdOp::ActivationRelu => {
                    let t = nodes[id].ty.as_tensor().unwrap().clone();
                    let inp = nodes[id].aux.unwrap();
                    let masked = self.tensor_relu_mask(adj, inp, &t);
                    self.ad_accumulate(&nodes, &mut adjoint, inputs[0], masked);
                }
                AdOp::ActivationTanh => {
                    let t = nodes[id].ty.as_tensor().unwrap().clone();
                    let fwd_out = nodes[id].fwd;
                    let d = self.tensor_tanh_backward(adj, fwd_out, &t);
                    self.ad_accumulate(&nodes, &mut adjoint, inputs[0], d);
                }
                AdOp::ActivationSigmoid => {
                    let t = nodes[id].ty.as_tensor().unwrap().clone();
                    let fwd_out = nodes[id].fwd;
                    let d = self.tensor_sigmoid_backward(adj, fwd_out, &t);
                    self.ad_accumulate(&nodes, &mut adjoint, inputs[0], d);
                }
                AdOp::ActivationGelu => {
                    let t_shape = nodes[id].ty.as_tensor().unwrap().clone();
                    let inp = nodes[id].aux.unwrap();
                    let d = self.tensor_gelu_backward(adj, inp, &t_shape);
                    self.ad_accumulate(&nodes, &mut adjoint, inputs[0], d);
                }
                AdOp::ActivationSilu | AdOp::ActivationElu | AdOp::ActivationMish => {
                    // adj .* act'(x), derivative over the stored input via the
                    // runtime deriv extern (#377).
                    let t = nodes[id].ty.as_tensor().unwrap().clone();
                    let inp = nodes[id].aux.unwrap();
                    let sym = match nodes[id].kind {
                        AdOp::ActivationSilu => "__dmc_silu_deriv_f32",
                        AdOp::ActivationElu  => "__dmc_elu_deriv_f32",
                        AdOp::ActivationMish => "__dmc_mish_deriv_f32",
                        _ => unreachable!(),
                    };
                    let d = self.tensor_activation_deriv_backward(adj, inp, &t, sym);
                    self.ad_accumulate(&nodes, &mut adjoint, inputs[0], d);
                }
                AdOp::Softmax => {
                    // dx = y .* (g - rowsum(g .* y)) over the last axis (#368).
                    let t = nodes[id].ty.as_tensor().unwrap().clone();
                    let y = nodes[id].fwd;
                    let dx = self.tensor_softmax_backward(adj, y, &t);
                    self.ad_accumulate(&nodes, &mut adjoint, inputs[0], dx);
                }
                AdOp::RmsNorm => {
                    // VJP flows to both x and gain (#368).
                    let t = nodes[id].ty.as_tensor().unwrap().clone();
                    let x = nodes[inputs[0]].fwd;
                    let gain = nodes[inputs[1]].fwd;
                    let eps = nodes[id].aux.unwrap();
                    let (dx, dgain) = self.tensor_rms_norm_backward(adj, x, gain, &t, eps);
                    self.ad_accumulate(&nodes, &mut adjoint, inputs[0], dx);
                    self.ad_accumulate(&nodes, &mut adjoint, inputs[1], dgain);
                }
                AdOp::LayerNorm => {
                    // VJP flows to x, gain, and bias (#368).
                    let t = nodes[id].ty.as_tensor().unwrap().clone();
                    let x = nodes[inputs[0]].fwd;
                    let gain = nodes[inputs[1]].fwd;
                    let eps = nodes[id].aux.unwrap();
                    let (dx, dgain, dbias) =
                        self.tensor_layer_norm_backward(adj, x, gain, &t, eps);
                    self.ad_accumulate(&nodes, &mut adjoint, inputs[0], dx);
                    self.ad_accumulate(&nodes, &mut adjoint, inputs[1], dgain);
                    self.ad_accumulate(&nodes, &mut adjoint, inputs[2], dbias);
                }
                AdOp::Rope => {
                    // VJP flows only to x: dx = rope(adj, cos, -sin) (#368).
                    // cos/sin are read-only tables (inputs[1], inputs[2]).
                    let t = nodes[id].ty.as_tensor().unwrap().clone();
                    let cos = nodes[inputs[1]].fwd;
                    let sin = nodes[inputs[2]].fwd;
                    let dx = self.tensor_rope_backward(adj, cos, sin, &t);
                    self.ad_accumulate(&nodes, &mut adjoint, inputs[0], dx);
                }
                AdOp::Attn => {
                    // Fused attention VJP to q, k, and v (#368). aux holds the
                    // [B,H_q,S,S] post-softmax weights P the forward saved.
                    let out_t = nodes[id].ty.as_tensor().unwrap().clone();
                    let k_t = nodes[inputs[1]].ty.as_tensor().unwrap().clone();
                    let q = nodes[inputs[0]].fwd;
                    let kk = nodes[inputs[1]].fwd;
                    let vv = nodes[inputs[2]].fwd;
                    let p_buf = nodes[id].aux.unwrap();
                    let (dq, dk, dv) =
                        self.tensor_attn_backward(adj, q, kk, vv, p_buf, &out_t, &k_t, span)?;
                    self.ad_accumulate(&nodes, &mut adjoint, inputs[0], dq);
                    self.ad_accumulate(&nodes, &mut adjoint, inputs[1], dk);
                    self.ad_accumulate(&nodes, &mut adjoint, inputs[2], dv);
                }
                AdOp::GeluFirstDeriv => {
                    // Backward of gelu'(x) w.r.t. x is gelu''(x).
                    // This is the key step that makes d²(sum(gelu(W)))/dW² = gelu''(W).
                    let t_shape = nodes[id].ty.as_tensor().unwrap().clone();
                    let inp = nodes[inputs[0]].fwd; // original x tensor pointer
                    let gelu_dd = self.tensor_gelu_second_deriv(inp, &t_shape);
                    let d = self.raw_elem(&BinOp::DotMul, adj, gelu_dd, &t_shape, span)?;
                    self.ad_accumulate(&nodes, &mut adjoint, inputs[0], d);
                }
            }
        }

        // Publish each mut param's gradient: to the host via capture_grad
        // (always), and return the (idx, grad_ptr) list so the caller can
        // also wire a single gradient into the multi-value return.
        //
        // If a mut param has no adjoint (None), the loss has no dependence on
        // that param and the gradient is zero. We allocate a zeros tensor for
        // tensor params; scalar params raise an error (the first-pass backward
        // always produces a gradient for scalar loss functions).
        let cap = self.fns.get("__dmc_capture_grad").expect("registered").clone();
        let mut grads = Vec::new();
        for (idx, node) in &mut_params {
            let grad = match adjoint[*node] {
                Some(v) => v,
                None => {
                    // No gradient path: either a bug in the first-pass backward (error)
                    // or a valid zero second derivative in the tape-backward pass.
                    // Distinguish by checking if the node is a tensor (can be zero) or scalar.
                    if let Some(tt) = nodes[*node].ty.as_tensor() {
                        let tt = tt.clone();
                        // Allocate a zeros tensor as the gradient.
                        self.forge_alloc(tt.nbytes())
                    } else {
                        return Err(JitError {
                            msg: "mut parameter received no gradient (loss does not depend on it?)".into(),
                            line: span.line, col: span.col,
                        });
                    }
                }
            };
            // nbytes drives the epilogue's grad compaction; 0 marks a
            // non-tensor gradient (nothing to relocate).
            let nbytes = nodes[*node].ty.as_tensor()
                .map(|tt| tt.nbytes() as i64).unwrap_or(0);
            let func_ref = self.module.declare_func_in_func(cap.id, self.builder.func);
            let idx_v = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, *idx as i64);
            let nb_v = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, nbytes);
            self.builder.ins().call(func_ref, &[idx_v, grad, nb_v]);
            grads.push((*idx, grad));
        }
        Ok(grads)
    }

    fn ad_accumulate(
        &mut self,
        nodes: &[AdNode],
        adjoint: &mut Vec<Option<Value>>,
        node: usize,
        contrib: Value,
    ) {
        match adjoint[node] {
            None => adjoint[node] = Some(contrib),
            Some(existing) => {
                if let Some(t) = nodes[node].ty.as_tensor() {
                    let tt = t.clone();
                    self.tensor_add_inplace(existing, contrib, &tt);
                } else {
                    let s = self.builder.ins().fadd(existing, contrib);
                    adjoint[node] = Some(s);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    // ─── tape_backward: symbolic taping of the reverse pass ─────────────────

    /// Functional accumulation for the symbolic tape: creates a new Add node
    /// rather than mutating in place (preserves SSA in the new AdState).
    fn tape_accumulate(
        st: &mut AdState,
        fwd_nodes: &[AdNode],
        adj_node: &mut Vec<Option<usize>>,
        target: usize,
        contrib_node: usize,
    ) {
        match adj_node[target] {
            None => { adj_node[target] = Some(contrib_node); }
            Some(existing) => {
                let ty = fwd_nodes[target].ty.clone();
                let sum_node = if ty.is_tensor() {
                    st.push(AdOp::Elem(BinOp::DotAdd),
                        vec![existing, contrib_node], ty, Value::from_u32(0))
                } else {
                    st.push(AdOp::ScalarBin(BinOp::Add),
                        vec![existing, contrib_node], ty, Value::from_u32(0))
                };
                adj_node[target] = Some(sum_node);
            }
        }
    }

    /// Build a new `AdState` that represents the backward computation
    /// symbolically. The returned `AdState` can be fed to `emit_backward` to
    /// obtain the second derivative.
    ///
    /// `forward_ad` is the completed first-pass `AdState` (after
    /// `ad_lower_block` has run and `loss` is set). The forward values stored
    /// in `forward_ad.nodes[i].fwd` are valid JIT `Value`s that already exist
    /// in the current function — they are wrapped as `Const` nodes in the new
    /// graph so the backward-of-backward can reference them.
    fn tape_backward(
        &mut self,
        forward_ad: AdState,
        span: &Span,
    ) -> Result<AdState, JitError> {
        let AdState { nodes: fwd_nodes, mut_params: fwd_mut_params, loss, .. } = forward_ad;
        let loss = loss.ok_or_else(|| JitError {
            msg: "tape_backward: no loss node in forward AdState".into(),
            line: span.line, col: span.col,
        })?;

        let n = fwd_nodes.len();

        // Determine which fwd nodes are differentiable (reachable from a mut param).
        // We replicate the forward graph in the tape:
        //   - Leaf nodes for mut params  → Leaf  (differentiable in 2nd pass)
        //   - Leaf nodes for other params → Const (not differentiable)
        //   - Const nodes                → Const (not differentiable)
        //   - Computation nodes          → same op, with tape-local input refs
        //
        // This lets emit_backward differentiate through the entire forward graph,
        // not just through the adjoint computation.
        //
        // `tape_fwd[i]` = node-id in `st` corresponding to fwd_nodes[i].

        let mut st = AdState::new();
        let mut tape_fwd: Vec<usize> = Vec::with_capacity(n);

        // Set of mut param node ids in the original forward graph.
        let mut_param_set: std::collections::HashSet<usize> =
            fwd_mut_params.iter().map(|(_, nid)| *nid).collect();

        // Phase 1: replicate the forward graph in `st`.
        for i in 0..n {
            let fv = fwd_nodes[i].fwd;
            let ty = fwd_nodes[i].ty.clone();
            let inputs_orig = &fwd_nodes[i].inputs;
            // Map original input ids to tape-local ids.
            let inputs_tape: Vec<usize> = inputs_orig.iter().map(|&j| tape_fwd[j]).collect();

            let kind_tape = match &fwd_nodes[i].kind {
                // Leaf: differentiable if it's a mut param, Const otherwise.
                AdOp::Leaf => {
                    if mut_param_set.contains(&i) {
                        AdOp::Leaf
                    } else {
                        AdOp::Const
                    }
                }
                // Const in forward → Const in tape (never differentiable).
                AdOp::Const => AdOp::Const,
                // ScalarTensor carries a node id *inside* the kind, which the
                // generic clone wouldn't remap — rewrite it through tape_fwd so
                // it points at the replicated node, not a stale forward index.
                AdOp::ScalarTensor { op, scalar_is_lhs, scalar, scalar_node } =>
                    AdOp::ScalarTensor {
                        op: op.clone(), scalar_is_lhs: *scalar_is_lhs, scalar: *scalar,
                        scalar_node: scalar_node.map(|j| tape_fwd[j]),
                    },
                // All other ops: replicate the kind but with tape-local inputs.
                // The `kind` is cloned directly; inputs are re-mapped above.
                other => other.clone(),
            };

            let tape_id = st.push(kind_tape, inputs_tape, ty, fv);
            tape_fwd.push(tape_id);
        }

        // Record the number of Phase-1 nodes. Only Phase-2 nodes (added
        // below by the backward construction) need `eval_tape_fwd` to
        // emit IR for their forward values.
        let phase1_end = st.nodes.len(); // == n

        // `adj_node[i]` = node-id in `st` for the accumulated adjoint of
        // fwd_nodes[i], or None if no gradient has been pushed yet.
        let mut adj_node: Vec<Option<usize>> = vec![None; n];

        // Seed: adjoint of loss = 1.0.
        let one_v = self.builder.ins().f32const(1.0_f32);
        let one_node = st.push(AdOp::Const, vec![], TyKind::Scalar(ScalarKind::F32), one_v);
        adj_node[loss] = Some(one_node);

        // Walk backward, producing symbolic adjoint nodes.
        for id in (0..n).rev() {
            let adj_id = match adj_node[id] { Some(v) => v, None => continue };
            let kind = fwd_nodes[id].kind.clone();
            let inputs = fwd_nodes[id].inputs.clone();

            match kind {
                AdOp::Leaf | AdOp::Const => {}

                // Second-order (@grad @grad) is not wired for these smooth
                // activations yet — bail so the whole @grad fn falls back to the
                // interpreter reference rather than emitting a wrong 2nd derivative.
                AdOp::ActivationSilu | AdOp::ActivationElu | AdOp::ActivationMish
                | AdOp::Softmax | AdOp::RmsNorm | AdOp::LayerNorm | AdOp::Rope
                | AdOp::Attn =>
                    return unsupported(span,
                        "second-order (@grad @grad) for silu/elu/mish/softmax/rms_norm/layer_norm/rope/attn is not JIT-lowered yet; use `dmc run`"),

                AdOp::Sum => {
                    // d_x += broadcast(adj, shape_of_x)
                    let ity = fwd_nodes[inputs[0]].ty.as_tensor().unwrap().clone();
                    let bc_node = st.push(
                        AdOp::Broadcast { ty: ity.clone() },
                        vec![adj_id],
                        TyKind::Tensor(ity),
                        Value::from_u32(0),
                    );
                    Self::tape_accumulate(&mut st, &fwd_nodes, &mut adj_node, inputs[0], bc_node);
                }

                AdOp::Mean => {
                    // d_x += broadcast(adj / n, shape_of_x)
                    let ity = fwd_nodes[inputs[0]].ty.as_tensor().unwrap().clone();
                    let n_val = self.builder.ins().f32const(ity.nelems() as f32);
                    let n_node = st.push(AdOp::Const, vec![],
                        TyKind::Scalar(ScalarKind::F32), n_val);
                    let scaled_node = st.push(AdOp::ScalarBin(BinOp::Div), vec![adj_id, n_node],
                        TyKind::Scalar(ScalarKind::F32), Value::from_u32(0));
                    let bc_node = st.push(
                        AdOp::Broadcast { ty: ity.clone() },
                        vec![scaled_node],
                        TyKind::Tensor(ity),
                        Value::from_u32(0),
                    );
                    Self::tape_accumulate(&mut st, &fwd_nodes, &mut adj_node, inputs[0], bc_node);
                }

                AdOp::Elem(bop) => {
                    let t = fwd_nodes[id].ty.as_tensor().unwrap().clone();
                    let a = inputs[0]; let b = inputs[1];
                    match bop {
                        BinOp::DotAdd => {
                            // d_a += adj, d_b += adj
                            Self::tape_accumulate(&mut st, &fwd_nodes, &mut adj_node, a, adj_id);
                            Self::tape_accumulate(&mut st, &fwd_nodes, &mut adj_node, b, adj_id);
                        }
                        BinOp::DotSub => {
                            // d_a += adj, d_b += -adj
                            Self::tape_accumulate(&mut st, &fwd_nodes, &mut adj_node, a, adj_id);
                            let neg_one_v = self.builder.ins().f32const(-1.0_f32);
                            let neg_one_n = st.push(AdOp::Const, vec![],
                                TyKind::Scalar(ScalarKind::F32), neg_one_v);
                            let neg_node = st.push(
                                AdOp::ScalarTensor { op: BinOp::DotMul, scalar_is_lhs: true,
                                    scalar: neg_one_v, scalar_node: None },
                                vec![adj_id],
                                TyKind::Tensor(t),
                                Value::from_u32(0),
                            );
                            // Store neg_one_n to avoid dead-code issues; it's embedded in neg_node.
                            let _ = neg_one_n;
                            Self::tape_accumulate(&mut st, &fwd_nodes, &mut adj_node, b, neg_node);
                        }
                        BinOp::DotMul => {
                            // d_a += adj .* b, d_b += adj .* a
                            let da_node = st.push(AdOp::Elem(BinOp::DotMul),
                                vec![adj_id, tape_fwd[b]],
                                TyKind::Tensor(t.clone()),
                                Value::from_u32(0));
                            Self::tape_accumulate(&mut st, &fwd_nodes, &mut adj_node, a, da_node);
                            let db_node = st.push(AdOp::Elem(BinOp::DotMul),
                                vec![adj_id, tape_fwd[a]],
                                TyKind::Tensor(t),
                                Value::from_u32(0));
                            Self::tape_accumulate(&mut st, &fwd_nodes, &mut adj_node, b, db_node);
                        }
                        BinOp::DotDiv => {
                            // d_a += adj ./ b
                            let da_node = st.push(AdOp::Elem(BinOp::DotDiv),
                                vec![adj_id, tape_fwd[b]],
                                TyKind::Tensor(t.clone()),
                                Value::from_u32(0));
                            Self::tape_accumulate(&mut st, &fwd_nodes, &mut adj_node, a, da_node);
                            // d_b += -(adj .* a) ./ (b .* b)
                            let ga_node = st.push(AdOp::Elem(BinOp::DotMul),
                                vec![adj_id, tape_fwd[a]],
                                TyKind::Tensor(t.clone()),
                                Value::from_u32(0));
                            let bb_node = st.push(AdOp::Elem(BinOp::DotMul),
                                vec![tape_fwd[b], tape_fwd[b]],
                                TyKind::Tensor(t.clone()),
                                Value::from_u32(0));
                            let q_node = st.push(AdOp::Elem(BinOp::DotDiv),
                                vec![ga_node, bb_node],
                                TyKind::Tensor(t.clone()),
                                Value::from_u32(0));
                            let neg_one_v = self.builder.ins().f32const(-1.0_f32);
                            let db_node = st.push(
                                AdOp::ScalarTensor { op: BinOp::DotMul, scalar_is_lhs: true,
                                    scalar: neg_one_v, scalar_node: None },
                                vec![q_node],
                                TyKind::Tensor(t),
                                Value::from_u32(0),
                            );
                            Self::tape_accumulate(&mut st, &fwd_nodes, &mut adj_node, b, db_node);
                        }
                        _ => unreachable!(),
                    }
                }

                AdOp::ScalarTensor { op: bop, scalar_is_lhs, scalar, .. } => {
                    let t = fwd_nodes[id].ty.as_tensor().unwrap().clone();
                    let tnode = inputs[0];
                    // scalar is stored as a Value; wrap it as Const.
                    let scalar_cn = st.push(AdOp::Const, vec![],
                        TyKind::Scalar(ScalarKind::F32), scalar);
                    match bop {
                        BinOp::DotAdd => {
                            Self::tape_accumulate(&mut st, &fwd_nodes, &mut adj_node, tnode, adj_id);
                        }
                        BinOp::DotSub => {
                            if scalar_is_lhs {
                                let neg_one_v = self.builder.ins().f32const(-1.0_f32);
                                let neg_node = st.push(
                                    AdOp::ScalarTensor { op: BinOp::DotMul, scalar_is_lhs: true,
                                        scalar: neg_one_v, scalar_node: None },
                                    vec![adj_id],
                                    TyKind::Tensor(t),
                                    Value::from_u32(0),
                                );
                                Self::tape_accumulate(&mut st, &fwd_nodes, &mut adj_node, tnode, neg_node);
                            } else {
                                Self::tape_accumulate(&mut st, &fwd_nodes, &mut adj_node, tnode, adj_id);
                            }
                        }
                        BinOp::DotMul => {
                            // d_tensor += adj .* scalar
                            let d_node = st.push(
                                AdOp::ScalarTensor { op: BinOp::DotMul, scalar_is_lhs: true,
                                    scalar, scalar_node: None },
                                vec![adj_id],
                                TyKind::Tensor(t),
                                Value::from_u32(0),
                            );
                            let _ = scalar_cn;
                            Self::tape_accumulate(&mut st, &fwd_nodes, &mut adj_node, tnode, d_node);
                        }
                        BinOp::DotDiv => {
                            if scalar_is_lhs {
                                // c = s / t -> d/dt = -s / t^2
                                let tv_cn = tape_fwd[tnode];
                                let t2_node = st.push(AdOp::Elem(BinOp::DotMul),
                                    vec![tv_cn, tv_cn],
                                    TyKind::Tensor(t.clone()),
                                    Value::from_u32(0));
                                let gs_node = st.push(
                                    AdOp::ScalarTensor { op: BinOp::DotMul, scalar_is_lhs: true,
                                        scalar, scalar_node: None },
                                    vec![adj_id],
                                    TyKind::Tensor(t.clone()),
                                    Value::from_u32(0));
                                let _ = scalar_cn;
                                let q_node = st.push(AdOp::Elem(BinOp::DotDiv),
                                    vec![gs_node, t2_node],
                                    TyKind::Tensor(t.clone()),
                                    Value::from_u32(0));
                                let neg_one_v = self.builder.ins().f32const(-1.0_f32);
                                let d_node = st.push(
                                    AdOp::ScalarTensor { op: BinOp::DotMul, scalar_is_lhs: true,
                                        scalar: neg_one_v, scalar_node: None },
                                    vec![q_node],
                                    TyKind::Tensor(t),
                                    Value::from_u32(0),
                                );
                                Self::tape_accumulate(&mut st, &fwd_nodes, &mut adj_node, tnode, d_node);
                            } else {
                                // c = t / s -> d/dt = 1/s (scalar constant wrt tensor)
                                let one_f = self.builder.ins().f32const(1.0_f32);
                                let inv_s_v = self.builder.ins().fdiv(one_f, scalar);
                                let _ = scalar_cn;
                                let d_node = st.push(
                                    AdOp::ScalarTensor { op: BinOp::DotMul, scalar_is_lhs: true,
                                        scalar: inv_s_v, scalar_node: None },
                                    vec![adj_id],
                                    TyKind::Tensor(t),
                                    Value::from_u32(0),
                                );
                                Self::tape_accumulate(&mut st, &fwd_nodes, &mut adj_node, tnode, d_node);
                            }
                        }
                        _ => unreachable!(),
                    }
                }

                AdOp::Transpose => {
                    // d_x = transpose(adj)
                    let out_t = fwd_nodes[id].ty.as_tensor().unwrap().clone();
                    // adj has the transposed shape; its type is out_t (from the forward).
                    // After transposing back, the type becomes the input's type.
                    let in_t = fwd_nodes[inputs[0]].ty.as_tensor().unwrap().clone();
                    let back_node = st.push(AdOp::Transpose,
                        vec![adj_id],
                        TyKind::Tensor(in_t),
                        Value::from_u32(0));
                    let _ = out_t;
                    Self::tape_accumulate(&mut st, &fwd_nodes, &mut adj_node, inputs[0], back_node);
                }

                AdOp::Matmul => {
                    // c = a @ b; adj: [M, N]
                    let a = inputs[0]; let b = inputs[1];
                    let at = fwd_nodes[a].ty.as_tensor().unwrap().clone();
                    let bt = fwd_nodes[b].ty.as_tensor().unwrap().clone();
                    let gt = fwd_nodes[id].ty.as_tensor().unwrap().clone();
                    // da = adj @ b' — shapes: [M,N] @ [N,K] = [M,K]
                    let bt_ty = TensorTy { elem: bt.elem, shape: vec![bt.shape[1], bt.shape[0]] };
                    let bt_node = st.push(AdOp::Transpose,
                        vec![tape_fwd[b]],
                        TyKind::Tensor(bt_ty),
                        Value::from_u32(0));
                    let da_ty = at.clone();
                    let da_node = st.push(AdOp::Matmul,
                        vec![adj_id, bt_node],
                        TyKind::Tensor(da_ty),
                        Value::from_u32(0));
                    Self::tape_accumulate(&mut st, &fwd_nodes, &mut adj_node, a, da_node);
                    // db = a' @ adj — shapes: [K,M] @ [M,N] = [K,N]
                    let at_ty = TensorTy { elem: at.elem, shape: vec![at.shape[1], at.shape[0]] };
                    let at_node = st.push(AdOp::Transpose,
                        vec![tape_fwd[a]],
                        TyKind::Tensor(at_ty),
                        Value::from_u32(0));
                    let db_ty = bt.clone();
                    let db_node = st.push(AdOp::Matmul,
                        vec![at_node, adj_id],
                        TyKind::Tensor(db_ty),
                        Value::from_u32(0));
                    Self::tape_accumulate(&mut st, &fwd_nodes, &mut adj_node, b, db_node);
                    let _ = gt;
                }

                AdOp::ScalarBin(bop) => {
                    let a = inputs[0]; let b = inputs[1];
                    let scal_ty = TyKind::Scalar(ScalarKind::F32);
                    match bop {
                        BinOp::Add => {
                            Self::tape_accumulate(&mut st, &fwd_nodes, &mut adj_node, a, adj_id);
                            Self::tape_accumulate(&mut st, &fwd_nodes, &mut adj_node, b, adj_id);
                        }
                        BinOp::Sub => {
                            Self::tape_accumulate(&mut st, &fwd_nodes, &mut adj_node, a, adj_id);
                            // d_b = -adj
                            let neg_one_v = self.builder.ins().f32const(-1.0_f32);
                            let neg_one_n = st.push(AdOp::Const, vec![], scal_ty.clone(), neg_one_v);
                            let nb_node = st.push(AdOp::ScalarBin(BinOp::Mul),
                                vec![adj_id, neg_one_n], scal_ty, Value::from_u32(0));
                            Self::tape_accumulate(&mut st, &fwd_nodes, &mut adj_node, b, nb_node);
                        }
                        BinOp::Mul => {
                            // d_a = adj * b, d_b = adj * a
                            let da_node = st.push(AdOp::ScalarBin(BinOp::Mul),
                                vec![adj_id, tape_fwd[b]], scal_ty.clone(), Value::from_u32(0));
                            Self::tape_accumulate(&mut st, &fwd_nodes, &mut adj_node, a, da_node);
                            let db_node = st.push(AdOp::ScalarBin(BinOp::Mul),
                                vec![adj_id, tape_fwd[a]], scal_ty, Value::from_u32(0));
                            Self::tape_accumulate(&mut st, &fwd_nodes, &mut adj_node, b, db_node);
                        }
                        BinOp::Div => {
                            // d_a = adj / b
                            let da_node = st.push(AdOp::ScalarBin(BinOp::Div),
                                vec![adj_id, tape_fwd[b]], scal_ty.clone(), Value::from_u32(0));
                            Self::tape_accumulate(&mut st, &fwd_nodes, &mut adj_node, a, da_node);
                            // d_b = -(a * adj) / (b * b)
                            let ag_node = st.push(AdOp::ScalarBin(BinOp::Mul),
                                vec![tape_fwd[a], adj_id], scal_ty.clone(), Value::from_u32(0));
                            let bb_node = st.push(AdOp::ScalarBin(BinOp::Mul),
                                vec![tape_fwd[b], tape_fwd[b]], scal_ty.clone(), Value::from_u32(0));
                            let q_node = st.push(AdOp::ScalarBin(BinOp::Div),
                                vec![ag_node, bb_node], scal_ty.clone(), Value::from_u32(0));
                            let neg_one_v = self.builder.ins().f32const(-1.0_f32);
                            let neg_one_n = st.push(AdOp::Const, vec![], scal_ty.clone(), neg_one_v);
                            let db_node = st.push(AdOp::ScalarBin(BinOp::Mul),
                                vec![q_node, neg_one_n], scal_ty, Value::from_u32(0));
                            Self::tape_accumulate(&mut st, &fwd_nodes, &mut adj_node, b, db_node);
                        }
                        _ => unreachable!(),
                    }
                }

                AdOp::Broadcast { .. } => {
                    // Broadcast in the forward tape means we already handled it above.
                    // In the second-order tape this would mean differentiating a
                    // Broadcast node, but Broadcast nodes only appear in the tape_backward
                    // output (not in the user's forward graph), so they won't appear here.
                    unreachable!("Broadcast node in user forward graph")
                }

                // Activation nodes: second-order AD rules.
                // The first-backward of activation(x) emits adj * activation'(x).
                // The second-backward differentiates this wrt x, giving
                // adj * activation''(x), accumulated into inputs[0].
                AdOp::Relu | AdOp::ActivationRelu => {
                    // relu''(x) = 0 everywhere (step function has zero derivative).
                    // Propagate a zero-valued contribution so accumulation is explicit.
                    let t_ty = fwd_nodes[id].ty.as_tensor().unwrap().clone();
                    let zero_v = self.builder.ins().f32const(0.0_f32);
                    // adj_id .* 0.0 → zero tensor
                    let zero_node = st.push(
                        AdOp::ScalarTensor { op: BinOp::DotMul, scalar_is_lhs: true, scalar: zero_v, scalar_node: None },
                        vec![adj_id],
                        TyKind::Tensor(t_ty),
                        Value::from_u32(0),
                    );
                    Self::tape_accumulate(&mut st, &fwd_nodes, &mut adj_node, inputs[0], zero_node);
                }

                AdOp::ActivationTanh => {
                    // Represent the backward of tanh symbolically so that
                    // emit_backward can differentiate through it.
                    // tanh backward: d_x = adj .* (1 - tanh_out²)
                    // tanh''(x) emerges when emit_backward propagates through
                    // the Phase-1 tanh node (applying tanh' again gives tanh'').
                    let t_ty = fwd_nodes[id].ty.as_tensor().unwrap().clone();
                    let t_node = tape_fwd[id]; // Phase-1 tanh node, fwd = tanh(x)
                    // tanh_sq = tanh(x) .* tanh(x) = t²
                    let tanh_sq = st.push(AdOp::Elem(BinOp::DotMul),
                        vec![t_node, t_node],
                        TyKind::Tensor(t_ty.clone()),
                        Value::from_u32(0));
                    // one_m_sq = 1 - t² = sech²(x)
                    let one_v = self.builder.ins().f32const(1.0_f32);
                    let one_m_sq = st.push(
                        AdOp::ScalarTensor { op: BinOp::DotSub, scalar_is_lhs: true, scalar: one_v, scalar_node: None },
                        vec![tanh_sq],
                        TyKind::Tensor(t_ty.clone()),
                        Value::from_u32(0));
                    // d_x = adj .* (1 - t²)
                    let d_x = st.push(AdOp::Elem(BinOp::DotMul),
                        vec![adj_id, one_m_sq],
                        TyKind::Tensor(t_ty),
                        Value::from_u32(0));
                    Self::tape_accumulate(&mut st, &fwd_nodes, &mut adj_node, inputs[0], d_x);
                }

                AdOp::ActivationSigmoid => {
                    // Represent the backward of sigmoid symbolically so that
                    // emit_backward can differentiate through it.
                    // sigmoid backward: d_x = adj .* s .* (1 - s)
                    // sigmoid''(x) emerges when emit_backward propagates through
                    // the Phase-1 sigmoid node (applying sigmoid' again gives sigmoid'').
                    let t_ty = fwd_nodes[id].ty.as_tensor().unwrap().clone();
                    let s_node = tape_fwd[id]; // Phase-1 sigmoid node, fwd = sigmoid(x)
                    // 1 - s
                    let one_v = self.builder.ins().f32const(1.0_f32);
                    let one_m_s = st.push(
                        AdOp::ScalarTensor { op: BinOp::DotSub, scalar_is_lhs: true, scalar: one_v, scalar_node: None },
                        vec![s_node],
                        TyKind::Tensor(t_ty.clone()),
                        Value::from_u32(0));
                    // s*(1-s)
                    let s_om_s = st.push(AdOp::Elem(BinOp::DotMul),
                        vec![s_node, one_m_s],
                        TyKind::Tensor(t_ty.clone()),
                        Value::from_u32(0));
                    // d_x = adj .* s .* (1-s)
                    let d_x = st.push(AdOp::Elem(BinOp::DotMul),
                        vec![adj_id, s_om_s],
                        TyKind::Tensor(t_ty),
                        Value::from_u32(0));
                    Self::tape_accumulate(&mut st, &fwd_nodes, &mut adj_node, inputs[0], d_x);
                }

                AdOp::ActivationGelu => {
                    // The Phase-1 backward of gelu(x) accumulates `adj * gelu'(x)` into
                    // the adjoint of x. To tape this symbolically in Phase-2 so that
                    // `emit_backward` can later differentiate through it, we need a node
                    // that represents `gelu'(x)` (NOT gelu''(x)). The accumulated Phase-2
                    // adjoint of x becomes `adj * gelu'(x)`, making the Phase-2 loss
                    // = sum(adj * gelu'(x)), and emit_backward then gives gelu''(x).
                    let t_ty = fwd_nodes[id].ty.as_tensor().unwrap().clone();
                    let x_node = tape_fwd[inputs[0]]; // Phase-2 Leaf for x
                    let gelu_fd = st.push(
                        AdOp::GeluFirstDeriv,
                        vec![x_node],
                        TyKind::Tensor(t_ty.clone()),
                        Value::from_u32(0),
                    );
                    let d_x = st.push(
                        AdOp::Elem(BinOp::DotMul),
                        vec![adj_id, gelu_fd],
                        TyKind::Tensor(t_ty),
                        Value::from_u32(0),
                    );
                    Self::tape_accumulate(&mut st, &fwd_nodes, &mut adj_node, inputs[0], d_x);
                }

                AdOp::GeluFirstDeriv => unreachable!("GeluFirstDeriv is Phase-2 only"),
            }
        }

        // Wire up mut_params: the second pass differentiates the first gradient
        // wrt the original input parameters. So mut_params for the tape AdState
        // point to the tape_fwd[orig_node] Leaf nodes (which are the same
        // parameters as in the first pass, now as Leaves in the tape graph).
        let mut new_mut_params: Vec<(usize, usize)> = Vec::new();
        for (idx, orig_node) in &fwd_mut_params {
            // tape_fwd[orig_node] is the Leaf node for this parameter in the tape.
            new_mut_params.push((*idx, tape_fwd[*orig_node]));
        }
        st.mut_params = new_mut_params;

        // The "loss" for the second pass is the first-gradient of the first mut param.
        // emit_backward seeds this with adjoint=1 and propagates backward through
        // the tape graph, yielding d²L/dW² at the Leaf nodes.
        //
        // If the first param's gradient is a tensor, we reduce it via sum to get a
        // scalar loss. This computes d/dW(sum(dL/dW)) = diagonal of the Hessian.
        let first_mut_adj = fwd_mut_params.iter().next()
            .and_then(|(_, orig_node)| adj_node[*orig_node]);

        if let Some(grad_node_id) = first_mut_adj {
            let grad_ty = st.nodes[grad_node_id].ty.clone();
            let final_loss_node = if grad_ty.is_tensor() {
                // sum(dL/dW) as scalar loss → d²L/dW² (Hessian diagonal).
                st.push(AdOp::Sum, vec![grad_node_id],
                    TyKind::Scalar(ScalarKind::F32), Value::from_u32(0))
            } else {
                grad_node_id
            };
            st.loss = Some(final_loss_node);
        } else {
            return Err(JitError {
                msg: "tape_backward: first mut param has no gradient (loss independent of it?)".into(),
                line: span.line, col: span.col,
            });
        }

        // Evaluate forward values for Phase-2 tape nodes only. Phase-1 nodes
        // (indices 0..phase1_end) already have their fwd set from the first pass.
        // Phase-2 nodes were built with `fwd = Value::from_u32(0)` as a placeholder.
        self.eval_tape_fwd(&mut st, phase1_end, span)?;

        Ok(st)
    }

    /// Walk Phase-2 tape nodes (indices `start..`) in forward order and emit
    /// Cranelift IR for their forward values. Phase-1 nodes (0..start) already
    /// have their fwd set from the original forward pass and are skipped.
    fn eval_tape_fwd(&mut self, st: &mut AdState, start: usize, span: &Span) -> Result<(), JitError> {
        for id in start..st.nodes.len() {
            let kind = st.nodes[id].kind.clone();
            let inputs = st.nodes[id].inputs.clone();
            let ty = st.nodes[id].ty.clone();

            // Const and Leaf nodes in Phase 2 have their fwd already set
            // (e.g., the one_node seeded with f32const(1.0)).
            match kind {
                AdOp::Const | AdOp::Leaf => continue,
                _ => {}
            }

            // Compute the forward value by emitting IR.
            let fwd_val: Value = match kind {
                AdOp::Const | AdOp::Leaf => unreachable!(),

                // Not reached in practice — tape_backward bails first — but keep
                // the match exhaustive and safe (#377).
                AdOp::ActivationSilu | AdOp::ActivationElu | AdOp::ActivationMish
                | AdOp::Softmax | AdOp::RmsNorm | AdOp::LayerNorm | AdOp::Rope
                | AdOp::Attn =>
                    return unsupported(span,
                        "second-order (@grad @grad) for silu/elu/mish/softmax/rms_norm/layer_norm/rope/attn is not JIT-lowered yet; use `dmc run`"),

                AdOp::Elem(bop) => {
                    let lv = st.nodes[inputs[0]].fwd;
                    let rv = st.nodes[inputs[1]].fwd;
                    let t = ty.as_tensor().unwrap().clone();
                    self.raw_elem(&bop, lv, rv, &t, span)?
                }

                AdOp::ScalarTensor { op: bop, scalar_is_lhs, scalar, .. } => {
                    let tv = st.nodes[inputs[0]].fwd;
                    let t = ty.as_tensor().unwrap().clone();
                    let (out, _) = self.lower_scalar_tensor_broadcast(
                        &bop, scalar, ScalarKind::F32, tv, &t, span, scalar_is_lhs)?;
                    out
                }

                AdOp::Transpose => {
                    let iv = st.nodes[inputs[0]].fwd;
                    let it = st.nodes[inputs[0]].ty.as_tensor().unwrap().clone();
                    let (out, _) = self.raw_transpose(iv, &it, span)?;
                    out
                }

                AdOp::Matmul => {
                    let lv = st.nodes[inputs[0]].fwd;
                    let rv = st.nodes[inputs[1]].fwd;
                    let lt = st.nodes[inputs[0]].ty.as_tensor().unwrap().clone();
                    let rt = st.nodes[inputs[1]].ty.as_tensor().unwrap().clone();
                    let (out, _) = self.lower_matmul(lv, &lt, rv, &rt, span)?;
                    out
                }

                AdOp::Sum => {
                    let iv = st.nodes[inputs[0]].fwd;
                    let it = st.nodes[inputs[0]].ty.as_tensor().unwrap().clone();
                    self.fused_sum(iv, it.nelems())
                }

                AdOp::Mean => {
                    let iv = st.nodes[inputs[0]].fwd;
                    let it = st.nodes[inputs[0]].ty.as_tensor().unwrap().clone();
                    let total = self.fused_sum(iv, it.nelems());
                    let n = self.builder.ins().f32const(it.nelems() as f32);
                    self.builder.ins().fdiv(total, n)
                }

                AdOp::ScalarBin(bop) => {
                    let lv = st.nodes[inputs[0]].fwd;
                    let rv = st.nodes[inputs[1]].fwd;
                    match bop {
                        BinOp::Add => self.builder.ins().fadd(lv, rv),
                        BinOp::Sub => self.builder.ins().fsub(lv, rv),
                        BinOp::Mul => self.builder.ins().fmul(lv, rv),
                        BinOp::Div => self.builder.ins().fdiv(lv, rv),
                        _ => return err(span, "unsupported ScalarBin in tape forward eval"),
                    }
                }

                AdOp::Broadcast { ref ty } => {
                    let sv = st.nodes[inputs[0]].fwd;
                    let ty = ty.clone();
                    self.broadcast_scalar_to_tensor(sv, &ty)
                }

                AdOp::GeluFirstDeriv => {
                    // Forward value for Phase-2 tape: gelu'(x) elementwise.
                    // This allows emit_backward to differentiate through it and
                    // produce gelu''(x) as the second-order gradient.
                    let iv = st.nodes[inputs[0]].fwd;
                    let t = ty.as_tensor().unwrap().clone();
                    self.tensor_gelu_first_deriv(iv, &t)
                }

                AdOp::Relu
                | AdOp::ActivationRelu
                | AdOp::ActivationTanh
                | AdOp::ActivationGelu
                | AdOp::ActivationSigmoid => {
                    // Activation nodes only appear in Phase-1 (indices < start)
                    // and are skipped above. They should never reach here.
                    return err(span, "activation node encountered in Phase-2 tape eval (internal error)");
                }
            };

            st.nodes[id].fwd = fwd_val;
        }
        Ok(())
    }

    /// Raw elementwise on two same-shape f32 tensors; returns fresh ptr.
    fn raw_elem(&mut self, op: &BinOp, l: Value, r: Value, t: &TensorTy, span: &Span)
        -> Result<Value, JitError>
    {
        let (out, _) = self.lower_elementwise(op, l, t, r, t, span)?;
        Ok(out)
    }

    /// out[i] = ptr[i] * c (compile-time constant scale). Returns fresh.
    fn tensor_scale_const(&mut self, ptr: Value, c: f32, t: &TensorTy) -> Value {
        let cv = self.builder.ins().f32const(c);
        self.tensor_scale_value(ptr, cv, t)
    }

    /// out[i] = ptr[i] * s (runtime scalar). Returns fresh.
    fn tensor_scale_value(&mut self, ptr: Value, s: Value, t: &TensorTy) -> Value {
        let out = self.forge_alloc(t.nbytes());
        let n = t.nelems();
        let zero = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, 0);
        let one = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, 1);
        let cap = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, n);
        let eb = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, 4);
        let h = self.builder.create_block();
        let bd = self.builder.create_block();
        let ex = self.builder.create_block();
        self.builder.append_block_param(h, cl::I64);
        self.jump(h, &[zero]);
        self.enter(h);
        let i = self.builder.block_params(h)[0];
        let c = self.builder.ins().icmp(IntCC::SignedLessThan, i, cap);
        self.brif(c, bd, ex);
        self.enter(bd);
        let off = self.builder.ins().imul(i, eb);
        let v = self.tensor_load_elem(ptr, off, ScalarKind::F32);
        let scaled = self.builder.ins().fmul(v, s);
        self.tensor_store_elem(out, off, scaled);
        let inext = self.builder.ins().iadd(i, one);
        self.jump(h, &[inext]);
        self.builder.seal_block(bd);
        self.builder.seal_block(h);
        self.enter(ex);
        self.builder.seal_block(ex);
        out
    }

    /// out[i] = s (broadcast a scalar across a fresh tensor). Returns fresh.
    fn broadcast_scalar_to_tensor(&mut self, s: Value, t: &TensorTy) -> Value {
        let out = self.forge_alloc(t.nbytes());
        let n = t.nelems();
        let zero = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, 0);
        let one = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, 1);
        let cap = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, n);
        let eb = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, 4);
        let h = self.builder.create_block();
        let bd = self.builder.create_block();
        let ex = self.builder.create_block();
        self.builder.append_block_param(h, cl::I64);
        self.jump(h, &[zero]);
        self.enter(h);
        let i = self.builder.block_params(h)[0];
        let c = self.builder.ins().icmp(IntCC::SignedLessThan, i, cap);
        self.brif(c, bd, ex);
        self.enter(bd);
        let off = self.builder.ins().imul(i, eb);
        self.tensor_store_elem(out, off, s);
        let inext = self.builder.ins().iadd(i, one);
        self.jump(h, &[inext]);
        self.builder.seal_block(bd);
        self.builder.seal_block(h);
        self.enter(ex);
        self.builder.seal_block(ex);
        out
    }

    /// dst[i] += src[i], in place over a same-shape f32 tensor.
    fn tensor_add_inplace(&mut self, dst: Value, src: Value, t: &TensorTy) {
        let n = t.nelems();
        let zero = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, 0);
