        let one = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, 1);
        let cap = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, n);
        let eb = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, 4);
        let h = self.builder.create_block();
        let bd = self.builder.create_block();
        let ex = self.builder.create_block();
        self.builder.append_block_param(h, cl::I64);
        self.jump(h, &[zero]);
        self.enter(h);
        let i = self.builder.block_params(h)[0];
        let c = self.builder.ins().icmp(IntCC::SignedLessThan, i, cap);
        self.brif(c, bd, ex);
        self.enter(bd);
        let off = self.builder.ins().imul(i, eb);
        let d = self.tensor_load_elem(dst, off, ScalarKind::F32);
        let s = self.tensor_load_elem(src, off, ScalarKind::F32);
        let sum = self.builder.ins().fadd(d, s);
        self.tensor_store_elem(dst, off, sum);
        let inext = self.builder.ins().iadd(i, one);
        self.jump(h, &[inext]);
        self.builder.seal_block(bd);
        self.builder.seal_block(h);
        self.enter(ex);
        self.builder.seal_block(ex);
    }

    /// 1.0 / s as a fresh f32 Value.
    fn recip_scalar(&mut self, s: Value) -> Value {
        let one = self.builder.ins().f32const(1.0_f32);
        self.builder.ins().fdiv(one, s)
    }

    fn lower_transpose(
        &mut self,
        base: &Expr,
        span: &Span,
    ) -> Result<(Value, TyKind), JitError> {
        let (ptr, ty) = self.lower_expr(base)?;
        // #324: transposing a bf16 weight (the tied lm-head `embed_tokens'`) —
        // transpose at native 2-byte width and keep it a Bf16Tensor so the
        // single biggest matmul (`h @ embed_tokens'`, one per decode token)
        // feeds the bf16-direct kernel rather than materializing a 2× f32 copy.
        if let TyKind::Bf16Tensor(bt) = &ty {
            return self.bf16_transpose(ptr, &bt.clone(), span);
        }
        let t = ty.as_tensor().ok_or_else(|| JitError {
            msg: format!("transpose `'` requires a tensor, got `{}`", ty.render()),
            line: span.line, col: span.col,
        })?.clone();
        let (out_ptr, out_ty) = self.raw_transpose(ptr, &t, span)?;
        Ok((out_ptr, TyKind::Tensor(out_ty)))
    }

    /// #324: transpose a bf16 weight at native 2-byte width, yielding a
    /// `Bf16Tensor` with swapped shape (no f32 upconvert). A rank-1 transpose is
    /// a byte copy; rank-2 calls the native cache-blocked kernel. The result
    /// flows into the bf16-direct matmul, so the tied lm-head keeps the
    /// bandwidth win instead of upconverting to a 2× f32 buffer first.
    fn bf16_transpose(
        &mut self,
        ptr: Value,
        bt: &Bf16TensorTy,
        span: &Span,
    ) -> Result<(Value, TyKind), JitError> {
        match bt.shape.len() {
            1 => {
                // Transpose of a vector is a no-op on layout — copy the bytes
                // so the result doesn't alias the source weight.
                let dst = self.forge_alloc(bt.nbytes());
                self.emit_memcpy_loop(dst, ptr, bt.nelems(), 2);
                Ok((dst, TyKind::Bf16Tensor(bt.clone())))
            }
            2 => {
                let m = bt.shape[0];
                let n = bt.shape[1];
                let entry = self.fns.get("__dmc_bf16_transpose_2d")
                    .expect("__dmc_bf16_transpose_2d not registered").clone();
                let func_ref = self.module.declare_func_in_func(entry.id, self.builder.func);
                let mv = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, m);
                let nv = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, n);
                let call = self.builder.ins().call(func_ref, &[ptr, mv, nv]);
                let out_ptr = self.builder.inst_results(call)[0];
                Ok((out_ptr, TyKind::Bf16Tensor(Bf16TensorTy { shape: vec![n, m] })))
            }
            r => err(span, format!(
                "bf16 transpose `'` only supports rank 1 or 2, got rank {}", r)),
        }
    }

    /// Transpose kernel operating on a data pointer + shape. Returns the
    /// fresh output pointer and its shape. Shared by `lower_transpose` and
    /// the `@grad` backward pass.
    fn raw_transpose(
        &mut self,
        ptr: Value,
        t: &TensorTy,
        span: &Span,
    ) -> Result<(Value, TensorTy), JitError> {
        if t.elem != ScalarKind::F32 {
            return err(span, "transpose `'` is f32-only");
        }
        match t.rank() {
            1 => {
                let out_ptr = self.forge_alloc(t.nbytes());
                let n = t.nelems();
                self.emit_memcpy_loop(out_ptr, ptr, n, t.elem_bytes());
                Ok((out_ptr, t.clone()))
            }
            2 => {
                let m = t.shape[0];
                let n = t.shape[1];
                let out_ty = TensorTy { elem: t.elem, shape: vec![n, m] };
                let out_ptr = self.forge_alloc(out_ty.nbytes());

                // for i in 0..m: for j in 0..n: out[j, i] = src[i, j]
                let eb_v = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, t.elem_bytes());
                let m_v = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, m);
                let n_v = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, n);
                let one = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, 1);
                let zero = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, 0);

                let i_hdr = self.builder.create_block();
                let i_body = self.builder.create_block();
                let i_exit = self.builder.create_block();
                self.builder.append_block_param(i_hdr, cl::I64);
                self.jump(i_hdr, &[zero]);

                self.enter(i_hdr);
                let i = self.builder.block_params(i_hdr)[0];
                let cont_i = self.builder.ins().icmp(IntCC::SignedLessThan, i, m_v);
                self.brif(cont_i, i_body, i_exit);

                self.enter(i_body);
                let j_hdr = self.builder.create_block();
                let j_body = self.builder.create_block();
                let j_exit = self.builder.create_block();
                self.builder.append_block_param(j_hdr, cl::I64);
                self.jump(j_hdr, &[zero]);

                self.enter(j_hdr);
                let j = self.builder.block_params(j_hdr)[0];
                let cont_j = self.builder.ins().icmp(IntCC::SignedLessThan, j, n_v);
                self.brif(cont_j, j_body, j_exit);

                self.enter(j_body);
                // src flat = i*n + j
                let i_n = self.builder.ins().imul(i, n_v);
                let src_flat = self.builder.ins().iadd(i_n, j);
                let src_off = self.builder.ins().imul(src_flat, eb_v);
                let v = self.tensor_load_elem(ptr, src_off, t.elem);
                // dst flat = j*m + i
                let j_m = self.builder.ins().imul(j, m_v);
                let dst_flat = self.builder.ins().iadd(j_m, i);
                let dst_off = self.builder.ins().imul(dst_flat, eb_v);
                self.tensor_store_elem(out_ptr, dst_off, v);
                let jnext = self.builder.ins().iadd(j, one);
                self.jump(j_hdr, &[jnext]);
                self.builder.seal_block(j_body);
                self.builder.seal_block(j_hdr);

                self.enter(j_exit);
                let inext = self.builder.ins().iadd(i, one);
                self.jump(i_hdr, &[inext]);
                self.builder.seal_block(j_exit);
                self.builder.seal_block(i_body);
                self.builder.seal_block(i_hdr);

                self.enter(i_exit);
                self.builder.seal_block(i_exit);

                Ok((out_ptr, out_ty))
            }
            4 => {
                // Swap last two axes: [B, H, M, N] -> [B, H, N, M].
                // Memory layout: src flat index = b*(H*M*N) + h*(M*N) + i*N + j
                //                dst flat index = b*(H*N*M) + h*(N*M) + j*M + i
                let b_dim = t.shape[0];
                let h_dim = t.shape[1];
                let m_dim = t.shape[2];
                let n_dim = t.shape[3];
                let out_ty = TensorTy { elem: t.elem, shape: vec![b_dim, h_dim, n_dim, m_dim] };
                let out_ptr = self.forge_alloc(out_ty.nbytes());

                let eb    = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, t.elem_bytes());
                let one   = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, 1);
                let zero  = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, 0);
                let b_v   = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, b_dim);
                let h_v   = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, h_dim);
                let m_v   = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, m_dim);
                let n_v   = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, n_dim);
                let mn_v  = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, m_dim * n_dim);
                let hmn_v = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, h_dim * m_dim * n_dim);

                // for b in 0..B
                let b_hdr  = self.builder.create_block();
                let b_body = self.builder.create_block();
                let b_exit = self.builder.create_block();
                self.builder.append_block_param(b_hdr, cl::I64);
                self.jump(b_hdr, &[zero]);
                self.enter(b_hdr);
                let b = self.builder.block_params(b_hdr)[0];
                let cb = self.builder.ins().icmp(IntCC::SignedLessThan, b, b_v);
                self.brif(cb, b_body, b_exit);

                // for h in 0..H
                self.enter(b_body);
                let h_hdr  = self.builder.create_block();
                let h_body = self.builder.create_block();
                let h_exit = self.builder.create_block();
                self.builder.append_block_param(h_hdr, cl::I64);
                self.jump(h_hdr, &[zero]);
                self.enter(h_hdr);
                let h = self.builder.block_params(h_hdr)[0];
                let ch = self.builder.ins().icmp(IntCC::SignedLessThan, h, h_v);
                self.brif(ch, h_body, h_exit);

                // for i in 0..M
                self.enter(h_body);
                let i_hdr  = self.builder.create_block();
                let i_body = self.builder.create_block();
                let i_exit = self.builder.create_block();
                self.builder.append_block_param(i_hdr, cl::I64);
                self.jump(i_hdr, &[zero]);
                self.enter(i_hdr);
                let i = self.builder.block_params(i_hdr)[0];
                let ci = self.builder.ins().icmp(IntCC::SignedLessThan, i, m_v);
                self.brif(ci, i_body, i_exit);

                // for j in 0..N
                self.enter(i_body);
                let j_hdr  = self.builder.create_block();
                let j_body = self.builder.create_block();
                let j_exit = self.builder.create_block();
                self.builder.append_block_param(j_hdr, cl::I64);
                self.jump(j_hdr, &[zero]);
                self.enter(j_hdr);
                let j = self.builder.block_params(j_hdr)[0];
                let cj = self.builder.ins().icmp(IntCC::SignedLessThan, j, n_v);
                self.brif(cj, j_body, j_exit);

                self.enter(j_body);
                // src[b,h,i,j] = b*(H*M*N) + h*(M*N) + i*N + j
                let bhmn  = self.builder.ins().imul(b, hmn_v);
                let hmn   = self.builder.ins().imul(h, mn_v);
                let in_   = self.builder.ins().imul(i, n_v);
                let src_f = self.builder.ins().iadd(bhmn, hmn);
                let src_f = self.builder.ins().iadd(src_f, in_);
                let src_f = self.builder.ins().iadd(src_f, j);
                let src_o = self.builder.ins().imul(src_f, eb);
                let v     = self.tensor_load_elem(ptr, src_o, t.elem);
                // dst[b,h,j,i] = b*(H*N*M) + h*(N*M) + j*M + i  (same total, different strides)
                let nm_v  = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, n_dim * m_dim);
                let hx    = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, h_dim * n_dim * m_dim);
                let bx    = self.builder.ins().imul(b, hx);
                let hxv   = self.builder.ins().imul(h, nm_v);
                let jm    = self.builder.ins().imul(j, m_v);
                let dst_f = self.builder.ins().iadd(bx, hxv);
                let dst_f = self.builder.ins().iadd(dst_f, jm);
                let dst_f = self.builder.ins().iadd(dst_f, i);
                let dst_o = self.builder.ins().imul(dst_f, eb);
                self.tensor_store_elem(out_ptr, dst_o, v);

                let jnext = self.builder.ins().iadd(j, one);
                self.jump(j_hdr, &[jnext]);
                self.builder.seal_block(j_body);
                self.builder.seal_block(j_hdr);

                self.enter(j_exit);
                let inext = self.builder.ins().iadd(i, one);
                self.jump(i_hdr, &[inext]);
                self.builder.seal_block(j_exit);
                self.builder.seal_block(i_body);
                self.builder.seal_block(i_hdr);

                self.enter(i_exit);
                let hnext = self.builder.ins().iadd(h, one);
                self.jump(h_hdr, &[hnext]);
                self.builder.seal_block(i_exit);
                self.builder.seal_block(h_body);
                self.builder.seal_block(h_hdr);

                self.enter(h_exit);
                let bnext = self.builder.ins().iadd(b, one);
                self.jump(b_hdr, &[bnext]);
                self.builder.seal_block(h_exit);
                self.builder.seal_block(b_body);
                self.builder.seal_block(b_hdr);

                self.enter(b_exit);
                self.builder.seal_block(b_exit);

                Ok((out_ptr, out_ty))
            }
            r => err(span, format!(
                "transpose `'` supports 1D, 2D, and 4D tensors; got rank {}", r,
            )),
        }
    }

    /// Emit a tight loop copying `n` f32 elements from `src` to `dst`.
    fn emit_memcpy_loop(&mut self, dst: Value, src: Value, n: i64, elem_bytes: i64) {
        let zero = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, 0);
        let one = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, 1);
        let cap = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, n);
        let eb = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, elem_bytes);

        let hdr = self.builder.create_block();
        let body = self.builder.create_block();
        let exit = self.builder.create_block();
        self.builder.append_block_param(hdr, cl::I64);
        self.jump(hdr, &[zero]);

        self.enter(hdr);
        let i = self.builder.block_params(hdr)[0];
        let cont = self.builder.ins().icmp(IntCC::SignedLessThan, i, cap);
        self.brif(cont, body, exit);

        self.enter(body);
        let off = self.builder.ins().imul(i, eb);
        let v = self.tensor_load_elem(src, off, ScalarKind::F32);
        self.tensor_store_elem(dst, off, v);
        let inext = self.builder.ins().iadd(i, one);
        self.jump(hdr, &[inext]);
        self.builder.seal_block(body);
        self.builder.seal_block(hdr);

        self.enter(exit);
        self.builder.seal_block(exit);
    }

    fn lower_matmul(
        &mut self,
        l: Value, lt: &TensorTy,
        r: Value, rt: &TensorTy,
        span: &Span,
    ) -> Result<(Value, TyKind), JitError> {
        if lt.elem != ScalarKind::F32 || rt.elem != ScalarKind::F32 {
            return err(span, "matmul `@` is f32-only");
        }
        match (lt.rank(), rt.rank()) {
            (2, 2) => {
                let m = lt.shape[0];
                let k = lt.shape[1];
                if k != rt.shape[0] {
                    return err(span, format!(
                        "matmul inner dim mismatch: lhs [_, {}] vs rhs [{}, _]", k, rt.shape[0]));
                }
                let n = rt.shape[1];
                let out_ty = TensorTy { elem: ScalarKind::F32, shape: vec![m, n] };
                let out_ptr = self.forge_alloc(out_ty.nbytes());
                self.emit_2d_matmul_at(l, r, out_ptr, m, k, n);
                Ok((out_ptr, TyKind::Tensor(out_ty)))
            }
            (4, 4) => {
                let b = lt.shape[0];
                let h = lt.shape[1];
                let m = lt.shape[2];
                let k = lt.shape[3];
                if lt.shape[0] != rt.shape[0] || lt.shape[1] != rt.shape[1] {
                    return err(span, "batched matmul: batch dims [B,H] must match");
                }
                if k != rt.shape[2] {
                    return err(span, format!(
                        "batched matmul inner dim mismatch: lhs [_,_,_,{}] vs rhs [_,_,{},_]",
                        k, rt.shape[2]));
                }
                let n = rt.shape[3];
                let out_ty = TensorTy { elem: ScalarKind::F32, shape: vec![b, h, m, n] };
                let out_ptr = self.forge_alloc(out_ty.nbytes());

                // Strides (in bytes): l: B*H*M*K, H*M*K, M*K, K
                //                     r: B*H*K*N, H*K*N, K*N, N
                //                     o: B*H*M*N, H*M*N, M*N, N
                let eb4    = 4i64;
                let l_slice = m * k * eb4;
                let r_slice = k * n * eb4;
                let o_slice = m * n * eb4;
                let l_hstride = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, l_slice);
                let r_hstride = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, r_slice);
                let o_hstride = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, o_slice);
                let l_bstride = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, h * l_slice);
                let r_bstride = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, h * r_slice);
                let o_bstride = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, h * o_slice);

                let zero  = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, 0);
                let one   = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, 1);
                let b_v   = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, b);
                let h_v   = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, h);

                // for bi in 0..B
                let bi_hdr  = self.builder.create_block();
                let bi_body = self.builder.create_block();
                let bi_exit = self.builder.create_block();
                self.builder.append_block_param(bi_hdr, cl::I64);
                self.jump(bi_hdr, &[zero]);
                self.enter(bi_hdr);
                let bi = self.builder.block_params(bi_hdr)[0];
                let cb = self.builder.ins().icmp(IntCC::SignedLessThan, bi, b_v);
                self.brif(cb, bi_body, bi_exit);

                self.enter(bi_body);
                let lb_off  = self.builder.ins().imul(bi, l_bstride);
                let rb_off  = self.builder.ins().imul(bi, r_bstride);
                let ob_off  = self.builder.ins().imul(bi, o_bstride);
                let l_batch = self.builder.ins().iadd(l, lb_off);
                let r_batch = self.builder.ins().iadd(r, rb_off);
                let o_batch = self.builder.ins().iadd(out_ptr, ob_off);

                // for hi in 0..H
                let hi_hdr  = self.builder.create_block();
                let hi_body = self.builder.create_block();
                let hi_exit = self.builder.create_block();
                self.builder.append_block_param(hi_hdr, cl::I64);
                self.jump(hi_hdr, &[zero]);
                self.enter(hi_hdr);
                let hi = self.builder.block_params(hi_hdr)[0];
                let ch = self.builder.ins().icmp(IntCC::SignedLessThan, hi, h_v);
                self.brif(ch, hi_body, hi_exit);

                self.enter(hi_body);
                let lh_off = self.builder.ins().imul(hi, l_hstride);
                let rh_off = self.builder.ins().imul(hi, r_hstride);
                let oh_off = self.builder.ins().imul(hi, o_hstride);
                let l_head  = self.builder.ins().iadd(l_batch, lh_off);
                let r_head  = self.builder.ins().iadd(r_batch, rh_off);
                let o_head  = self.builder.ins().iadd(o_batch, oh_off);

                self.emit_2d_matmul_at(l_head, r_head, o_head, m, k, n);

                let hinext = self.builder.ins().iadd(hi, one);
                self.jump(hi_hdr, &[hinext]);
                self.builder.seal_block(hi_body);
                self.builder.seal_block(hi_hdr);

                self.enter(hi_exit);
                let binext = self.builder.ins().iadd(bi, one);
                self.jump(bi_hdr, &[binext]);
                self.builder.seal_block(hi_exit);
                self.builder.seal_block(bi_body);
                self.builder.seal_block(bi_hdr);

                self.enter(bi_exit);
                self.builder.seal_block(bi_exit);

                Ok((out_ptr, TyKind::Tensor(out_ty)))
            }
            // #276: general batched matmul — any ranks >= 2, with numpy-style
            // broadcasting of the leading batch dims (the attention projections:
            // `[B,1,S,K] @ [H,K,N] -> [B,H,S,N]`).
            _ => self.lower_matmul_general(l, lt, r, &rt.shape, false, span),
        }
    }

    /// #276: batched matmul with leading-dim broadcasting. lhs `[..L, M, K]`,
    /// rhs `[..R, K, N]`; the batch dims `..L`/`..R` broadcast (right-aligned,
    /// numpy rules) to `..O`, and each batch position is a 2-D `[M,K]@[K,N]`.
    /// Batched matmul (broadcasting). `rhs_bf16` selects a 2-byte bf16 weight
    /// RHS (read via the bf16-direct kernel) vs the regular f32 RHS; the RHS
    /// shape is passed explicitly so both a `TensorTy` (f32) and a `Bf16TensorTy`
    /// can drive it. LHS and output are always f32. (#324)
    fn lower_matmul_general(
        &mut self, l: Value, lt: &TensorTy, r: Value, rt_shape: &[i64], rhs_bf16: bool, span: &Span,
    ) -> Result<(Value, TyKind), JitError> {
        let rt_rank = rt_shape.len();
        if lt.rank() < 2 || rt_rank < 2 {
            return err(span, "matmul `@` needs rank >= 2 on both sides");
        }
        let (m, k) = (lt.shape[lt.rank() - 2], lt.shape[lt.rank() - 1]);
        let (k2, n) = (rt_shape[rt_rank - 2], rt_shape[rt_rank - 1]);
        if k != k2 {
            return err(span, format!("matmul inner dim mismatch: lhs [.., {}] vs rhs [{}, ..]", k, k2));
        }
        let lb = &lt.shape[..lt.rank() - 2];
        let rb = &rt_shape[..rt_rank - 2];
        // Broadcast batch shapes, right-aligned.
        let ob_rank = lb.len().max(rb.len());
        let mut ob: Vec<i64> = Vec::with_capacity(ob_rank);
        for i in 0..ob_rank {
            let ld = lb.get(lb.len().wrapping_sub(ob_rank - i)).copied().unwrap_or(1);
            let rd = rb.get(rb.len().wrapping_sub(ob_rank - i)).copied().unwrap_or(1);
            if ld != rd && ld != 1 && rd != 1 {
                return err(span, format!("matmul batch dims not broadcastable: {} vs {}", ld, rd));
            }
            ob.push(ld.max(rd));
        }
        let batch_total: i64 = ob.iter().product();
        let mut out_shape = ob.clone();
        out_shape.push(m);
        out_shape.push(n);
        let out_ty = TensorTy { elem: ScalarKind::F32, shape: out_shape };
        let out_ptr = self.forge_alloc(out_ty.nbytes());

        let (lmat, rmat, omat) = (m * k, k * n, m * n); // elements per matrix
        let ob_strides = row_major_strides(&ob);
        let lb_strides = row_major_strides(lb);
        let rb_strides = row_major_strides(rb);
        let four = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, 4);
        // #324: the RHS weight matrix is 2 bytes/elem when bf16, 4 when f32.
        let rhs_eb = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, if rhs_bf16 { 2 } else { 4 });
        let zero = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, 0);
        let one = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, 1);
        let total_c = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, batch_total);

        let hdr = self.builder.create_block();
        let body = self.builder.create_block();
        let exit = self.builder.create_block();
        self.builder.append_block_param(hdr, cl::I64);
        self.jump(hdr, &[zero]);
        self.enter(hdr);
        let p = self.builder.block_params(hdr)[0];
        let cont = self.builder.ins().icmp(IntCC::SignedLessThan, p, total_c);
        self.brif(cont, body, exit);
        self.builder.seal_block(exit);

        self.enter(body);
        // map batch position p -> flat lhs / rhs batch indices (broadcasting).
        let mut lflat = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, 0);
        let mut rflat = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, 0);
        for ax in 0..ob_rank {
            let os = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, ob_strides[ax]);
            let div = self.builder.ins().udiv(p, os);
            let ext = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, ob[ax]);
            let coord = self.builder.ins().urem(div, ext);
            // lhs axis (right-aligned); contributes only if its dim > 1.
            if ax + lb.len() >= ob_rank {
                let la = ax + lb.len() - ob_rank;
                if lb[la] > 1 {
                    let st = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, lb_strides[la]);
                    let t = self.builder.ins().imul(coord, st);
                    lflat = self.builder.ins().iadd(lflat, t);
                }
            }
            if ax + rb.len() >= ob_rank {
                let ra = ax + rb.len() - ob_rank;
                if rb[ra] > 1 {
                    let st = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, rb_strides[ra]);
                    let t = self.builder.ins().imul(coord, st);
                    rflat = self.builder.ins().iadd(rflat, t);
                }
            }
        }
        let lmat_c = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, lmat);
        let rmat_c = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, rmat);
        let omat_c = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, omat);
        let lo = self.builder.ins().imul(lflat, lmat_c);
        let ro = self.builder.ins().imul(rflat, rmat_c);
        let oo = self.builder.ins().imul(p, omat_c);
        let lb_off = self.builder.ins().imul(lo, four);
        let rb_off = self.builder.ins().imul(ro, rhs_eb);
        let ob_off = self.builder.ins().imul(oo, four);
        let lp = self.builder.ins().iadd(l, lb_off);
        let rp = self.builder.ins().iadd(r, rb_off);
        let op = self.builder.ins().iadd(out_ptr, ob_off);
        if rhs_bf16 {
            self.emit_2d_matmul_bf16_at(lp, rp, op, m, k, n);
        } else {
            self.emit_2d_matmul_at(lp, rp, op, m, k, n);
        }
        let pnext = self.builder.ins().iadd(p, one);
        self.jump(hdr, &[pnext]);
        self.builder.seal_block(body);
        self.builder.seal_block(hdr);

        self.enter(exit);
        Ok((out_ptr, TyKind::Tensor(out_ty)))
    }

    /// Packed trit matmul: `x @ w` where `x: Tensor[f32, [B, K]]` and
    /// `w: TritTensor[K, N]`. Emits a POPCNT-based integer accumulation.
    fn lower_trit_matmul(
        &mut self,
        x_ptr: Value, xt: &TensorTy,
        w_ptr: Value, wt: &TritTensorTy,
        span: &Span,
    ) -> Result<(Value, TyKind), JitError> {
        if xt.rank() != 2 {
            return err(span, "trit matmul: activation x must be 2-D [B, K]");
        }
        let (b, k) = (xt.shape[0], xt.shape[1]);
        if k != wt.k {
            return err(span, format!(
                "trit matmul inner-dim mismatch: x has K={} but w has K={}", k, wt.k));
        }
        let n = wt.n;
        let n_words = wt.n_words();
        let out_ty = TensorTy { elem: ScalarKind::F32, shape: vec![b, n] };
        let out_ptr = self.forge_alloc(out_ty.nbytes());
        self.emit_trit_matmul_kernel(x_ptr, w_ptr, out_ptr, b, k, n, n_words);
        Ok((out_ptr, TyKind::Tensor(out_ty)))
    }

    /// Emit the POPCNT matmul inner loops.
    /// Layout assumed for w: [pos_bits: u64*n_words*N][neg_bits: u64*n_words*N]
    /// column n pos-words at byte offset n*n_words*8, neg-words at (N+n)*n_words*8.
    /// x is a row-major f32[B, K] tensor (standard forge layout).
    fn emit_trit_matmul_kernel(
        &mut self,
        x: Value, w: Value, out: Value,
        b: i64, k: i64, n: i64, n_words: i64,
    ) {
        let zero      = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, 0);
        let one       = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, 1);
        let sixty4    = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, 64);
        let b_c       = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, b);
        let n_c       = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, n);
        let k_c       = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, k);
        let nw_c      = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, n_words);
        let neg_base  = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, n * n_words * 8);
        let eb4       = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, 4);
        let eb8       = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, 8);
        let tail_bits = k % 64;
        let tail_mask_val = if tail_bits == 0 { !0u64 } else { (1u64 << tail_bits) - 1 };
        let tail_mask = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, tail_mask_val as i64);
        let last_word = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, n_words - 1);

        // Stack slot: packed sign bits for one row of x, n_words * 8 bytes.
        let slot = self.builder.create_sized_stack_slot(
            StackSlotData::new(StackSlotKind::ExplicitSlot, (n_words * 8) as u32, 3),
        );

        // ── outer loop: for bi in 0..B ──────────────────────────────────────
        let bi_hdr  = self.builder.create_block();
        let bi_body = self.builder.create_block();
        let bi_exit = self.builder.create_block();
        self.builder.append_block_param(bi_hdr, cl::I64);
        self.jump(bi_hdr, &[zero]);
        self.enter(bi_hdr);
        let bi = self.builder.block_params(bi_hdr)[0];
        let cbi = self.builder.ins().icmp(IntCC::SignedLessThan, bi, b_c);
        self.brif(cbi, bi_body, bi_exit);

        // ── pack row bi: for kw in 0..n_words ───────────────────────────────
        self.enter(bi_body);
        let pack_hdr  = self.builder.create_block();
        let pack_body = self.builder.create_block();
        let pack_exit = self.builder.create_block();
        self.builder.append_block_param(pack_hdr, cl::I64);
        self.jump(pack_hdr, &[zero]);
        self.enter(pack_hdr);
        let kw = self.builder.block_params(pack_hdr)[0];
        let cpk = self.builder.ins().icmp(IntCC::SignedLessThan, kw, nw_c);
        self.brif(cpk, pack_body, pack_exit);

        self.enter(pack_body);
        // base elem index for this word: bi*K + kw*64
        let bik   = self.builder.ins().imul(bi, k_c);
        let kw64  = self.builder.ins().imul(kw, sixty4);
        let base  = self.builder.ins().iadd(bik, kw64);

        // Inner loop: for bit in 0..64, pack f32 sign bits into u64
        let bit_hdr  = self.builder.create_block();
        let bit_body = self.builder.create_block();
        let bit_exit = self.builder.create_block();
        self.builder.append_block_param(bit_hdr, cl::I64); // bit counter
        self.builder.append_block_param(bit_hdr, cl::I64); // word accumulator
        self.builder.append_block_param(bit_exit, cl::I64); // final word
        self.jump(bit_hdr, &[zero, zero]);
        self.enter(bit_hdr);
        let bit    = self.builder.block_params(bit_hdr)[0];
        let wrd    = self.builder.block_params(bit_hdr)[1];
        let cbit   = self.builder.ins().icmp(IntCC::SignedLessThan, bit, sixty4);
        self.builder.ins().brif(cbit, bit_body, &[], bit_exit, &[wrd.into()]);
        self.block_filled = true;

        self.enter(bit_body);
        let elem_idx   = self.builder.ins().iadd(base, bit);
        // `in_bounds` checks whether column kw*64+bit is within [0, K).
        // We must NOT compare elem_idx (= bi*K + kw*64 + bit) against k_c,
        // because that would always be false for rows bi > 0 even when
        // the column is valid. Use kw64 + bit instead.
        let col_offset = self.builder.ins().iadd(kw64, bit);
        let in_bounds  = self.builder.ins().icmp(IntCC::SignedLessThan, col_offset, k_c);
        let elem_byte  = self.builder.ins().imul(elem_idx, eb4);
        let xf         = self.tensor_load_elem(x, elem_byte, ScalarKind::F32);
        let zerof      = self.builder.ins().f32const(0.0_f32);
        let positive   = self.builder.ins().fcmp(FloatCC::GreaterThan, xf, zerof);
        let bit_v      = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, 1);
        let shifted    = self.builder.ins().ishl(bit_v, bit);
        let all_ones   = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, !0i64);
        // contrib = shifted if (positive && in_bounds), else 0
        let pos_mask    = self.builder.ins().select(positive, all_ones, zero);
        let bounds_mask = self.builder.ins().select(in_bounds, all_ones, zero);
        let combined   = self.builder.ins().band(pos_mask, bounds_mask);
        let contrib    = self.builder.ins().band(shifted, combined);
        let wrd2       = self.builder.ins().bor(wrd, contrib);
        let bitnext    = self.builder.ins().iadd(bit, one);
        self.jump(bit_hdr, &[bitnext, wrd2]);
        self.builder.seal_block(bit_body);
        self.builder.seal_block(bit_hdr);

        self.enter(bit_exit);
        let packed_word_raw = self.builder.block_params(bit_exit)[0];
        // apply tail mask to last word
        let is_last = self.builder.ins().icmp(IntCC::Equal, kw, last_word);
        let masked_word = if tail_bits != 0 {
            let tail_m = self.builder.ins().band(packed_word_raw, tail_mask);
            self.builder.ins().select(is_last, tail_m, packed_word_raw)
        } else {
            packed_word_raw
        };
        // store to stack slot
        let flags = cranelift::codegen::ir::MemFlagsData::new();
        let slot_off = self.builder.ins().imul(kw, eb8);
        let slot_ptr = self.builder.ins().stack_addr(cl::I64, slot, 0);
        let slot_ea  = self.builder.ins().iadd(slot_ptr, slot_off);
        self.builder.ins().store(flags, masked_word, slot_ea, 0);
        let kwnext = self.builder.ins().iadd(kw, one);
        self.jump(pack_hdr, &[kwnext]);
        self.builder.seal_block(bit_exit);
        self.builder.seal_block(pack_body);
        self.builder.seal_block(pack_hdr);

        self.enter(pack_exit);

        // ── output loop: for ni in 0..N ─────────────────────────────────────
        let ni_hdr  = self.builder.create_block();
        let ni_body = self.builder.create_block();
        let ni_exit = self.builder.create_block();
        self.builder.append_block_param(ni_hdr, cl::I64);
        self.jump(ni_hdr, &[zero]);
        self.enter(ni_hdr);
        let ni = self.builder.block_params(ni_hdr)[0];
        let cni = self.builder.ins().icmp(IntCC::SignedLessThan, ni, n_c);
        self.brif(cni, ni_body, ni_exit);

        self.enter(ni_body);
        // inner accumulation loop: for akw in 0..n_words
        let acc_hdr  = self.builder.create_block();
        let acc_body = self.builder.create_block();
        let acc_exit = self.builder.create_block();
        self.builder.append_block_param(acc_hdr, cl::I64); // akw
        self.builder.append_block_param(acc_hdr, cl::I64); // acc
        self.builder.append_block_param(acc_exit, cl::I64); // final acc
        self.jump(acc_hdr, &[zero, zero]);
        self.enter(acc_hdr);
        let akw = self.builder.block_params(acc_hdr)[0];
        let acc = self.builder.block_params(acc_hdr)[1];
        let cak = self.builder.ins().icmp(IntCC::SignedLessThan, akw, nw_c);
        self.builder.ins().brif(cak, acc_body, &[], acc_exit, &[acc.into()]);
        self.block_filled = true;

        self.enter(acc_body);
        // load packed x word from stack slot
        let soff    = self.builder.ins().imul(akw, eb8);
        let sptr    = self.builder.ins().stack_addr(cl::I64, slot, 0);
        let sea     = self.builder.ins().iadd(sptr, soff);
        let xw      = self.builder.ins().load(cl::I64, flags, sea, 0);
        // pos_word: w + ni*n_words*8 + akw*8
        let nw8_c       = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, n_words * 8);
        let ni_pos_base = self.builder.ins().imul(ni, nw8_c);
        let pos_base_ptr = self.builder.ins().iadd(w, ni_pos_base);
        let pos_word_off = self.builder.ins().imul(akw, eb8);
        let pos_ea   = self.builder.ins().iadd(pos_base_ptr, pos_word_off);
        let pos_w    = self.builder.ins().load(cl::I64, flags, pos_ea, 0);
        // neg_word: w + neg_base + ni*n_words*8 + akw*8
        let neg_col_base = self.builder.ins().iadd(w, neg_base);
        let neg_ni_base  = self.builder.ins().iadd(neg_col_base, ni_pos_base);
        let neg_ea   = self.builder.ins().iadd(neg_ni_base, pos_word_off);
        let neg_w    = self.builder.ins().load(cl::I64, flags, neg_ea, 0);
        // popcnt(xw & pos_w) - popcnt(xw & neg_w)
        let pos_and  = self.builder.ins().band(xw, pos_w);
        let neg_and  = self.builder.ins().band(xw, neg_w);
        let pop_pos  = self.builder.ins().popcnt(pos_and);
        let pop_neg  = self.builder.ins().popcnt(neg_and);
        let delta    = self.builder.ins().isub(pop_pos, pop_neg);
        let acc2     = self.builder.ins().iadd(acc, delta);
        let aknext   = self.builder.ins().iadd(akw, one);
        self.jump(acc_hdr, &[aknext, acc2]);
        self.builder.seal_block(acc_body);
        self.builder.seal_block(acc_hdr);

        self.enter(acc_exit);
        let final_acc = self.builder.block_params(acc_exit)[0];
        // convert i64 accumulator to f32
        let fval = self.builder.ins().fcvt_from_sint(cl::F32, final_acc);
        // store to out[bi, ni]
        let bi_n     = self.builder.ins().imul(bi, n_c);
        let out_flat = self.builder.ins().iadd(bi_n, ni);
        let out_off  = self.builder.ins().imul(out_flat, eb4);
        self.tensor_store_elem(out, out_off, fval);
        let ninext = self.builder.ins().iadd(ni, one);
        self.jump(ni_hdr, &[ninext]);
        self.builder.seal_block(acc_exit);
        self.builder.seal_block(ni_body);
        self.builder.seal_block(ni_hdr);

        self.enter(ni_exit);
        let binext = self.builder.ins().iadd(bi, one);
        self.jump(bi_hdr, &[binext]);
        self.builder.seal_block(ni_exit);
        self.builder.seal_block(bi_body);
        self.builder.seal_block(bi_hdr);

        self.enter(bi_exit);
        self.builder.seal_block(bi_exit);
    }

    /// Native KV-cache attention *scores* `q @ k_cache'` (issue #176 part 2,
    /// form 1). The RHS must be a postfix-transpose whose inner expr lowers to
    /// a KV/DynTensor; the transpose of the last two K dims is folded into
    /// indexing rather than materialized. Returns `None` when the RHS is not
    /// such a transpose (the caller then takes the generic dense path).
    /// Result: `DynTensor[B,H,1,len]` (axis 3 = runtime `len`).
    fn try_lower_kv_scores_matmul(
        &mut self,
        lhs: &Expr,
        rhs: &Expr,
        span: &Span,
    ) -> Result<Option<(Value, TyKind)>, JitError> {
        let inner = match rhs {
            Expr::Postfix { expr: inner, op: PostfixOp::Transpose, .. } => inner,
            _ => return Ok(None),
        };
        // Peek the inner type without committing to generic transpose lowering
        // (which only handles dense tensors).
        let (kv_ptr, kdt) = match self.lower_expr(inner)? {
            (p, TyKind::KV(kv)) if kv.elem == ScalarKind::F32 => self.kv_materialize(p, &kv),
            (p, TyKind::DynTensor(dt)) if dt.elem == ScalarKind::F32 => (p, dt),
            // Inner is a dense tensor (or non-f32) — a plain `m @ n'` matmul;
            // re-lower the whole RHS through the generic path.
            _ => return Ok(None),
        };
        let (q_ptr, qk) = self.lower_expr(lhs)?;
        let qt = qk.as_tensor().ok_or_else(|| JitError {
            msg: format!("attention `q @ k_cache'` requires a dense tensor `q`, got `{}`",
                         qk.render()),
            line: span.line, col: span.col,
        })?.clone();
        Ok(Some(self.lower_kv_scores(q_ptr, &qt, kv_ptr, &kdt, span)?))
    }

    /// `q @ k_cache'` — attention scores. `q: Tensor[f32,[B,H,1,D]]` static,
    /// `kdt: DynTensor[B,H,len,D]` (axis 2 runtime). The transpose of the last
    /// two K dims is folded into indexing: we read `kcache[b,h,j,d]` directly.
    /// Result is `DynTensor[B,H,1,len]` with `result[b,h,0,j] =
    /// sum_d q[b,h,0,d] * kcache[b,h,j,d]`.
    fn lower_kv_scores(
        &mut self,
        q_ptr: Value, qt: &TensorTy,
        k_ptr: Value, kdt: &DynTensorTy,
        span: &Span,
    ) -> Result<(Value, TyKind), JitError> {
        if qt.rank() != 4 || kdt.rank() != 4 {
            return err(span, "attention `q @ k_cache'` requires rank-4 [B,H,1,D] operands");
        }
        let (b, h, mq, dq) = (qt.shape[0], qt.shape[1], qt.shape[2], qt.shape[3]);
        if mq != 1 {
            return err(span, format!("attention scores: q axis 2 must be 1, got {}", mq));
        }
        // K static dims: [B,H,?,D]. Axis 2 (len) is the runtime axis.
        let (kb, kh, kd) = (kdt.dims[0], kdt.dims[1], kdt.dims[3]);
        if kb != Some(b) || kh != Some(h) {
            return err(span, "attention scores: q/k batch dims [B,H] must match");
        }
        if kd != Some(dq) {
            return err(span, "attention scores: q/k feature dim D must match");
        }
        if kdt.dims[2].is_some() {
            return err(span, "attention scores: k cache streaming axis (2) must be runtime");
        }

        // len = runtime streaming length of the K cache.
        let len = self.dyn_extent(k_ptr, kdt, 2);
        let k_data = self.dyn_data_ptr(k_ptr, kdt);

        // Output DynTensor [B,H,1,len]: only axis 3 is dynamic.
        let odt = DynTensorTy {
            elem: ScalarKind::F32,
            dims: vec![Some(b), Some(h), Some(1), None],
        };
        let out = self.dyn_alloc(&odt, &[len]);
        let o_data = self.dyn_data_ptr(out, &odt);

        let zero = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, 0);
        let one  = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, 1);
        let d_v  = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, dq);

        // for b in 0..B, h in 0..H (static), j in 0..len (runtime):
        //   acc = 0; for d in 0..D: acc += q[b,h,0,d] * k[b,h,j,d]
        //   out[b,h,0,j] = acc
        for bi in 0..b {
            let bi_v = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, bi);
            for hi in 0..h {
                let hi_v = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, hi);

                // j loop (runtime bound `len`).
                let j_hdr  = self.builder.create_block();
                let j_body = self.builder.create_block();
                let j_exit = self.builder.create_block();
                self.builder.append_block_param(j_hdr, cl::I64);
                self.jump(j_hdr, &[zero]);
                self.enter(j_hdr);
                let j = self.builder.block_params(j_hdr)[0];
                let cj = self.builder.ins().icmp(IntCC::SignedLessThan, j, len);
                self.brif(cj, j_body, j_exit);

                self.enter(j_body);
                // d loop carrying f32 accumulator.
                let d_hdr  = self.builder.create_block();
                let d_body = self.builder.create_block();
                let d_exit = self.builder.create_block();
                self.builder.append_block_param(d_hdr, cl::I64);
                self.builder.append_block_param(d_hdr, cl::F32);
                self.builder.append_block_param(d_exit, cl::F32);
                let zerof = self.builder.ins().f32const(0.0_f32);
                self.jump(d_hdr, &[zero, zerof]);
                self.enter(d_hdr);
                let d = self.builder.block_params(d_hdr)[0];
                let acc = self.builder.block_params(d_hdr)[1];
                let cd = self.builder.ins().icmp(IntCC::SignedLessThan, d, d_v);
                self.builder.ins().brif(cd, d_body, &[], d_exit, &[acc.into()]);
                self.block_filled = true;

                self.enter(d_body);
                let q_off = self.tensor_byte_offset(qt, &[bi_v, hi_v, zero, d]);
                let qv = self.tensor_load_elem(q_ptr, q_off, ScalarKind::F32);
                let k_off = self.dyn_byte_offset(k_ptr, kdt, &[bi_v, hi_v, j, d]);
                let kv = self.tensor_load_elem(k_data, k_off, ScalarKind::F32);
                let prod = self.builder.ins().fmul(qv, kv);
                let acc2 = self.builder.ins().fadd(acc, prod);
                let dn = self.builder.ins().iadd(d, one);
                self.jump(d_hdr, &[dn, acc2]);
                self.builder.seal_block(d_body);
                self.builder.seal_block(d_hdr);

                self.enter(d_exit);
                let final_acc = self.builder.block_params(d_exit)[0];
                let o_off = self.dyn_byte_offset(out, &odt, &[bi_v, hi_v, zero, j]);
                self.tensor_store_elem(o_data, o_off, final_acc);
                let jn = self.builder.ins().iadd(j, one);
                self.jump(j_hdr, &[jn]);
                self.builder.seal_block(d_exit);
                self.builder.seal_block(j_body);
                self.builder.seal_block(j_hdr);

                self.enter(j_exit);
                self.builder.seal_block(j_exit);
            }
        }
        Ok((out, TyKind::DynTensor(odt)))
    }

    /// `probs @ v_cache` — attention output. `pdt: DynTensor[B,H,1,len]`
    /// (axis 3 runtime), `vdt: DynTensor[B,H,len,D]` (axis 2 runtime). Result
    /// is static `Tensor[f32,[B,H,1,D]]` with `result[b,h,0,d] =
    /// sum_j probs[b,h,0,j] * vcache[b,h,j,d]`. The contraction `len` is
    /// runtime (loop bound from the dynamic extent).
    fn lower_kv_output(
        &mut self,
        p_ptr: Value, pdt: &DynTensorTy,
        v_ptr: Value, vdt: &DynTensorTy,
        span: &Span,
    ) -> Result<(Value, TyKind), JitError> {
        if pdt.rank() != 4 || vdt.rank() != 4 {
            return err(span, "attention `probs @ v_cache` requires rank-4 operands");
        }
        if pdt.elem != ScalarKind::F32 {
            return err(span, "attention output is f32-only");
        }
        // probs: [B,H,1,len], all of B,H,1 static; axis 3 runtime.
        let (b, h) = match (pdt.dims[0], pdt.dims[1]) {
            (Some(b), Some(h)) => (b, h),
            _ => return err(span, "attention output: probs batch dims [B,H] must be static"),
        };
        if pdt.dims[2] != Some(1) {
            return err(span, "attention output: probs axis 2 must be 1");
        }
        if pdt.dims[3].is_some() {
            return err(span, "attention output: probs axis 3 (len) must be runtime");
        }
        // v: [B,H,len,D], B,H,D static; axis 2 runtime.
        let dv = match vdt.dims[3] {
            Some(d) => d,
            None => return err(span, "attention output: v feature dim D must be static"),
        };
        if vdt.dims[0] != Some(b) || vdt.dims[1] != Some(h) {
            return err(span, "attention output: probs/v batch dims [B,H] must match");
        }
        if vdt.dims[2].is_some() {
            return err(span, "attention output: v cache streaming axis (2) must be runtime");
        }

        let len = self.dyn_extent(p_ptr, pdt, 3);
        let p_data = self.dyn_data_ptr(p_ptr, pdt);
        let v_data = self.dyn_data_ptr(v_ptr, vdt);

        let out_ty = TensorTy { elem: ScalarKind::F32, shape: vec![b, h, 1, dv] };
        let out_ptr = self.forge_alloc(out_ty.nbytes());

        let zero = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, 0);
        let one  = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, 1);

        // for b in 0..B, h in 0..H, d in 0..D (static); j in 0..len (runtime):
        //   acc = 0; for j: acc += probs[b,h,0,j] * v[b,h,j,d]
        //   out[b,h,0,d] = acc
        for bi in 0..b {
            let bi_v = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, bi);
            for hi in 0..h {
                let hi_v = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, hi);
                for di in 0..dv {
                    let di_v = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, di);

                    // j contraction loop (runtime bound `len`), f32 accumulator.
                    let j_hdr  = self.builder.create_block();
                    let j_body = self.builder.create_block();
                    let j_exit = self.builder.create_block();
                    self.builder.append_block_param(j_hdr, cl::I64);
                    self.builder.append_block_param(j_hdr, cl::F32);
                    self.builder.append_block_param(j_exit, cl::F32);
                    let zerof = self.builder.ins().f32const(0.0_f32);
                    self.jump(j_hdr, &[zero, zerof]);
                    self.enter(j_hdr);
                    let j = self.builder.block_params(j_hdr)[0];
                    let acc = self.builder.block_params(j_hdr)[1];
                    let cj = self.builder.ins().icmp(IntCC::SignedLessThan, j, len);
                    self.builder.ins().brif(cj, j_body, &[], j_exit, &[acc.into()]);
                    self.block_filled = true;

                    self.enter(j_body);
                    let p_off = self.dyn_byte_offset(p_ptr, pdt, &[bi_v, hi_v, zero, j]);
                    let pv = self.tensor_load_elem(p_data, p_off, ScalarKind::F32);
                    let v_off = self.dyn_byte_offset(v_ptr, vdt, &[bi_v, hi_v, j, di_v]);
                    let vv = self.tensor_load_elem(v_data, v_off, ScalarKind::F32);
                    let prod = self.builder.ins().fmul(pv, vv);
                    let acc2 = self.builder.ins().fadd(acc, prod);
                    let jn = self.builder.ins().iadd(j, one);
                    self.jump(j_hdr, &[jn, acc2]);
                    self.builder.seal_block(j_body);
                    self.builder.seal_block(j_hdr);

                    self.enter(j_exit);
                    let final_acc = self.builder.block_params(j_exit)[0];
                    let o_off = self.tensor_byte_offset(&out_ty, &[bi_v, hi_v, zero, di_v]);
                    self.tensor_store_elem(out_ptr, o_off, final_acc);
                    self.builder.seal_block(j_exit);
                }
            }
        }
        Ok((out_ptr, TyKind::Tensor(out_ty)))
    }

    /// Vectorized matmul, cache-blocked over the output columns (#322).
    ///
    /// Loop order i → nb(N-tile) → k → jj with the K-contraction OUTER of the
    /// N-inner loop, so the RHS/weight matrix is read ROW-CONTIGUOUS
    /// (`B[k, nb:nb+NB]` is contiguous) instead of strided down columns. The
    /// output tile `C[i, nb:nb+NB]` (NB elems) stays L1-resident across the
    /// k-loop. Each output element still accumulates over k in ASCENDING order
    /// (zero, then one fma per k), so results are bit-identical to the prior
    /// column-outer kernel — pure speedup, no numeric change.
    ///
    ///   for i in 0..M:
    ///     for nb in 0..N step NB:
    ///       C[i, nb:nb+NB] = 0
    ///       for k in 0..K:
    ///         for jj in nb..nb+NB step 4: C[i,jj:jj+4] += splat(A[i,k]) * B[k,jj:jj+4]
    ///
    /// `n` must be a multiple of 4. `out` is zeroed per-tile here.
    fn simd_matmul(&mut self, l: Value, r: Value, out: Value, m: i64, k: i64, n: i64) {
        let flags = cranelift::codegen::ir::MemFlagsData::new();
        let zero = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, 0);
        let one = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, 1);
        let four = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, 4);           // elem bytes
        let vec_bytes = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, 16);     // one F32X4
        let m_v = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, m);
        let k_v = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, k);
        let n_bytes_val = n * 4;                                    // row stride
        let n_bytes = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, n_bytes_val);
        let zc = self.builder.func.dfg.constants.insert(vec![0u8; 16].into());
        let zvec = self.builder.ins().vconst(cl::F32X4, zc);

        // Register-blocked GEMM. The main loop holds TILE output-column vectors
        // (TILE*4 f32) live in vector registers across the *whole* k-loop — they
        // ride the k_hdr block params, so the C accumulators take ZERO memory
        // traffic until one final store per tile (vs the prior kernel's per-k
        // load+store of C). Weights are still read row-contiguous (B[kk, jt..]).
        // `n` is only guaranteed % 4 (one vector), so columns past the last full
        // TILE tile are swept by a single-vector remainder loop. Both paths
        // accumulate `zvec + fma(a, b, acc)` over kk ascending — bit-identical to
        // the pre-register-blocking kernel, so all matmul goldens are unchanged.
        const TILE: i64 = 4;
        let tile_bytes_val = TILE * 16;                            // 64
        let main_end_val = (n_bytes_val / tile_bytes_val) * tile_bytes_val;
        let main_end = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, main_end_val);
        let tile_bytes = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, tile_bytes_val);

        // for i in 0..m
        let i_hdr = self.builder.create_block();
        let i_body = self.builder.create_block();
        let i_exit = self.builder.create_block();
        self.builder.append_block_param(i_hdr, cl::I64);
        self.jump(i_hdr, &[zero]);
        self.enter(i_hdr);
        let i = self.builder.block_params(i_hdr)[0];
        let ci = self.builder.ins().icmp(IntCC::SignedLessThan, i, m_v);
        self.brif(ci, i_body, i_exit);

        self.enter(i_body);
        let i_rowb = self.builder.ins().imul(i, n_bytes);
        let out_row = self.builder.ins().iadd(out, i_rowb);        // C[i,*]
        let l_rowb = self.builder.ins().imul(i, k_v);
        let l_rowb = self.builder.ins().imul(l_rowb, four);
        let l_row = self.builder.ins().iadd(l, l_rowb);            // A[i,*]
        // i_body falls through into the first emitted section below.

        // ---- main: for jt in 0..main_end step TILE (TILE accs held in regs) ----
        if main_end_val > 0 {
            let jt_hdr = self.builder.create_block();
            let jt_body = self.builder.create_block();
            let jt_exit = self.builder.create_block();
            self.builder.append_block_param(jt_hdr, cl::I64);
            self.jump(jt_hdr, &[zero]);
            self.enter(jt_hdr);
            let jt = self.builder.block_params(jt_hdr)[0];
            let cjt = self.builder.ins().icmp(IntCC::SignedLessThan, jt, main_end);
            self.brif(cjt, jt_body, jt_exit);

            self.enter(jt_body);
            // k loop carrying TILE F32X4 accumulators as block params (registers).
            let k_hdr = self.builder.create_block();
            let k_body = self.builder.create_block();
            let k_exit = self.builder.create_block();
            self.builder.append_block_param(k_hdr, cl::I64);
            for _ in 0..TILE { self.builder.append_block_param(k_hdr, cl::F32X4); }
            for _ in 0..TILE { self.builder.append_block_param(k_exit, cl::F32X4); }
            let mut init_args = vec![zero];
            for _ in 0..TILE { init_args.push(zvec); }
            self.jump(k_hdr, &init_args);
            self.enter(k_hdr);
            let kk = self.builder.block_params(k_hdr)[0];
            let accs: Vec<Value> = (0..TILE as usize)
                .map(|t| self.builder.block_params(k_hdr)[1 + t])
                .collect();
            let ck = self.builder.ins().icmp(IntCC::SignedLessThan, kk, k_v);
            let acc_args: Vec<_> = accs.iter().map(|v| (*v).into()).collect();
            self.builder.ins().brif(ck, k_body, &[], k_exit, &acc_args);
            self.block_filled = true;

            self.enter(k_body);
            // a = splat(A[i,kk]); A[i,kk] at l_row + kk*4
            let kk_b = self.builder.ins().imul(kk, four);
            let l_addr = self.builder.ins().iadd(l_row, kk_b);
            let a_scalar = self.builder.ins().load(cl::F32, flags, l_addr, 0);
            let a_vec = self.builder.ins().splat(cl::F32X4, a_scalar);
            // b_base = B[kk, jt] at r + kk*n_bytes + jt — TILE vectors read contiguous
            let b_rowb = self.builder.ins().imul(kk, n_bytes);
            let b_row = self.builder.ins().iadd(r, b_rowb);
            let b_base = self.builder.ins().iadd(b_row, jt);
            let mut new_accs = Vec::with_capacity(TILE as usize);
            for t in 0..TILE as usize {
                let bvec = self.builder.ins().load(cl::F32X4, flags, b_base, (t as i32) * 16);
                let na = self.builder.ins().fma(a_vec, bvec, accs[t]);
                new_accs.push(na);
            }
            let kn = self.builder.ins().iadd(kk, one);
            let mut back_args = vec![kn];
            back_args.extend(new_accs);
            self.jump(k_hdr, &back_args);
            self.builder.seal_block(k_body);
            self.builder.seal_block(k_hdr);

            // k_exit: one store per tile vector, then jt back-edge.
            self.enter(k_exit);
            let out_accs: Vec<Value> = (0..TILE as usize)
                .map(|t| self.builder.block_params(k_exit)[t])
                .collect();
            let c_base = self.builder.ins().iadd(out_row, jt);
            for t in 0..TILE as usize {
                self.builder.ins().store(flags, out_accs[t], c_base, (t as i32) * 16);
            }
            let jtn = self.builder.ins().iadd(jt, tile_bytes);
            self.jump(jt_hdr, &[jtn]);
            self.builder.seal_block(k_exit);
            self.builder.seal_block(jt_body);
            self.builder.seal_block(jt_hdr);

            self.enter(jt_exit);
            self.builder.seal_block(jt_exit);
            // current block is now jt_exit; remainder / i back-edge continues here.
        }

        // ---- remainder: single-vector register-blocked sweep of leftover cols ----
        if main_end_val < n_bytes_val {
            let jr_hdr = self.builder.create_block();
            let jr_body = self.builder.create_block();
            let jr_exit = self.builder.create_block();
            self.builder.append_block_param(jr_hdr, cl::I64);
            self.jump(jr_hdr, &[main_end]);
            self.enter(jr_hdr);
            let jr = self.builder.block_params(jr_hdr)[0];
            let cjr = self.builder.ins().icmp(IntCC::SignedLessThan, jr, n_bytes);
            self.brif(cjr, jr_body, jr_exit);

            self.enter(jr_body);
            let k2_hdr = self.builder.create_block();
            let k2_body = self.builder.create_block();
            let k2_exit = self.builder.create_block();
            self.builder.append_block_param(k2_hdr, cl::I64);
            self.builder.append_block_param(k2_hdr, cl::F32X4);
            self.builder.append_block_param(k2_exit, cl::F32X4);
            self.jump(k2_hdr, &[zero, zvec]);
            self.enter(k2_hdr);
            let kk2 = self.builder.block_params(k2_hdr)[0];
            let acc = self.builder.block_params(k2_hdr)[1];
            let ck2 = self.builder.ins().icmp(IntCC::SignedLessThan, kk2, k_v);
            self.builder.ins().brif(ck2, k2_body, &[], k2_exit, &[acc.into()]);
            self.block_filled = true;

            self.enter(k2_body);
            let kk2_b = self.builder.ins().imul(kk2, four);
            let l2_addr = self.builder.ins().iadd(l_row, kk2_b);
            let a2_scalar = self.builder.ins().load(cl::F32, flags, l2_addr, 0);
            let a2_vec = self.builder.ins().splat(cl::F32X4, a2_scalar);
            let b2_rowb = self.builder.ins().imul(kk2, n_bytes);
            let b2_row = self.builder.ins().iadd(r, b2_rowb);
            let b2_addr = self.builder.ins().iadd(b2_row, jr);
            let b2vec = self.builder.ins().load(cl::F32X4, flags, b2_addr, 0);
            let acc2 = self.builder.ins().fma(a2_vec, b2vec, acc);
            let kk2n = self.builder.ins().iadd(kk2, one);
            self.jump(k2_hdr, &[kk2n, acc2]);
            self.builder.seal_block(k2_body);
            self.builder.seal_block(k2_hdr);

            self.enter(k2_exit);
            let acc_out = self.builder.block_params(k2_exit)[0];
            let c2_addr = self.builder.ins().iadd(out_row, jr);
            self.builder.ins().store(flags, acc_out, c2_addr, 0);
            let jrn = self.builder.ins().iadd(jr, vec_bytes);
            self.jump(jr_hdr, &[jrn]);
            self.builder.seal_block(k2_exit);
            self.builder.seal_block(jr_body);
            self.builder.seal_block(jr_hdr);

            self.enter(jr_exit);
            self.builder.seal_block(jr_exit);
        }

        // end of column work → i back-edge
        let in_ = self.builder.ins().iadd(i, one);
        self.jump(i_hdr, &[in_]);
        self.builder.seal_block(i_body);
        self.builder.seal_block(i_hdr);

        self.enter(i_exit);
        self.builder.seal_block(i_exit);
    }

    /// Scalar fallback matmul kernel. Same signature as `simd_matmul`.
    fn scalar_matmul(&mut self, l: Value, r: Value, out: Value, m: i64, k: i64, n: i64) {
        let eb   = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, 4);
        let k_v  = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, k);
        let n_v  = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, n);
        let m_v  = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, m);
        let one  = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, 1);
        let zero = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, 0);
        let zerof = self.builder.ins().f32const(0.0_f32);

        let i_hdr  = self.builder.create_block();
        let i_body = self.builder.create_block();
        let i_exit = self.builder.create_block();
        self.builder.append_block_param(i_hdr, cl::I64);
        self.jump(i_hdr, &[zero]);
        self.enter(i_hdr);
        let i = self.builder.block_params(i_hdr)[0];
        let ci = self.builder.ins().icmp(IntCC::SignedLessThan, i, m_v);
        self.brif(ci, i_body, i_exit);

        self.enter(i_body);
        let j_hdr  = self.builder.create_block();
        let j_body = self.builder.create_block();
        let j_exit = self.builder.create_block();
        self.builder.append_block_param(j_hdr, cl::I64);
        self.jump(j_hdr, &[zero]);
        self.enter(j_hdr);
        let j = self.builder.block_params(j_hdr)[0];
        let cj = self.builder.ins().icmp(IntCC::SignedLessThan, j, n_v);
        self.brif(cj, j_body, j_exit);

        self.enter(j_body);
        let kk_hdr  = self.builder.create_block();
        let kk_body = self.builder.create_block();
        let kk_exit = self.builder.create_block();
        self.builder.append_block_param(kk_hdr, cl::I64);
        self.builder.append_block_param(kk_hdr, cl::F32);
        self.builder.append_block_param(kk_exit, cl::F32);
        self.jump(kk_hdr, &[zero, zerof]);
        self.enter(kk_hdr);
        let kk  = self.builder.block_params(kk_hdr)[0];
        let acc = self.builder.block_params(kk_hdr)[1];
        let ck  = self.builder.ins().icmp(IntCC::SignedLessThan, kk, k_v);
        self.builder.ins().brif(ck, kk_body, &[], kk_exit, &[acc.into()]);
        self.block_filled = true;

        self.enter(kk_body);
        let ik   = self.builder.ins().imul(i, k_v);
        let lf   = self.builder.ins().iadd(ik, kk);
        let lo   = self.builder.ins().imul(lf, eb);
        let lv   = self.tensor_load_elem(l, lo, ScalarKind::F32);
        let kkn  = self.builder.ins().imul(kk, n_v);
        let rf   = self.builder.ins().iadd(kkn, j);
        let ro   = self.builder.ins().imul(rf, eb);
        let rv   = self.tensor_load_elem(r, ro, ScalarKind::F32);
        let prod = self.builder.ins().fmul(lv, rv);
        let acc2 = self.builder.ins().fadd(acc, prod);
        let kkn2 = self.builder.ins().iadd(kk, one);
        self.jump(kk_hdr, &[kkn2, acc2]);
        self.builder.seal_block(kk_body);
        self.builder.seal_block(kk_hdr);

        self.enter(kk_exit);
        let final_acc = self.builder.block_params(kk_exit)[0];
        let in_  = self.builder.ins().imul(i, n_v);
        let of_  = self.builder.ins().iadd(in_, j);
        let oo   = self.builder.ins().imul(of_, eb);
        self.tensor_store_elem(out, oo, final_acc);
        let jn = self.builder.ins().iadd(j, one);
        self.jump(j_hdr, &[jn]);
        self.builder.seal_block(kk_exit);
        self.builder.seal_block(j_body);
        self.builder.seal_block(j_hdr);

        self.enter(j_exit);
        let i2 = self.builder.ins().iadd(i, one);
        self.jump(i_hdr, &[i2]);
        self.builder.seal_block(j_exit);
        self.builder.seal_block(i_body);
        self.builder.seal_block(i_hdr);

        self.enter(i_exit);
        self.builder.seal_block(i_exit);
    }

    /// Dispatch to SIMD or scalar 2D matmul kernel.
    /// `l`, `r`, `out` are raw f32 pointers to the start of the slice.
    fn emit_2d_matmul_at(&mut self, l: Value, r: Value, out: Value, m: i64, k: i64, n: i64) {
        if n % 4 == 0 && n >= 4 {
            // #323: large multi-row Linear layers (prefill / batched) go to the
            // multi-threaded runtime kernel, which is bit-identical to `simd_matmul`
            // (same fused ascending-kk accumulation). A decode GEMV (m == 1) is
            // bandwidth-bound — threading buys nothing — so it stays on the inline
            // kernel, as do small matmuls (tests, attention heads). Threshold and
            // the m >= 2 gate match `matmul_threads`.
            let macs = (m as i128) * (k as i128) * (n as i128);
            if m >= 2 && macs >= (1 << 20) {
                self.emit_matmul_par_call(l, r, out, m, k, n);
            } else {
                self.simd_matmul(l, r, out, m, k, n);
            }
        } else {
            self.scalar_matmul(l, r, out, m, k, n);
        }
    }

    /// Emit a call to the threaded runtime matmul `__dmc_matmul_par`.
    fn emit_matmul_par_call(&mut self, l: Value, r: Value, out: Value, m: i64, k: i64, n: i64) {
        let m_v = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, m);
        let k_v = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, k);
        let n_v = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, n);
        let entry = self.fns.get("__dmc_matmul_par")
            .expect("__dmc_matmul_par not registered").clone();
        let func_ref = self.module.declare_func_in_func(entry.id, self.builder.func);
        self.builder.ins().call(func_ref, &[l, r, out, m_v, k_v, n_v]);
    }

    /// #324: emit one 2-D slice through the bf16-direct kernel. `r` is a 2-byte
    /// bf16 weight pointer; `l`/`out` are f32. The kernel reads u16 + upconverts
    /// in-register (threaded for m>=2, serial GEMV for m==1). A future micro-opt
    /// could inline the m==1 decode GEMV like `simd_matmul`, but the extern call
    /// overhead is negligible against the per-slice MACs.
    fn emit_2d_matmul_bf16_at(&mut self, l: Value, r: Value, out: Value, m: i64, k: i64, n: i64) {
        let m_v = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, m);
        let k_v = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, k);
        let n_v = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, n);
        // #326: route the m==1 decode GEMV to the GPU when `--gpu` is on and the
        // Metal builtin is compiled in. Prefill (m>1) and feature-off builds keep
        // the CPU kernel. `gpu_sym` resolves to the GPU symbol only under cfg, so
        // a feature-off build can never reference an unregistered symbol.
        let gpu_sym = {
            #[cfg(all(target_os = "macos", feature = "gpu"))]
            {
                // Offload only the m==1 decode GEMV, and only when it's large
                // enough that GPU compute dominates the per-dispatch sync cost.
                // The big static projections (FFN k·n≈25M, lm-head≈388M) clear
                // this and become resident; the many sub-1M per-step attention
                // matmuls (KV-dependent, can't reside) stay on the CPU, where
                // they're already fast and avoid a command-buffer round-trip.
                const GPU_MIN_MACS: i128 = 4_000_000;
                if self.gpu && m == 1 && (k as i128) * (n as i128) >= GPU_MIN_MACS {
                    Some("__dmc_matmul_bf16_gpu")
                } else { None }
            }
            #[cfg(not(all(target_os = "macos", feature = "gpu")))]
            { let _ = self.gpu; None::<&str> }
        };
        let sym = gpu_sym.unwrap_or("__dmc_matmul_bf16");
        let entry = self.fns.get(sym)
            .unwrap_or_else(|| panic!("{} not registered", sym)).clone();
        let func_ref = self.module.declare_func_in_func(entry.id, self.builder.func);
        self.builder.ins().call(func_ref, &[l, r, out, m_v, k_v, n_v]);
    }

    // ─── Tensor-aware builtin dispatch ──────────────────────────────────────

    fn lower_builtin_len(
        &mut self,
        args: &[CallArg],
        span: &Span,
    ) -> Result<(Value, TyKind), JitError> {
        if args.len() != 1 {
            return err(span, "`len` takes exactly 1 argument");
        }
        let e = match &args[0] {
            CallArg::Positional(e) => e,
            _ => return unsupported(span, "non-positional arg to `len`"),
        };
        let (v, ty) = self.lower_expr(e)?;
        // String: call __dmc_str_len at runtime.
        if ty.is_str() {
            let entry = self.fns.get("__dmc_str_len")
                .expect("__dmc_str_len not registered").clone();
            let func_ref = self.module.declare_func_in_func(entry.id, self.builder.func);
            let call = self.builder.ins().call(func_ref, &[v]);
            let result = self.builder.inst_results(call)[0];
            return Ok((result, TyKind::Scalar(ScalarKind::I64)));
        }
        let t = ty.as_tensor().ok_or_else(|| JitError {
            msg: "`len` requires a tensor or str argument".into(),
            line: span.line, col: span.col,
        })?;
        // #parity: len(tensor) is the size of the FIRST dimension (rows), like
        // the interpreter / numpy — not the flattened element count. (For a 1-D
        // tensor shape[0] == nelems, so this is unchanged there.)
        let n_val = t.shape.first().copied().unwrap_or_else(|| t.nelems());
        let n = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, n_val);
        Ok((n, TyKind::Scalar(ScalarKind::I64)))
    }

    /// `str_concat(s1, s2)` — concatenate two strings, return new Str.
    fn lower_builtin_str_concat(
        &mut self,
        args: &[CallArg],
        span: &Span,
    ) -> Result<(Value, TyKind), JitError> {
        if args.len() != 2 {
            return err(span, "`str_concat` takes exactly 2 arguments");
        }
        let e1 = match &args[0] { CallArg::Positional(e) => e, _ => return unsupported(span, "non-positional arg to `str_concat`") };
        let e2 = match &args[1] { CallArg::Positional(e) => e, _ => return unsupported(span, "non-positional arg to `str_concat`") };
        let (v1, ty1) = self.lower_expr(e1)?;
        let (v2, ty2) = self.lower_expr(e2)?;
        if !ty1.is_str() { return err(span, format!("`str_concat` arg 1 must be str, got `{}`", ty1.render())); }
        if !ty2.is_str() { return err(span, format!("`str_concat` arg 2 must be str, got `{}`", ty2.render())); }
        let entry = self.fns.get("__dmc_str_concat").expect("__dmc_str_concat not registered").clone();
        let func_ref = self.module.declare_func_in_func(entry.id, self.builder.func);
        let call = self.builder.ins().call(func_ref, &[v1, v2]);
        let result = self.builder.inst_results(call)[0];
        Ok((result, TyKind::Str))
    }

    /// `str_eq(s1, s2)` — 1 if equal, 0 otherwise.
    fn lower_builtin_str_eq(
        &mut self,
        args: &[CallArg],
        span: &Span,
    ) -> Result<(Value, TyKind), JitError> {
        if args.len() != 2 {
            return err(span, "`str_eq` takes exactly 2 arguments");
        }
        let e1 = match &args[0] { CallArg::Positional(e) => e, _ => return unsupported(span, "non-positional arg to `str_eq`") };
        let e2 = match &args[1] { CallArg::Positional(e) => e, _ => return unsupported(span, "non-positional arg to `str_eq`") };
        let (v1, ty1) = self.lower_expr(e1)?;
        let (v2, ty2) = self.lower_expr(e2)?;
        if !ty1.is_str() { return err(span, format!("`str_eq` arg 1 must be str, got `{}`", ty1.render())); }
        if !ty2.is_str() { return err(span, format!("`str_eq` arg 2 must be str, got `{}`", ty2.render())); }
        let entry = self.fns.get("__dmc_str_eq").expect("__dmc_str_eq not registered").clone();
        let func_ref = self.module.declare_func_in_func(entry.id, self.builder.func);
        let call = self.builder.ins().call(func_ref, &[v1, v2]);
        let result = self.builder.inst_results(call)[0];
        Ok((result, TyKind::Scalar(ScalarKind::I64)))
    }

    /// `str_get_char(s, i)` — return byte at index i as i64.
    fn lower_builtin_str_get_char(
        &mut self,
        args: &[CallArg],
        span: &Span,
    ) -> Result<(Value, TyKind), JitError> {
        if args.len() != 2 {
            return err(span, "`str_get_char` takes exactly 2 arguments");
        }
        let e1 = match &args[0] { CallArg::Positional(e) => e, _ => return unsupported(span, "non-positional arg to `str_get_char`") };
        let e2 = match &args[1] { CallArg::Positional(e) => e, _ => return unsupported(span, "non-positional arg to `str_get_char`") };
        let (v1, ty1) = self.lower_expr(e1)?;
        let (v2, ty2) = self.lower_expr(e2)?;
        if !ty1.is_str() { return err(span, format!("`str_get_char` arg 1 must be str, got `{}`", ty1.render())); }
        if ty2.as_scalar().map(|s| !s.is_int()).unwrap_or(true) {
            return err(span, format!("`str_get_char` arg 2 must be an integer index, got `{}`", ty2.render()));
        }
        let idx = self.coerce_to(v2, &ty2, &TyKind::Scalar(ScalarKind::I64), span)?;
        let entry = self.fns.get("__dmc_str_get_char").expect("__dmc_str_get_char not registered").clone();
        let func_ref = self.module.declare_func_in_func(entry.id, self.builder.func);
        let call = self.builder.ins().call(func_ref, &[v1, idx]);
        let result = self.builder.inst_results(call)[0];
        Ok((result, TyKind::Scalar(ScalarKind::I64)))
    }

    /// `print_str(s)` — print a string with newline.
    fn lower_builtin_print_str(
        &mut self,
        args: &[CallArg],
        span: &Span,
    ) -> Result<(Value, TyKind), JitError> {
        if args.len() != 1 {
            return err(span, "`print_str` takes exactly 1 argument");
        }
        let e = match &args[0] { CallArg::Positional(e) => e, _ => return unsupported(span, "non-positional arg to `print_str`") };
        let (v, ty) = self.lower_expr(e)?;
        if !ty.is_str() { return err(span, format!("`print_str` requires a str argument, got `{}`", ty.render())); }
        let entry = self.fns.get("__dmc_print_str").expect("__dmc_print_str not registered").clone();
        let func_ref = self.module.declare_func_in_func(entry.id, self.builder.func);
        self.builder.ins().call(func_ref, &[v]);
        let z = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I8, 0);
        Ok((z, TyKind::Scalar(ScalarKind::Nil)))
    }

    /// `chr(n)` — the one-character string for codepoint `n`. Returns a forge
    /// string pointer (same layout as str_concat / str_from_int).
    fn lower_builtin_chr(
        &mut self,
        args: &[CallArg],
        span: &Span,
    ) -> Result<(Value, TyKind), JitError> {
        if args.len() != 1 {
            return err(span, "`chr` takes exactly 1 argument");
        }
        let e = match &args[0] { CallArg::Positional(e) => e, _ => return unsupported(span, "non-positional arg to `chr`") };
        let (v, ty) = self.lower_expr(e)?;
        let n = self.coerce_to(v, &ty, &TyKind::Scalar(ScalarKind::I64), span)?;
        let entry = self.fns.get("__dmc_chr").expect("__dmc_chr not registered").clone();
        let func_ref = self.module.declare_func_in_func(entry.id, self.builder.func);
        let call = self.builder.ins().call(func_ref, &[n]);
        let result = self.builder.inst_results(call)[0];
        Ok((result, TyKind::Str))
    }

    /// `sleep_ms(ms)` — sleep for `ms` milliseconds (side effect, returns nil).
    fn lower_builtin_sleep_ms(
        &mut self,
        args: &[CallArg],
        span: &Span,
    ) -> Result<(Value, TyKind), JitError> {
        if args.len() != 1 {
            return err(span, "`sleep_ms` takes exactly 1 argument");
