        let (v, ty) = self.lower_expr(e)?;
        let ms = self.coerce_to(v, &ty, &TyKind::Scalar(ScalarKind::F64), span)?;
        let entry = self.fns.get("__dmc_sleep_ms").expect("__dmc_sleep_ms not registered").clone();
        let func_ref = self.module.declare_func_in_func(entry.id, self.builder.func);
        self.builder.ins().call(func_ref, &[ms]);
        let z = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I8, 0);
        Ok((z, TyKind::Scalar(ScalarKind::Nil)))
    }

    /// `flush()` — flush stdout (side effect, returns nil).
    fn lower_builtin_flush(
        &mut self,
        args: &[CallArg],
        span: &Span,
    ) -> Result<(Value, TyKind), JitError> {
        if !args.is_empty() {
            return err(span, "`flush` takes no arguments");
        }
        let entry = self.fns.get("__dmc_flush").expect("__dmc_flush not registered").clone();
        let func_ref = self.module.declare_func_in_func(entry.id, self.builder.func);
        self.builder.ins().call(func_ref, &[]);
        let z = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I8, 0);
        Ok((z, TyKind::Scalar(ScalarKind::Nil)))
    }

    // ─── HashMap builtins ────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    fn lower_builtin_map_new(
        &mut self,
        args: &[CallArg],
        span: &Span,
    ) -> Result<(Value, TyKind), JitError> {
        if !args.is_empty() {
            return err(span, "`map_new` takes no arguments");
        }
        let entry = self.fns.get("__dmc_map_new").expect("__dmc_map_new not registered").clone();
        let func_ref = self.module.declare_func_in_func(entry.id, self.builder.func);
        let call = self.builder.ins().call(func_ref, &[]);
        let result = self.builder.inst_results(call)[0];
        Ok((result, TyKind::Map))
    }

    fn lower_builtin_map_get(
        &mut self,
        args: &[CallArg],
        span: &Span,
    ) -> Result<(Value, TyKind), JitError> {
        if args.len() != 2 {
            return err(span, "`map_get` takes exactly 2 arguments (map, key)");
        }
        let e0 = match &args[0] { CallArg::Positional(e) => e, _ => return unsupported(span, "non-positional arg to `map_get`") };
        let e1 = match &args[1] { CallArg::Positional(e) => e, _ => return unsupported(span, "non-positional arg to `map_get`") };
        let (m, mty) = self.lower_expr(e0)?;
        let (k, kty) = self.lower_expr(e1)?;
        if !mty.is_map() { return err(span, format!("`map_get` arg 1 must be a Map, got `{}`", mty.render())); }
        if !kty.is_str() { return err(span, format!("`map_get` arg 2 must be str, got `{}`", kty.render())); }
        // map_get is dynamically typed and returns `nil` on a missing key (#300.4).
        // Produce an OptI64 (I128: present-bit | value) built from map_contains +
        // map_get, so `print` / `== nil` see the miss and a plain-i64 use traps —
        // matching the interpreter instead of the old silent 0.
        let get = self.fns.get("__dmc_map_get").expect("__dmc_map_get not registered").clone();
        let contains = self.fns.get("__dmc_map_contains").expect("__dmc_map_contains not registered").clone();
        let get_ref = self.module.declare_func_in_func(get.id, self.builder.func);
        let con_ref = self.module.declare_func_in_func(contains.id, self.builder.func);
        let value = { let c = self.builder.ins().call(get_ref, &[m, k]); self.builder.inst_results(c)[0] };
        let present = { let c = self.builder.ins().call(con_ref, &[m, k]); self.builder.inst_results(c)[0] };
        let opt = self.pack_opt(present, value);
        Ok((opt, TyKind::Scalar(ScalarKind::OptI64)))
    }

    /// Pack (present: i64 0/1, value: i64) into the OptI64 I128 representation:
    /// `(present << 64) | (value as u64)`. Decoded by `opt_present`/`opt_value`.
    fn pack_opt(&mut self, present: Value, value: Value) -> Value {
        let p128 = self.builder.ins().uextend(cl::I128, present);
        let v128 = self.builder.ins().uextend(cl::I128, value);
        let hi = self.builder.ins().ishl_imm_u(p128, OPT_PRESENT_BIT);
        self.builder.ins().bor(hi, v128)
    }

    /// Extract the present flag (i64 0/1) from an OptI64.
    fn opt_present(&mut self, opt: Value) -> Value {
        let shifted = self.builder.ins().ushr_imm_u(opt, OPT_PRESENT_BIT);
        self.builder.ins().ireduce(cl::I64, shifted)
    }

    /// Extract the payload value (i64, low 64 bits) from an OptI64.
    fn opt_value(&mut self, opt: Value) -> Value {
        self.builder.ins().ireduce(cl::I64, opt)
    }

    fn lower_builtin_map_set(
        &mut self,
        args: &[CallArg],
        span: &Span,
    ) -> Result<(Value, TyKind), JitError> {
        if args.len() != 3 {
            return err(span, "`map_set` takes exactly 3 arguments (map, key, val)");
        }
        let e0 = match &args[0] { CallArg::Positional(e) => e, _ => return unsupported(span, "non-positional arg to `map_set`") };
        let e1 = match &args[1] { CallArg::Positional(e) => e, _ => return unsupported(span, "non-positional arg to `map_set`") };
        let e2 = match &args[2] { CallArg::Positional(e) => e, _ => return unsupported(span, "non-positional arg to `map_set`") };
        let (m, mty) = self.lower_expr(e0)?;
        let (k, kty) = self.lower_expr(e1)?;
        let (v, vty) = self.lower_expr(e2)?;
        if !mty.is_map() { return err(span, format!("`map_set` arg 1 must be a Map, got `{}`", mty.render())); }
        if !kty.is_str() { return err(span, format!("`map_set` arg 2 must be str, got `{}`", kty.render())); }
        // Coerce the value to i64.
        let v = self.coerce_to(v, &vty, &TyKind::Scalar(ScalarKind::I64), span)?;
        let entry = self.fns.get("__dmc_map_set").expect("__dmc_map_set not registered").clone();
        let func_ref = self.module.declare_func_in_func(entry.id, self.builder.func);
        self.builder.ins().call(func_ref, &[m, k, v]);
        // map_set mutates in place and returns the (same, stable) map pointer,
        // so `m = map_set(m, k, v)` rebinds m to the live map — matching the
        // interpreter. Returning nil here made the map unusable after a set.
        Ok((m, TyKind::Map))
    }

    fn lower_builtin_map_contains(
        &mut self,
        args: &[CallArg],
        span: &Span,
    ) -> Result<(Value, TyKind), JitError> {
        if args.len() != 2 {
            return err(span, "`map_contains` takes exactly 2 arguments (map, key)");
        }
        let e0 = match &args[0] { CallArg::Positional(e) => e, _ => return unsupported(span, "non-positional arg to `map_contains`") };
        let e1 = match &args[1] { CallArg::Positional(e) => e, _ => return unsupported(span, "non-positional arg to `map_contains`") };
        let (m, mty) = self.lower_expr(e0)?;
        let (k, kty) = self.lower_expr(e1)?;
        if !mty.is_map() { return err(span, format!("`map_contains` arg 1 must be a Map, got `{}`", mty.render())); }
        if !kty.is_str() { return err(span, format!("`map_contains` arg 2 must be str, got `{}`", kty.render())); }
        let entry = self.fns.get("__dmc_map_contains").expect("__dmc_map_contains not registered").clone();
        let func_ref = self.module.declare_func_in_func(entry.id, self.builder.func);
        let call = self.builder.ins().call(func_ref, &[m, k]);
        let result = self.builder.inst_results(call)[0];
        // Convert i64 (0 or 1) to bool (i8).
        let zero = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, 0);
        let b = self.builder.ins().icmp(IntCC::NotEqual, result, zero);
        Ok((b, TyKind::Scalar(ScalarKind::Bool)))
    }

    // ─── Trit tensor builtins ────────────────────────────────────────────────

    /// `trit_quantize(x: Tensor[f32, [K, N]]) -> TritTensor[K, N]`
    fn lower_builtin_trit_quantize(
        &mut self,
        args: &[CallArg],
        span: &Span,
    ) -> Result<(Value, TyKind), JitError> {
        if args.len() != 1 {
            return err(span, "`trit_quantize` takes exactly 1 argument");
        }
        let e = match &args[0] { CallArg::Positional(e) => e, _ => return unsupported(span, "non-positional arg to trit_quantize") };
        let (src, src_ty) = self.lower_expr(e)?;
        let t = src_ty.as_tensor().ok_or_else(|| JitError {
            msg: format!("`trit_quantize` requires a 2-D f32 tensor, got `{}`", src_ty.render()),
            line: span.line, col: span.col,
        })?.clone();
        if t.rank() != 2 {
            return err(span, "`trit_quantize` requires a 2-D tensor [K, N]");
        }
        let (k, n) = (t.shape[0], t.shape[1]);
        let kv = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, k);
        let nv = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, n);
        let entry = self.fns.get("__dmc_trit_quantize").expect("registered").clone();
        let func_ref = self.module.declare_func_in_func(entry.id, self.builder.func);
        let call = self.builder.ins().call(func_ref, &[src, kv, nv]);
        let ptr = self.builder.inst_results(call)[0];
        Ok((ptr, TyKind::TritTensor(TritTensorTy { k, n })))
    }

    /// `trit_neg(w: TritTensor[K, N]) -> TritTensor[K, N]`
    fn lower_builtin_trit_neg(
        &mut self,
        args: &[CallArg],
        span: &Span,
    ) -> Result<(Value, TyKind), JitError> {
        if args.len() != 1 {
            return err(span, "`trit_neg` takes exactly 1 argument");
        }
        let e = match &args[0] { CallArg::Positional(e) => e, _ => return unsupported(span, "non-positional arg to trit_neg") };
        let (src, src_ty) = self.lower_expr(e)?;
        let tt = match &src_ty {
            TyKind::TritTensor(tt) => tt.clone(),
            _ => return err(span, format!("`trit_neg` requires a TritTensor, got `{}`", src_ty.render())),
        };
        let kv = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, tt.k);
        let nv = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, tt.n);
        let entry = self.fns.get("__dmc_trit_neg").expect("registered").clone();
        let func_ref = self.module.declare_func_in_func(entry.id, self.builder.func);
        let call = self.builder.ins().call(func_ref, &[src, kv, nv]);
        let ptr = self.builder.inst_results(call)[0];
        Ok((ptr, TyKind::TritTensor(tt)))
    }

    /// `trit_sparsity(w: TritTensor[K, N]) -> f64`
    fn lower_builtin_trit_sparsity(
        &mut self,

        if args.len() != 1 {

        }
        let e = match &args[0] { CallArg::Positional(e) => e, _ => return unsupported(span, "non-positional arg to trit_sparsity") };
        let (src, src_ty) = self.lower_expr(e)?;
        let tt = match &src_ty {
            TyKind::TritTensor(tt) => tt.clone(),

        };

        let nv = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, tt.n);

    fn lower_builtin_sum(
        &mut self,
        args: &[CallArg],
        span: &Span,
    ) -> Result<(Value, TyKind), JitError> {
        let (total, _count) = self.lower_sum_with_count(args, span)?;
        Ok((total, TyKind::Scalar(ScalarKind::F32)))
    }

    /// Core of `sum` / `mean`: lower the argument ONCE and reduce, returning
    /// both the f32 total and the runtime i64 element count. #288: `mean`
    /// previously re-lowered its argument expression to recover the count,
    /// re-emitting the arg's IR — side effects ran twice under the JIT.
    fn lower_sum_with_count(
        &mut self,
        args: &[CallArg],
        span: &Span,
    ) -> Result<(Value, Value), JitError> {
        if args.len() != 1 {
            return err(span, "`sum` takes exactly 1 argument");
        }
        let e = match &args[0] {
            CallArg::Positional(e) => e,
            _ => return unsupported(span, "non-positional arg to `sum`"),
        };
        let (ptr, ty) = self.lower_expr(e)?;
        // #324: summing a bf16 weight field — upconvert to f32 first.
        let (ptr, ty) = match &ty {
            TyKind::Bf16Tensor(bt) => self.bf16_upconvert(ptr, &bt.clone()),
            _ => (ptr, ty),
        };
        // `sum` reduces a static tensor, a dynamic-shape tensor, or a KV cache
        // (materialized to its filled prefix first). All three reduce to a flat
        // (data pointer, runtime element count) pair.
        let (data_ptr, count) = match ty {
            TyKind::Tensor(ref t) if t.elem == ScalarKind::F32 => {
                let n = t.nelems();
                (ptr, self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, n))
            }
            TyKind::KV(ref kv) if kv.elem == ScalarKind::F32 => {
                let kv = kv.clone();
                let (dptr, dt) = self.kv_materialize(ptr, &kv);
                let n = self.dyn_total_elems(dptr, &dt);
                let d = self.dyn_data_ptr(dptr, &dt);
                (d, n)
            }
            TyKind::DynTensor(ref dt) if dt.elem == ScalarKind::F32 => {
                let dt = dt.clone();
                let n = self.dyn_total_elems(ptr, &dt);
                let d = self.dyn_data_ptr(ptr, &dt);
                (d, n)
            }
            TyKind::Tensor(_) | TyKind::KV(_) | TyKind::DynTensor(_) =>
                return err(span, "`sum` is f32-only"),
            _ => return err(span, "`sum` requires a tensor or KV argument"),
        };
        let total = self.fused_sum_v(data_ptr, count);
        Ok((total, count))
    }

    /// #272: `max(t)` / `min(t)` — full reduction of an f32 tensor (any rank) to
    /// an f32 scalar, matching the interpreter's `fold(±INFINITY, fmax/fmin)`.
    /// (Scalar / variadic `max(a, b, …)` is not lowered here — tensor only.)
    fn lower_builtin_minmax(&mut self, name: &str, args: &[CallArg], span: &Span)
        -> Result<(Value, TyKind), JitError>
    {
        if args.len() != 1 {
            return err(span, format!(
                "`{}` on a tensor takes exactly 1 argument (scalar/variadic `{}` is not lowered in the JIT)",
                name, name));
        }
        let e = match &args[0] {
            CallArg::Positional(e) => e,
            _ => return unsupported(span, "non-positional arg to a reduction"),
        };
        let is_max = name == "max";
        let (ptr, ty) = self.lower_expr(e)?;
        let (data_ptr, count) = match ty {
            TyKind::Tensor(ref t) if t.elem == ScalarKind::F32 =>
                (ptr, self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, t.nelems())),
            TyKind::KV(ref kv) if kv.elem == ScalarKind::F32 => {
                let kv = kv.clone();
                let (d, dt) = self.kv_materialize(ptr, &kv);
                (self.dyn_data_ptr(d, &dt), self.dyn_total_elems(d, &dt))
            }
            TyKind::DynTensor(ref dt) if dt.elem == ScalarKind::F32 => {
                let dt = dt.clone();
                (self.dyn_data_ptr(ptr, &dt), self.dyn_total_elems(ptr, &dt))
            }
            TyKind::Tensor(_) | TyKind::KV(_) | TyKind::DynTensor(_) =>
                return err(span, format!("`{}` is f32-only", name)),
            _ => return err(span, format!("`{}` requires a tensor argument", name)),
        };
        let r = self.fused_minmax_v(data_ptr, count, is_max);
        Ok((r, TyKind::Scalar(ScalarKind::F32)))
    }

    /// #272: `argmax(t)` / `argmin(t)` — index (i64) of the extremum. JIT slice
    /// supports a rank-1 f32 tensor (the `argmax(logits)` sampler case), where
    /// the flat index is the semantic index; an optional axis must be `0`/`-1`.
    /// Multi-axis arg-reduce (an index *tensor*) is not yet lowered.
    fn lower_builtin_argreduce(&mut self, name: &str, args: &[CallArg], span: &Span)
        -> Result<(Value, TyKind), JitError>
    {
        if args.is_empty() || args.len() > 2 {
            return err(span, format!("`{}` takes a tensor and an optional axis", name));
        }
        let e = match &args[0] {
            CallArg::Positional(e) => e,
            _ => return unsupported(span, "non-positional arg to a reduction"),
        };
        let want_max = name == "argmax";
        let (ptr, ty) = self.lower_expr(e)?;
        match ty {
            TyKind::Tensor(ref t) if t.elem == ScalarKind::F32 => {
                let t = t.clone();
                let rank = t.shape.len() as i64;
                // axis (default -1 = last); normalize negatives.
                let raw_axis = args.get(1)
                    .and_then(|a| match a { CallArg::Positional(e) => const_int_axis(e), _ => None })
                    .unwrap_or(-1);
                let axis = if raw_axis < 0 { raw_axis + rank } else { raw_axis };
                if axis < 0 || axis >= rank {
                    return err(span, format!("`{}` axis {} out of range for a rank-{} tensor", name, raw_axis, rank));
                }
                if rank == 1 {
                    // Scalar index (#272) — at parity with the interpreter's Int.
                    let n = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, t.nelems());
                    let r = self.fused_argreduce_v(ptr, n, want_max);
                    return Ok((r, TyKind::Scalar(ScalarKind::I64)));
                }
                // #276 follow-up: reduce one axis -> an i64 index tensor (input
                // shape with `axis` dropped). The greedy-decode `argmax(.., -1)`.
                self.lower_argreduce_axis(ptr, &t, axis as usize, want_max, span)
            }
            TyKind::Tensor(_) => err(span, format!("`{}` is f32-only", name)),
            _ => err(span, format!("`{}` requires a tensor argument", name)),
        }
    }

    /// #276: `argmax`/`argmin` over one axis of a multi-dim f32 tensor → an i64
    /// index tensor (input shape with `axis` removed). Outer loop over output
    /// positions; an inner strided scan along `axis` picks the extremum index
    /// (first-wins on ties, matching the interpreter).
    fn lower_argreduce_axis(&mut self, ptr: Value, t: &TensorTy, axis: usize, want_max: bool, _span: &Span)
        -> Result<(Value, TyKind), JitError>
    {
        let src_strides = row_major_strides(&t.shape);
        let axis_len = t.shape[axis];
        let axis_stride = src_strides[axis];
        let out_shape: Vec<i64> = (0..t.rank()).filter(|&a| a != axis).map(|a| t.shape[a]).collect();
        let out_ty = TensorTy { elem: ScalarKind::I64, shape: out_shape.clone() };
        let out_total = out_ty.nelems();
        let out_ptr = self.forge_alloc(out_ty.nbytes());
        let out_strides = row_major_strides(&out_shape);
        let in_axes: Vec<usize> = (0..t.rank()).filter(|&a| a != axis).collect();

        let zero = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, 0);
        let one = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, 1);
        let total_c = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, out_total);
        let ohdr = self.builder.create_block();
        let obody = self.builder.create_block();
        let oexit = self.builder.create_block();
        self.builder.append_block_param(ohdr, cl::I64);
        self.jump(ohdr, &[zero]);
        self.enter(ohdr);
        let o = self.builder.block_params(ohdr)[0];
        let ocont = self.builder.ins().icmp(IntCC::SignedLessThan, o, total_c);
        self.brif(ocont, obody, oexit);
        self.builder.seal_block(oexit);

        self.enter(obody);
        // input base offset (axis coord 0) for this output position
        let mut base = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, 0);
        for (j, &ia) in in_axes.iter().enumerate() {
            let os = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, out_strides[j]);
            let div = self.builder.ins().udiv(o, os);
            let ext = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, out_shape[j]);
            let coord = self.builder.ins().urem(div, ext);
            let st = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, src_strides[ia]);
            let term = self.builder.ins().imul(coord, st);
            base = self.builder.ins().iadd(base, term);
        }
        // inner strided arg-reduce along the axis -> best index (i64)
        let best_i = self.fused_argreduce_strided(ptr, base, axis_stride, axis_len, want_max);
        let eight = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, 8);
        let out_byte = self.builder.ins().imul(o, eight);
        self.tensor_store_elem(out_ptr, out_byte, best_i);
        let onext = self.builder.ins().iadd(o, one);
        self.jump(ohdr, &[onext]);
        self.builder.seal_block(obody);
        self.builder.seal_block(ohdr);

        self.enter(oexit);
        Ok((out_ptr, TyKind::Tensor(out_ty)))
    }

    /// #276: arg-reduce over `len` f32 elements starting at element offset `base`
    /// with element stride `stride`. Returns the i64 index (0..len) of the first
    /// extremum. Inner loop of `lower_argreduce_axis`.
    fn fused_argreduce_strided(&mut self, ptr: Value, base: Value, stride: i64, len: i64, want_max: bool) -> Value {
        let zero = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, 0);
        let one = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, 1);
        let four = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, 4);
        let stride_c = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, stride);
        let cap = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, len);
        let init_v = self.builder.ins().f32const(if want_max { f32::NEG_INFINITY } else { f32::INFINITY });

        let hdr = self.builder.create_block();
        let body = self.builder.create_block();
        let exit = self.builder.create_block();
        self.builder.append_block_param(hdr, cl::I64); // i
        self.builder.append_block_param(hdr, cl::F32); // best value
        self.builder.append_block_param(hdr, cl::I64); // best index
        self.builder.append_block_param(exit, cl::I64);

        self.jump(hdr, &[zero, init_v, zero]);
        self.enter(hdr);
        let i = self.builder.block_params(hdr)[0];
        let best_v = self.builder.block_params(hdr)[1];
        let best_i = self.builder.block_params(hdr)[2];
        let cont = self.builder.ins().icmp(IntCC::SignedLessThan, i, cap);
        self.builder.ins().brif(cont, body, &[], exit, &[best_i.into()]);
        self.block_filled = true;

        self.enter(body);
        // elem offset = (base + i*stride) * 4
        let istr = self.builder.ins().imul(i, stride_c);
        let elem = self.builder.ins().iadd(base, istr);
        let off = self.builder.ins().imul(elem, four);
        let v = self.tensor_load_elem(ptr, off, ScalarKind::F32);
        let cc = if want_max { FloatCC::GreaterThan } else { FloatCC::LessThan };
        let better = self.builder.ins().fcmp(cc, v, best_v);
        let bv2 = self.builder.ins().select(better, v, best_v);
        let bi2 = self.builder.ins().select(better, i, best_i);
        let inext = self.builder.ins().iadd(i, one);
        self.jump(hdr, &[inext, bv2, bi2]);
        self.builder.seal_block(body);
        self.builder.seal_block(hdr);

        self.enter(exit);
        let r = self.builder.block_params(exit)[0];
        self.builder.seal_block(exit);
        r
    }

    /// `mean(t)` = sum(t) / nelems. Emitted as a sum-loop followed by a
    /// single divide. f32-only in this slice; matches the stdlib spec
    /// where mean shows up as part of layer_norm (STDLIB.md §127).
    fn lower_builtin_mean(
        &mut self,
        args: &[CallArg],
        span: &Span,
    ) -> Result<(Value, TyKind), JitError> {
        // #288: lower the argument exactly once (via the shared sum core) and
        // divide by the runtime count it already produced. The old path
        // re-lowered the arg expression just to recover `nelems`, re-emitting
        // its IR — an impure argument's side effects executed twice under the
        // JIT but once under `dmc run`. Bonus: the runtime count also makes
        // `mean` work on KV / dynamic-shape tensors (the re-walk only handled
        // static tensors and panicked otherwise).
        let (total, count) = self.lower_sum_with_count(args, span)?;
        let n_v = self.builder.ins().fcvt_from_sint(cl::F32, count);
        let m = self.builder.ins().fdiv(total, n_v);
        Ok((m, TyKind::Scalar(ScalarKind::F32)))
    }

    /// `variance(t)` = sum((x - mean)^2) / nelems. Population variance
    /// (1/N), not sample variance (1/(N-1)) — this is the form that
    /// matches the layer_norm / rms_norm primitives in STDLIB.md.
    fn lower_builtin_variance(
        &mut self,
        args: &[CallArg],
        span: &Span,
    ) -> Result<(Value, TyKind), JitError> {
        if args.len() != 1 {
            return err(span, "`variance` takes exactly 1 argument");
        }
        let e = match &args[0] {
            CallArg::Positional(e) => e,
            _ => return unsupported(span, "non-positional arg to `variance`"),
        };
        let (ptr, ty) = self.lower_expr(e)?;
        let t = ty.as_tensor().ok_or_else(|| JitError {
            msg: "`variance` requires a tensor argument".into(),
            line: span.line, col: span.col,
        })?.clone();
        if t.elem != ScalarKind::F32 {
            return err(span, "`variance` is f32-only in slice 3");
        }
        let n = t.nelems();
        let n_v = self.builder.ins().f32const(n as f32);

        // Pass 1: mean = sum(t) / n
        let mean = self.fused_sum(ptr, n);
        let mean = self.builder.ins().fdiv(mean, n_v);

        // Pass 2: acc = sum((x - mean) ** 2); var = acc / n
        let zero = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, 0);
        let one = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, 1);
        let cap = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, n);
        let eb = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, 4);
        let zerof = self.builder.ins().f32const(0.0_f32);

        let hdr = self.builder.create_block();
        let body = self.builder.create_block();
        let exit = self.builder.create_block();
        self.builder.append_block_param(hdr, cl::I64);
        self.builder.append_block_param(hdr, cl::F32);
        self.builder.append_block_param(exit, cl::F32);

        self.jump(hdr, &[zero, zerof]);
        self.enter(hdr);
        let i = self.builder.block_params(hdr)[0];
        let acc = self.builder.block_params(hdr)[1];
        let cont = self.builder.ins().icmp(IntCC::SignedLessThan, i, cap);
        self.builder.ins().brif(cont, body, &[], exit, &[acc.into()]);
        self.block_filled = true;

        self.enter(body);
        let off = self.builder.ins().imul(i, eb);
        let v = self.tensor_load_elem(ptr, off, ScalarKind::F32);
        let d = self.builder.ins().fsub(v, mean);
        let dsq = self.builder.ins().fmul(d, d);
        let acc2 = self.builder.ins().fadd(acc, dsq);
        let inext = self.builder.ins().iadd(i, one);
        self.jump(hdr, &[inext, acc2]);
        self.builder.seal_block(body);
        self.builder.seal_block(hdr);

        self.enter(exit);
        let total = self.builder.block_params(exit)[0];
        self.builder.seal_block(exit);

        let var = self.builder.ins().fdiv(total, n_v);
        Ok((var, TyKind::Scalar(ScalarKind::F32)))
    }

    /// `pull_to_mean(t, alpha)` — the philosophical move from the
    /// lotka_volterra_variance demo, lifted into the language as a
    /// first-class primitive.
    ///
    /// Returns a fresh tensor of the same shape:
    ///     out[i] = t[i] + alpha * (mean(t) - t[i])
    ///
    /// This is the variance-minimizing redistribution: every element is
    /// pulled fractionally toward the global mean. At alpha=0 it's a
    /// copy; at alpha=1 it's the uniform field. The README's "trait
    /// change" that turns a Lotka-Volterra oscillator into a
    /// phase-separating coexistence is this function applied once per
    /// step. It is also the gradient direction of `variance(t)` under a
    /// sum-preserving constraint — see AGENTS.md / FROM_THE_MODEL.md
    /// once the rationale gets written up.
    fn lower_builtin_pull_to_mean(
        &mut self,
        args: &[CallArg],
        span: &Span,
    ) -> Result<(Value, TyKind), JitError> {
        if args.len() != 2 {
            return err(span, "`pull_to_mean` takes 2 arguments: tensor, alpha");
        }
        let (t_expr, a_expr) = match (&args[0], &args[1]) {
            (CallArg::Positional(t), CallArg::Positional(a)) => (t, a),
            _ => return unsupported(span, "non-positional args to `pull_to_mean`"),
        };
        let (ptr, ty) = self.lower_expr(t_expr)?;
        let t = ty.as_tensor().ok_or_else(|| JitError {
            msg: "`pull_to_mean` first arg must be a tensor".into(),
            line: span.line, col: span.col,
        })?.clone();
        if t.elem != ScalarKind::F32 {
            return err(span, "`pull_to_mean` is f32-only in slice 3");
        }
        let (alpha, alpha_ty) = self.lower_expr(a_expr)?;
        let alpha = self.coerce_to(alpha, &alpha_ty, &TyKind::Scalar(ScalarKind::F32), span)?;

        let n = t.nelems();
        let out_ptr = self.forge_alloc(t.nbytes());

        // mean = sum(t) / n
        let mean = self.fused_sum(ptr, n);
        let n_v = self.builder.ins().f32const(n as f32);
        let mean = self.builder.ins().fdiv(mean, n_v);

        // for i in 0..n: out[i] = t[i] + alpha * (mean - t[i])
        let zero = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, 0);
        let one = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, 1);
        let cap = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, n);
        let eb = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, 4);

        let hdr = self.builder.create_block();
        let body = self.builder.create_block();
        let exit = self.builder.create_block();
        self.builder.append_block_param(hdr, cl::I64);

        self.jump(hdr, &[zero]);
        self.enter(hdr);
        let i = self.builder.block_params(hdr)[0];
        let cont = self.builder.ins().icmp(IntCC::SignedLessThan, i, cap);
        self.brif(cont, body, exit);

        self.enter(body);
        let off = self.builder.ins().imul(i, eb);
        let here = self.tensor_load_elem(ptr, off, ScalarKind::F32);
        let delta = self.builder.ins().fsub(mean, here);
        let pull = self.builder.ins().fmul(alpha, delta);
        let new = self.builder.ins().fadd(here, pull);
        self.tensor_store_elem(out_ptr, off, new);
        let inext = self.builder.ins().iadd(i, one);
        self.jump(hdr, &[inext]);
        self.builder.seal_block(body);
        self.builder.seal_block(hdr);

        self.enter(exit);
        self.builder.seal_block(exit);

        Ok((out_ptr, TyKind::Tensor(t)))
    }

    /// Sum-of-elements helper shared by mean / variance / pull_to_mean.
    /// Emits a tight i-loop that reduces `n` f32 elements starting at
    /// `ptr`. Returns the f32 accumulator value at loop exit.
    fn fused_sum(&mut self, ptr: Value, n: i64) -> Value {
        let cap = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, n);
        self.fused_sum_v(ptr, cap)
    }

    /// Like `fused_sum`, but the element count `n` is a runtime Value (used for
    /// dynamic-shape tensors / materialized KV reads).
    fn fused_sum_v(&mut self, ptr: Value, cap: Value) -> Value {
        let zero = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, 0);
        let one = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, 1);
        let eb = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, 4);
        let zerof = self.builder.ins().f32const(0.0_f32);

        let hdr = self.builder.create_block();
        let body = self.builder.create_block();
        let exit = self.builder.create_block();
        self.builder.append_block_param(hdr, cl::I64);
        self.builder.append_block_param(hdr, cl::F32);
        self.builder.append_block_param(exit, cl::F32);

        self.jump(hdr, &[zero, zerof]);
        self.enter(hdr);
        let i = self.builder.block_params(hdr)[0];
        let acc = self.builder.block_params(hdr)[1];
        let cont = self.builder.ins().icmp(IntCC::SignedLessThan, i, cap);
        self.builder.ins().brif(cont, body, &[], exit, &[acc.into()]);
        self.block_filled = true;

        self.enter(body);
        let off = self.builder.ins().imul(i, eb);
        let v = self.tensor_load_elem(ptr, off, ScalarKind::F32);
        let acc2 = self.builder.ins().fadd(acc, v);
        let inext = self.builder.ins().iadd(i, one);
        self.jump(hdr, &[inext, acc2]);
        self.builder.seal_block(body);
        self.builder.seal_block(hdr);

        self.enter(exit);
        let total = self.builder.block_params(exit)[0];
        self.builder.seal_block(exit);
        total
    }

    /// #272: full-tensor `max`/`min` reduction over a flat f32 buffer → f32.
    /// Init is ∓∞ (so an empty buffer yields ±∞, matching the interpreter's
    /// `fold(±INFINITY, fmax/fmin)`); `fmax`/`fmin` propagate a stored NaN the
    /// same way on both backends.
    fn fused_minmax_v(&mut self, ptr: Value, cap: Value, is_max: bool) -> Value {
        let zero = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, 0);
        let one = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, 1);
        let eb = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, 4);
        let init = self.builder.ins().f32const(if is_max { f32::NEG_INFINITY } else { f32::INFINITY });

        let hdr = self.builder.create_block();
        let body = self.builder.create_block();
        let exit = self.builder.create_block();
        self.builder.append_block_param(hdr, cl::I64);
        self.builder.append_block_param(hdr, cl::F32);
        self.builder.append_block_param(exit, cl::F32);

        self.jump(hdr, &[zero, init]);
        self.enter(hdr);
        let i = self.builder.block_params(hdr)[0];
        let acc = self.builder.block_params(hdr)[1];
        let cont = self.builder.ins().icmp(IntCC::SignedLessThan, i, cap);
        self.builder.ins().brif(cont, body, &[], exit, &[acc.into()]);
        self.block_filled = true;

        self.enter(body);
        let off = self.builder.ins().imul(i, eb);
        let v = self.tensor_load_elem(ptr, off, ScalarKind::F32);
        let acc2 = if is_max { self.builder.ins().fmax(acc, v) } else { self.builder.ins().fmin(acc, v) };
        let inext = self.builder.ins().iadd(i, one);
        self.jump(hdr, &[inext, acc2]);
        self.builder.seal_block(body);
        self.builder.seal_block(hdr);

        self.enter(exit);
        let r = self.builder.block_params(exit)[0];
        self.builder.seal_block(exit);
        r
    }

    /// #272: full-tensor `argmax`/`argmin` over a flat f32 buffer → i64 index.
    /// Strict comparison (`>` / `<`) so the *first* extremum wins on ties,
    /// matching the interpreter. For a rank-1 tensor the flat index is the
    /// semantic index.
    fn fused_argreduce_v(&mut self, ptr: Value, cap: Value, want_max: bool) -> Value {
        let zero = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, 0);
        let one = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, 1);
        let eb = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, 4);
        let init_v = self.builder.ins().f32const(if want_max { f32::NEG_INFINITY } else { f32::INFINITY });

        let hdr = self.builder.create_block();
        let body = self.builder.create_block();
        let exit = self.builder.create_block();
        self.builder.append_block_param(hdr, cl::I64); // i
        self.builder.append_block_param(hdr, cl::F32); // best value
        self.builder.append_block_param(hdr, cl::I64); // best index
        self.builder.append_block_param(exit, cl::I64); // best index out

        self.jump(hdr, &[zero, init_v, zero]);
        self.enter(hdr);
        let i = self.builder.block_params(hdr)[0];
        let best_v = self.builder.block_params(hdr)[1];
        let best_i = self.builder.block_params(hdr)[2];
        let cont = self.builder.ins().icmp(IntCC::SignedLessThan, i, cap);
        self.builder.ins().brif(cont, body, &[], exit, &[best_i.into()]);
        self.block_filled = true;

        self.enter(body);
        let off = self.builder.ins().imul(i, eb);
        let v = self.tensor_load_elem(ptr, off, ScalarKind::F32);
        let cc = if want_max { FloatCC::GreaterThan } else { FloatCC::LessThan };
        let better = self.builder.ins().fcmp(cc, v, best_v);
        let bv2 = self.builder.ins().select(better, v, best_v);
        let bi2 = self.builder.ins().select(better, i, best_i);
        let inext = self.builder.ins().iadd(i, one);
        self.jump(hdr, &[inext, bv2, bi2]);
        self.builder.seal_block(body);
        self.builder.seal_block(hdr);

        self.enter(exit);
        let r = self.builder.block_params(exit)[0];
        self.builder.seal_block(exit);
        r
    }

    /// Lower a unary f32 scalar math builtin (`exp`, `sqrt`) to a runtime-
    /// symbol call. The IR emits a single call instruction; the symbol
    /// dispatches to a Rust intrinsic.
    fn lower_builtin_scalar_math(
        &mut self,
        sym: &str,
        args: &[CallArg],
        span: &Span,
    ) -> Result<(Value, TyKind), JitError> {
        if args.len() != 1 {
            return err(span, format!("`{}` takes exactly 1 argument", sym));
        }
        let e = match &args[0] {
            CallArg::Positional(e) => e,
            _ => return unsupported(span, "non-positional arg"),
        };
        let (v, k) = self.lower_expr(e)?;
        // #209: scalar transcendentals compute in f64 (match the interpreter).
        let v = self.coerce_to(v, &k, &TyKind::Scalar(ScalarKind::F64), span)?;
        let entry = self.fns.get(sym).expect("scalar math sym not registered").clone();
        let func_ref = self.module.declare_func_in_func(entry.id, self.builder.func);
        let call = self.builder.ins().call(func_ref, &[v]);
        let result = self.builder.inst_results(call)[0];
        Ok((result, TyKind::Scalar(ScalarKind::F64)))
    }

    /// Scalar math builtins that map to a native Cranelift float instruction
    /// rather than a libm call: `abs` → `fabs`, `floor` → `floor`, `ceil` → `ceil`.
    fn lower_builtin_scalar_native_math(
        &mut self,
        op: &str,
        args: &[CallArg],
        span: &Span,
    ) -> Result<(Value, TyKind), JitError> {
        if args.len() != 1 {
            return err(span, format!("`{}` takes exactly 1 argument", op));
        }
        let e = match &args[0] {
            CallArg::Positional(e) => e,
            _ => return unsupported(span, "non-positional arg"),
        };
        let (v, k) = self.lower_expr(e)?;
        // #287: compute in f64, matching the interpreter and the libm path
        // above (#209). Coercing through f32 first rounds the operand and
        // silently diverges from `dmc run` (e.g. ceil(2.00000005)).
        let v = self.coerce_to(v, &k, &TyKind::Scalar(ScalarKind::F64), span)?;
        let result = match op {
            "abs"   => self.builder.ins().fabs(v),
            "floor" => self.builder.ins().floor(v),
            "ceil"  => self.builder.ins().ceil(v),
            _ => return err(span, format!("unknown native scalar-math op `{}`", op)),
        };
        Ok((result, TyKind::Scalar(ScalarKind::F64)))
    }

    /// `f32_to_bits(x)` — reinterpret an f32's 32-bit pattern as an integer,
    /// zero-extended into i64 (#189). No arithmetic conversion.
    fn lower_builtin_f32_to_bits(
        &mut self,
        args: &[CallArg],
        span: &Span,
    ) -> Result<(Value, TyKind), JitError> {
        if args.len() != 1 {
            return err(span, "`f32_to_bits` takes exactly 1 argument");
        }
        let e = match &args[0] {
            CallArg::Positional(e) => e,
            _ => return unsupported(span, "non-positional arg"),
        };
        let (v, k) = self.lower_expr(e)?;
        let v = self.coerce_to(v, &k, &TyKind::Scalar(ScalarKind::F32), span)?;
        let bits = self.builder.ins().bitcast(cl::I32, cranelift::codegen::ir::MemFlagsData::new(), v);
        let wide = self.builder.ins().uextend(cl::I64, bits);
        Ok((wide, TyKind::Scalar(ScalarKind::I64)))
    }

    /// `f32_from_bits(n)` — reinterpret the low 32 bits of an integer as an f32
    /// (#189). Inverse of `f32_to_bits`.
    fn lower_builtin_f32_from_bits(
        &mut self,
        args: &[CallArg],
        span: &Span,
    ) -> Result<(Value, TyKind), JitError> {
        if args.len() != 1 {
            return err(span, "`f32_from_bits` takes exactly 1 argument");
        }
        let e = match &args[0] {
            CallArg::Positional(e) => e,
            _ => return unsupported(span, "non-positional arg"),
        };
        let (v, k) = self.lower_expr(e)?;
        let v = self.coerce_to(v, &k, &TyKind::Scalar(ScalarKind::I64), span)?;
        let narrow = self.builder.ins().ireduce(cl::I32, v);
        let f = self.builder.ins().bitcast(cl::F32, cranelift::codegen::ir::MemFlagsData::new(), narrow);
        Ok((f, TyKind::Scalar(ScalarKind::F32)))
    }

    /// `sum_along(t, axis)` / `mean_along(t, axis)`. `divide=true` selects
    /// the mean form. Supports 2D tensors only in slice 5 — 1D goes
    /// through plain `sum` / `mean`; 3D+ defers to a later slice.
    fn lower_builtin_reduce_along(
        &mut self,
        reduce: ReduceAlong,
        args: &[CallArg],
        span: &Span,
        divide: bool,
    ) -> Result<(Value, TyKind), JitError> {
        let (t_expr, axis) = self.parse_reduce_args(args, span)?;
        let (ptr, ty) = self.lower_expr(t_expr)?;
        let t = ty.as_tensor().ok_or_else(|| JitError {
            msg: "reduce_along requires a tensor argument".into(),
            line: span.line, col: span.col,
        })?.clone();
        if t.elem != ScalarKind::F32 {
            return err(span, "per-axis reductions are f32-only");
        }
        if t.rank() < 2 {
            return err(span, format!(
                "per-axis reductions require rank >= 2 (rank-1 goes through `sum`/`mean`); got rank {}",
                t.rank(),
            ));
        }
        if axis < 0 || axis as usize >= t.rank() {
            return err(span, format!(
                "axis {} out of range for rank-{} tensor", axis, t.rank(),
            ));
        }
        // Result shape = original with `axis` removed.
        let mut out_shape: Vec<i64> = t.shape.clone();
        let div_n = out_shape.remove(axis as usize);
        let out_ty = TensorTy { elem: ScalarKind::F32, shape: out_shape.clone() };
        let out_ptr = self.forge_alloc(out_ty.nbytes());
        let n_out = out_ty.nelems();

        // Row-major reduction over one axis, any rank. `axis_stride` (the stride
        // of the reduced axis) equals `inner_n`, the product of the dims *after*
        // the axis — the kept axes split into `outer` (before) and `inner`
        // (after). An output flat index `k` over the kept axes decomposes as
        // `outer_idx = k / inner_n`, `inner_idx = k % inner_n`, and the source
        // base element is `outer_idx * (div_n * inner_n) + inner_idx`; the inner
        // loop walks the reduced axis with stride `axis_stride`. For rank 2 this
        // is exactly the old `other_stride` path.
        let strides = row_major_strides(&t.shape);
        let axis_stride = strides[axis as usize];
        let inner_n = axis_stride;           // dims strictly after `axis`
        let block = div_n * inner_n;         // one full reduced-axis span

        let zero = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, 0);
        let one = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, 1);
        let n_out_v = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, n_out);
        let div_n_v = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, div_n);
        let axis_stride_v = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, axis_stride);
        let inner_n_v = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, inner_n);
        let block_v = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, block);
        let eb = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, 4);

        // for k in 0..n_out: acc=0; for j in 0..div_n: acc += t[k,j];
        //                   out[k] = acc / div_n (if mean)
        let k_hdr = self.builder.create_block();
        let k_body = self.builder.create_block();
        let k_exit = self.builder.create_block();
        self.builder.append_block_param(k_hdr, cl::I64);
        self.jump(k_hdr, &[zero]);

        self.enter(k_hdr);
        let k = self.builder.block_params(k_hdr)[0];
        let cont_k = self.builder.ins().icmp(IntCC::SignedLessThan, k, n_out_v);
        self.brif(cont_k, k_body, k_exit);

        self.enter(k_body);
        // Compute base byte offset into source for this output index `k`:
        //   base_elem = (k / inner_n) * block + (k % inner_n)
        let outer_idx = self.builder.ins().udiv(k, inner_n_v);
        let inner_idx = self.builder.ins().urem(k, inner_n_v);
        let outer_term = self.builder.ins().imul(outer_idx, block_v);
        let base_elem = self.builder.ins().iadd(outer_term, inner_idx);
        let base_off = self.builder.ins().imul(base_elem, eb);
        let base_addr = self.builder.ins().iadd(ptr, base_off);

        // Sum/mean seed the accumulator at 0; max at -inf; min at +inf.
        let zerof = self.builder.ins().f32const(match reduce {
            ReduceAlong::Add => 0.0_f32,
            ReduceAlong::Max => f32::NEG_INFINITY,
            ReduceAlong::Min => f32::INFINITY,
        });
        let j_hdr = self.builder.create_block();
        let j_body = self.builder.create_block();
        let j_exit = self.builder.create_block();
        self.builder.append_block_param(j_hdr, cl::I64);
        self.builder.append_block_param(j_hdr, cl::F32);
        self.builder.append_block_param(j_exit, cl::F32);

        self.jump(j_hdr, &[zero, zerof]);
        self.enter(j_hdr);
        let j = self.builder.block_params(j_hdr)[0];
        let acc = self.builder.block_params(j_hdr)[1];
        let cont_j = self.builder.ins().icmp(IntCC::SignedLessThan, j, div_n_v);
        self.builder.ins().brif(cont_j, j_body, &[], j_exit, &[acc.into()]);
        self.block_filled = true;

        self.enter(j_body);
        // src offset (elements) = j * axis_stride; bytes = *4
        let j_off_e = self.builder.ins().imul(j, axis_stride_v);
        let j_off = self.builder.ins().imul(j_off_e, eb);
        let v = self.tensor_load_elem(base_addr, j_off, ScalarKind::F32);
        let acc2 = match reduce {
            ReduceAlong::Add => self.builder.ins().fadd(acc, v),
            ReduceAlong::Max => self.builder.ins().fmax(acc, v),
            ReduceAlong::Min => self.builder.ins().fmin(acc, v),
        };
        let jnext = self.builder.ins().iadd(j, one);
        self.jump(j_hdr, &[jnext, acc2]);
        self.builder.seal_block(j_body);
        self.builder.seal_block(j_hdr);

        self.enter(j_exit);
        let total = self.builder.block_params(j_exit)[0];
        self.builder.seal_block(j_exit);

        let final_v = if divide {
            let n_v = self.builder.ins().f32const(div_n as f32);
            self.builder.ins().fdiv(total, n_v)
        } else {
            total
        };
        // Store at out[k]
        let k_off_b = self.builder.ins().imul(k, eb);
        self.tensor_store_elem(out_ptr, k_off_b, final_v);
        let knext = self.builder.ins().iadd(k, one);
        self.jump(k_hdr, &[knext]);
        self.builder.seal_block(k_body);
        self.builder.seal_block(k_hdr);

        self.enter(k_exit);
        self.builder.seal_block(k_exit);

        Ok((out_ptr, TyKind::Tensor(out_ty)))
    }

    fn parse_reduce_args<'b>(
        &self,
        args: &'b [CallArg],
        span: &Span,
    ) -> Result<(&'b Expr, i64), JitError> {
        if args.len() != 2 {
            return err(span, "expected (tensor, axis)");
        }
        let (t_expr, a_expr) = match (&args[0], &args[1]) {
            (CallArg::Positional(t), CallArg::Positional(a)) => (t, a),
            _ => return unsupported(span, "non-positional args"),
        };
        let axis = match a_expr {
            Expr::Literal(Literal::Int(n, _), _) => *n,
            _ => return err(span, "axis must be a literal int in slice 5"),
        };
        Ok((t_expr, axis))
    }

    /// `variance_along(t, axis)` — population variance per kept index.
    fn lower_builtin_variance_along(
        &mut self,
        args: &[CallArg],
        span: &Span,
    ) -> Result<(Value, TyKind), JitError> {
        // First pass: means_along.
        let (means_ptr, means_ty) = self.lower_builtin_reduce_along(
            ReduceAlong::Add, args, span, /*divide=*/ true,
        )?;
        // Second pass: sum of squared deviations, divided by div_n.
        let (t_expr, axis) = self.parse_reduce_args(args, span)?;
        let (ptr, ty) = self.lower_expr(t_expr)?;
        let t = ty.as_tensor().expect("validated").clone();
        let _ = means_ty;
        let strides = row_major_strides(&t.shape);
        let axis_stride = strides[axis as usize];
        let other_axis = (1 - axis) as usize;
        let other_stride = strides[other_axis];

        let mut out_shape = t.shape.clone();
        let div_n = out_shape.remove(axis as usize);
        let out_ty = TensorTy { elem: ScalarKind::F32, shape: out_shape };
        let out_ptr = self.forge_alloc(out_ty.nbytes());
        let n_out = out_ty.nelems();

        let zero = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, 0);
        let one = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, 1);
        let eb = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, 4);
        let n_out_v = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, n_out);
        let div_n_v = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, div_n);
        let axis_stride_v = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, axis_stride);
        let other_stride_v = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, other_stride);
        let div_n_f = self.builder.ins().f32const(div_n as f32);

        let k_hdr = self.builder.create_block();
        let k_body = self.builder.create_block();
        let k_exit = self.builder.create_block();
        self.builder.append_block_param(k_hdr, cl::I64);
        self.jump(k_hdr, &[zero]);

        self.enter(k_hdr);
        let k = self.builder.block_params(k_hdr)[0];
        let cont_k = self.builder.ins().icmp(IntCC::SignedLessThan, k, n_out_v);
        self.brif(cont_k, k_body, k_exit);

        self.enter(k_body);
        let k_off_b = self.builder.ins().imul(k, eb);
        let mean_k = self.tensor_load_elem(means_ptr, k_off_b, ScalarKind::F32);
        let base_elem = self.builder.ins().imul(k, other_stride_v);
        let base_off = self.builder.ins().imul(base_elem, eb);
        let base_addr = self.builder.ins().iadd(ptr, base_off);

        let zerof = self.builder.ins().f32const(0.0_f32);
        let j_hdr = self.builder.create_block();
        let j_body = self.builder.create_block();
        let j_exit = self.builder.create_block();
        self.builder.append_block_param(j_hdr, cl::I64);
        self.builder.append_block_param(j_hdr, cl::F32);
        self.builder.append_block_param(j_exit, cl::F32);

        self.jump(j_hdr, &[zero, zerof]);
        self.enter(j_hdr);
        let j = self.builder.block_params(j_hdr)[0];
        let acc = self.builder.block_params(j_hdr)[1];
        let cont_j = self.builder.ins().icmp(IntCC::SignedLessThan, j, div_n_v);
        self.builder.ins().brif(cont_j, j_body, &[], j_exit, &[acc.into()]);
        self.block_filled = true;

        self.enter(j_body);
        let j_off_e = self.builder.ins().imul(j, axis_stride_v);
        let j_off = self.builder.ins().imul(j_off_e, eb);
        let v = self.tensor_load_elem(base_addr, j_off, ScalarKind::F32);
        let d = self.builder.ins().fsub(v, mean_k);
        let dsq = self.builder.ins().fmul(d, d);
        let acc2 = self.builder.ins().fadd(acc, dsq);
        let jnext = self.builder.ins().iadd(j, one);
        self.jump(j_hdr, &[jnext, acc2]);
        self.builder.seal_block(j_body);
        self.builder.seal_block(j_hdr);

        self.enter(j_exit);
        let total = self.builder.block_params(j_exit)[0];
        self.builder.seal_block(j_exit);

        let var_k = self.builder.ins().fdiv(total, div_n_f);
        self.tensor_store_elem(out_ptr, k_off_b, var_k);
        let knext = self.builder.ins().iadd(k, one);
        self.jump(k_hdr, &[knext]);
        self.builder.seal_block(k_body);
        self.builder.seal_block(k_hdr);

        self.enter(k_exit);
        self.builder.seal_block(k_exit);

        Ok((out_ptr, TyKind::Tensor(out_ty)))
    }

    /// `pull_to_mean_along(t, axis, alpha)` — per-axis variance trait.
    /// Implements `out[i, j] = t[i, j] + alpha * (mean[k] - t[i, j])`
    /// where `k` is the kept-axis index. Slice 5: 2D only.
    fn lower_builtin_pull_to_mean_along(
        &mut self,
        args: &[CallArg],
        span: &Span,
    ) -> Result<(Value, TyKind), JitError> {
        if args.len() != 3 {
            return err(span, "`pull_to_mean_along` takes (tensor, axis, alpha)");
        }
        let (t_expr, a_expr, alpha_expr) = match (&args[0], &args[1], &args[2]) {
            (CallArg::Positional(t), CallArg::Positional(a), CallArg::Positional(al)) =>
                (t, a, al),
            _ => return unsupported(span, "non-positional args"),
        };
        let axis = match a_expr {
            Expr::Literal(Literal::Int(n, _), _) => *n,
            _ => return err(span, "axis must be a literal int"),
        };

        // Compute means_along(t, axis) — reuse via constructing args.
        let reduce_args = vec![args[0].clone(), args[1].clone()];
        let (means_ptr, _) = self.lower_builtin_reduce_along(
            ReduceAlong::Add, &reduce_args, span, true,
        )?;

        // Re-lower the source tensor.
        let (ptr, ty) = self.lower_expr(t_expr)?;
        let t = ty.as_tensor().expect("validated").clone();
        if t.rank() != 2 {
            return err(span, "`pull_to_mean_along` requires a 2D tensor in slice 5");
        }
        let (alpha, alpha_ty) = self.lower_expr(alpha_expr)?;
        let alpha = self.coerce_to(alpha, &alpha_ty, &TyKind::Scalar(ScalarKind::F32), span)?;

        let strides = row_major_strides(&t.shape);
        let axis_stride = strides[axis as usize];
        let other_axis = (1 - axis) as usize;
        let other_stride = strides[other_axis];
        let div_n = t.shape[axis as usize];
        let n_out = t.shape[other_axis];

        let out_ty = t.clone();
        let out_ptr = self.forge_alloc(out_ty.nbytes());

        let zero = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, 0);
        let one = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, 1);
        let eb = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, 4);
        let n_out_v = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, n_out);
        let div_n_v = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, div_n);
        let axis_stride_v = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, axis_stride);
        let other_stride_v = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, other_stride);

        let k_hdr = self.builder.create_block();
        let k_body = self.builder.create_block();
        let k_exit = self.builder.create_block();
        self.builder.append_block_param(k_hdr, cl::I64);
        self.jump(k_hdr, &[zero]);

        self.enter(k_hdr);
        let k = self.builder.block_params(k_hdr)[0];
        let cont_k = self.builder.ins().icmp(IntCC::SignedLessThan, k, n_out_v);
        self.brif(cont_k, k_body, k_exit);

        self.enter(k_body);
        let k_off_b = self.builder.ins().imul(k, eb);
        let mean_k = self.tensor_load_elem(means_ptr, k_off_b, ScalarKind::F32);
        let base_elem = self.builder.ins().imul(k, other_stride_v);
        let base_off = self.builder.ins().imul(base_elem, eb);
        let base_in = self.builder.ins().iadd(ptr, base_off);
        let base_out = self.builder.ins().iadd(out_ptr, base_off);

        let j_hdr = self.builder.create_block();
        let j_body = self.builder.create_block();
        let j_exit = self.builder.create_block();
        self.builder.append_block_param(j_hdr, cl::I64);
        self.jump(j_hdr, &[zero]);

        self.enter(j_hdr);
        let j = self.builder.block_params(j_hdr)[0];
        let cont_j = self.builder.ins().icmp(IntCC::SignedLessThan, j, div_n_v);
        self.brif(cont_j, j_body, j_exit);

        self.enter(j_body);
        let j_off_e = self.builder.ins().imul(j, axis_stride_v);
        let j_off = self.builder.ins().imul(j_off_e, eb);
        let v = self.tensor_load_elem(base_in, j_off, ScalarKind::F32);
        let delta = self.builder.ins().fsub(mean_k, v);
        let pull = self.builder.ins().fmul(alpha, delta);
        let new = self.builder.ins().fadd(v, pull);
        self.tensor_store_elem(base_out, j_off, new);
        let jnext = self.builder.ins().iadd(j, one);
        self.jump(j_hdr, &[jnext]);
        self.builder.seal_block(j_body);
        self.builder.seal_block(j_hdr);

        self.enter(j_exit);
        self.builder.seal_block(j_exit);
        let knext = self.builder.ins().iadd(k, one);
        self.jump(k_hdr, &[knext]);
        self.builder.seal_block(k_body);
        self.builder.seal_block(k_hdr);

        self.enter(k_exit);
        self.builder.seal_block(k_exit);

        Ok((out_ptr, TyKind::Tensor(out_ty)))
    }

    /// `softmax(t)` — naive (no max stability yet) over a 1D vector.
    /// out[i] = exp(t[i]) / sum(exp(t)). 2D inputs apply per-row.
    /// Stable max-subtraction lands when `max_along` arrives.
    fn lower_builtin_softmax(
        &mut self,
        args: &[CallArg],
        span: &Span,
    ) -> Result<(Value, TyKind), JitError> {
        // `softmax(t)` or `softmax(t, axis)`. The optional axis selects the
        // reduction axis; only the last axis (-1 / rank-1) is supported, which
        // is what attention needs (`softmax(scores, -1)`). For static 1-D
        // tensors the axis is implicit. For KV / dynamic-shape tensors we
        // reduce over a *runtime*-length last axis (issue #176 part 2).
        if args.is_empty() || args.len() > 2 {
            return err(span, "`softmax` takes (t) or (t, axis)");
        }
        let e = match &args[0] {
            CallArg::Positional(e) => e,
            _ => return unsupported(span, "non-positional arg"),
        };
        let (ptr, ty) = self.lower_expr(e)?;

        // A KV cache or dynamic-shape tensor reduces over its runtime last
        // axis. Materialize a KV to a contiguous DynTensor first, then run a
        // runtime-bounded per-row softmax in place on the fresh buffer.
        match &ty {
            TyKind::KV(kv) if kv.elem == ScalarKind::F32 => {
                let kv = kv.clone();
                let (out, dt) = self.kv_materialize(ptr, &kv);
                self.softmax_dyn_last_axis(out, &dt, args, span)?;
                return Ok((out, TyKind::DynTensor(dt)));
            }
            TyKind::DynTensor(dt) if dt.elem == ScalarKind::F32 => {
                // Copy into a fresh DynTensor of the same dynamic shape so we
                // don't mutate the caller's buffer, then softmax in place.
                let dt = dt.clone();
                let out = self.dyn_copy(ptr, &dt);
                self.softmax_dyn_last_axis(out, &dt, args, span)?;
                return Ok((out, TyKind::DynTensor(dt)));
            }
            TyKind::KV(_) | TyKind::DynTensor(_) =>
                return err(span, "softmax is f32-only"),
            _ => {}
        }

        let t = ty.as_tensor().ok_or_else(|| JitError {
            msg: "softmax requires a tensor".into(),
            line: span.line, col: span.col,
        })?.clone();
        if t.elem != ScalarKind::F32 {
            return err(span, "softmax is f32-only in slice 5");
        }
        // Static rank ≥ 2: per-row softmax over the LAST axis (the attention
        // case, `softmax(scores, -1)`). Copy so we don't mutate the input, then
        // softmax each row in place via the shared stable per-row helper. Only
        // the last axis is supported; an explicit non-last axis bails.
        if t.rank() >= 2 {
            let last = (t.rank() - 1) as i64;
            if let Some(ax) = args.get(1) {
                if let CallArg::Positional(ae) = ax {
                    if let Some(a) = const_int_axis(ae) {
                        let norm = if a < 0 { a + t.rank() as i64 } else { a };
                        if norm != last {
                            return unsupported(span,
                                "JIT softmax reduces over the last axis only; \
                                 a non-last axis needs `dmc run`");
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            let l = t.shape[t.rank() - 1];
            let rows = t.nelems() / l;
            let out_ty = t.clone();
            let out_ptr = self.copy_tensor_value(ptr, &TyKind::Tensor(t.clone()));
            let rows_v = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, rows);
            let l_v = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, l);
            self.softmax_rows_v(out_ptr, rows_v, l_v);
            return Ok((out_ptr, TyKind::Tensor(out_ty)));
        }
        let n = t.nelems();
        let out_ty = t.clone();
        let out_ptr = self.forge_alloc(out_ty.nbytes());
        let exp_entry = self.fns.get("__dmc_exp_f32").expect("registered").clone();
        let exp_ref = self.module.declare_func_in_func(exp_entry.id, self.builder.func);

        // #258: numerically-stable, ±inf-aware softmax (matches the interpreter
        // and the dynamic/attention path `softmax_rows_v`). Pass 0 takes the
        // max; Pass 1 applies the 3-way weight rule (masked row → 0, argmax → 1,
        // else exp(x-max)); Pass 2 divides, guarding a fully-masked row's 0/0.
        // For finite in-range inputs this is identical to the old naive
        // exp(x)/sum — but it no longer overflows on large logits or yields
        // NaN on a +inf entry.
        let zero = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, 0);
        let one = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, 1);
        let eb = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, 4);
        let n_v = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, n);
        let zerof = self.builder.ins().f32const(0.0_f32);
        let onef = self.builder.ins().f32const(1.0_f32);
        let neg_inf = self.builder.ins().f32const(f32::NEG_INFINITY);

        // Pass 0: max over t.
        let h0 = self.builder.create_block();
        let b0 = self.builder.create_block();
        let e0 = self.builder.create_block();
        self.builder.append_block_param(h0, cl::I64);
        self.builder.append_block_param(h0, cl::F32);
        self.builder.append_block_param(e0, cl::F32);
        self.jump(h0, &[zero, neg_inf]);
        self.enter(h0);
        let mi = self.builder.block_params(h0)[0];
        let mx = self.builder.block_params(h0)[1];
        let cm = self.builder.ins().icmp(IntCC::SignedLessThan, mi, n_v);
        self.builder.ins().brif(cm, b0, &[], e0, &[mx.into()]);
        self.block_filled = true;
        self.enter(b0);
        let moff = self.builder.ins().imul(mi, eb);
        let mv = self.tensor_load_elem(ptr, moff, ScalarKind::F32);
        let mx2 = self.builder.ins().fmax(mx, mv);
        let minext = self.builder.ins().iadd(mi, one);
        self.jump(h0, &[minext, mx2]);
        self.builder.seal_block(b0);
        self.builder.seal_block(h0);
        self.enter(e0);
        let max_val = self.builder.block_params(e0)[0];
        self.builder.seal_block(e0);
        // Whole-row mask: max == -inf.
        let masked = self.builder.ins().fcmp(FloatCC::Equal, max_val, neg_inf);

        // Pass 1: w[i] = masked ? 0 : (x_i==max ? 1 : exp(x_i-max)); acc = sum.
        let h1 = self.builder.create_block();
        let b1 = self.builder.create_block();
        let e1 = self.builder.create_block();
        self.builder.append_block_param(h1, cl::I64);
        self.builder.append_block_param(h1, cl::F32);
        self.builder.append_block_param(e1, cl::F32);

        self.jump(h1, &[zero, zerof]);
        self.enter(h1);
        let i = self.builder.block_params(h1)[0];
        let acc = self.builder.block_params(h1)[1];
        let c = self.builder.ins().icmp(IntCC::SignedLessThan, i, n_v);
        self.builder.ins().brif(c, b1, &[], e1, &[acc.into()]);
        self.block_filled = true;

        self.enter(b1);
        let off = self.builder.ins().imul(i, eb);
        let v = self.tensor_load_elem(ptr, off, ScalarKind::F32);
        let sh = self.builder.ins().fsub(v, max_val);
        let call = self.builder.ins().call(exp_ref, &[sh]);
        let ev = self.builder.inst_results(call)[0];
        // argmax (incl. +inf) → exactly 1, avoiding +inf-+inf = NaN through exp.
        let is_argmax = self.builder.ins().fcmp(FloatCC::Equal, v, max_val);
        let w_argmax = self.builder.ins().select(is_argmax, onef, ev);
        let w = self.builder.ins().select(masked, zerof, w_argmax);
        self.tensor_store_elem(out_ptr, off, w);
        let acc2 = self.builder.ins().fadd(acc, w);
        let inext = self.builder.ins().iadd(i, one);
        self.jump(h1, &[inext, acc2]);
        self.builder.seal_block(b1);
        self.builder.seal_block(h1);

        self.enter(e1);
        let total = self.builder.block_params(e1)[0];
        self.builder.seal_block(e1);
        // Fully-masked row → sum 0; output 0 instead of 0/0 = NaN.
        let sum_zero = self.builder.ins().fcmp(FloatCC::Equal, total, zerof);

        // Pass 2: out[i] = sum_zero ? 0 : out[i] / total.
        let h2 = self.builder.create_block();
        let b2 = self.builder.create_block();
        let e2 = self.builder.create_block();
        self.builder.append_block_param(h2, cl::I64);
        self.jump(h2, &[zero]);
        self.enter(h2);
        let i2 = self.builder.block_params(h2)[0];
        let c2 = self.builder.ins().icmp(IntCC::SignedLessThan, i2, n_v);
        self.brif(c2, b2, e2);

        self.enter(b2);
        let off2 = self.builder.ins().imul(i2, eb);
        let v2 = self.tensor_load_elem(out_ptr, off2, ScalarKind::F32);
        let qd = self.builder.ins().fdiv(v2, total);
        let q = self.builder.ins().select(sum_zero, zerof, qd);
        self.tensor_store_elem(out_ptr, off2, q);
        let i2n = self.builder.ins().iadd(i2, one);
        self.jump(h2, &[i2n]);
        self.builder.seal_block(b2);
        self.builder.seal_block(h2);

        self.enter(e2);
        self.builder.seal_block(e2);

        Ok((out_ptr, TyKind::Tensor(out_ty)))
    }

    /// `rms_norm(x, g, eps)` over a 1D vector:
    ///     ms    = mean(x .* x)
    ///     scale = 1 / sqrt(ms + eps)
    ///     out   = x .* g .* scale
    /// #276: `embed(vocab[V, D], ids)` — embedding gather. For each (integer) id
    /// in `ids`, copy row `vocab[clamp(id, 0, V-1)]` (D elems). Output shape is
    /// `ids.shape ++ [D]`, element type f32 (vocab's). A flat loop over the
    /// `N*D` output elements: element k belongs to id-position `k/D`, column
    /// `k%D`. Matches `builtin_embed`.
    fn lower_builtin_embed(&mut self, args: &[CallArg], span: &Span)
        -> Result<(Value, TyKind), JitError>
    {
        if args.len() != 2 {
            return err(span, "`embed` takes (vocab[V, D], ids)");
        }
        let (vp, vty) = match &args[0] {
            CallArg::Positional(e) => self.lower_expr(e)?,
            _ => return unsupported(span, "non-positional arg to `embed`"),
        };
        // #324: a bf16 weight as the embedding table — upconvert to f32 first.
        let (vp, vty) = match &vty {
            TyKind::Bf16Tensor(bt) => self.bf16_upconvert(vp, &bt.clone()),
            _ => (vp, vty),
        };
        let (ip, ity) = match &args[1] {
            CallArg::Positional(e) => self.lower_expr(e)?,
            _ => return unsupported(span, "non-positional arg to `embed`"),
        };
        let vt = match vty {
            TyKind::Tensor(t) if t.elem == ScalarKind::F32 && t.shape.len() == 2 => t,
            _ => return err(span, "`embed`: vocab must be a 2-D f32 tensor [V, D]"),
        };
        let it = match ity {
            TyKind::Tensor(t) if matches!(t.elem, ScalarKind::I64 | ScalarKind::I32) => t,
            _ => return err(span, "`embed`: ids must be an integer tensor"),
        };
        let (v_size, d_size) = (vt.shape[0], vt.shape[1]);
        let n_ids = it.nelems();
        let id_eb = it.elem_bytes();

        let mut out_shape = it.shape.clone();
        out_shape.push(d_size);
        let out_ty = TensorTy { elem: ScalarKind::F32, shape: out_shape };
        let out_ptr = self.forge_alloc(out_ty.nbytes());
        let total = n_ids * d_size;

        let zero = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, 0);
        let one = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, 1);
        let four = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, 4);
        let d_c = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, d_size);
        let vmax = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, v_size - 1);
        let cap = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, total);

        let hdr = self.builder.create_block();
        let body = self.builder.create_block();
        let exit = self.builder.create_block();
        self.builder.append_block_param(hdr, cl::I64);
        self.jump(hdr, &[zero]);
        self.enter(hdr);
        let k = self.builder.block_params(hdr)[0];
        let cont = self.builder.ins().icmp(IntCC::SignedLessThan, k, cap);
        self.brif(cont, body, exit);
        self.builder.seal_block(exit);

        self.enter(body);
        let id_pos = self.builder.ins().udiv(k, d_c);
        let col = self.builder.ins().urem(k, d_c);
        // load the id (i32/i64) and sign-extend to i64
        let id_eb_c = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, id_eb);
        let id_off = self.builder.ins().imul(id_pos, id_eb_c);
        let id_raw = self.tensor_load_elem(ip, id_off, it.elem);
        let id = if it.elem == ScalarKind::I32 {
            self.builder.ins().sextend(cl::I64, id_raw)
        } else { id_raw };
        // clamp to [0, V-1]
        let neg = self.builder.ins().icmp(IntCC::SignedLessThan, id, zero);
        let id1 = self.builder.ins().select(neg, zero, id);
        let hi = self.builder.ins().icmp(IntCC::SignedGreaterThan, id1, vmax);
        let id2 = self.builder.ins().select(hi, vmax, id1);
        // src element = id*D + col ; copy vocab[src] -> out[k]
        let id_d = self.builder.ins().imul(id2, d_c);
        let src_elem = self.builder.ins().iadd(id_d, col);
        let src_byte = self.builder.ins().imul(src_elem, four);
        let out_byte = self.builder.ins().imul(k, four);
        let val = self.tensor_load_elem(vp, src_byte, ScalarKind::F32);
        self.tensor_store_elem(out_ptr, out_byte, val);
        let knext = self.builder.ins().iadd(k, one);
        self.jump(hdr, &[knext]);
        self.builder.seal_block(body);
        self.builder.seal_block(hdr);

        self.enter(exit);
        Ok((out_ptr, TyKind::Tensor(out_ty)))
    }

    fn lower_builtin_rms_norm(
        &mut self,
        args: &[CallArg],
        span: &Span,
    ) -> Result<(Value, TyKind), JitError> {
        if args.len() != 3 {
            return err(span, "`rms_norm` takes (x, g, eps)");
        }
        let (x_e, g_e, eps_e) = match (&args[0], &args[1], &args[2]) {
            (CallArg::Positional(a), CallArg::Positional(b), CallArg::Positional(c))
                => (a, b, c),
            _ => return unsupported(span, "non-positional args"),
        };
        let (x_ptr, x_ty) = self.lower_expr(x_e)?;
        let (g_ptr, g_ty) = self.lower_expr(g_e)?;
        // #324: the gain `g` is a bf16 weight field — upconvert to f32.
        let (g_ptr, g_ty) = match &g_ty {
            TyKind::Bf16Tensor(bt) => self.bf16_upconvert(g_ptr, &bt.clone()),
            _ => (g_ptr, g_ty),
        };
        let (eps, eps_ty) = self.lower_expr(eps_e)?;
        let eps = self.coerce_to(eps, &eps_ty, &TyKind::Scalar(ScalarKind::F32), span)?;
        let xt = x_ty.as_tensor().ok_or_else(|| JitError {
            msg: "rms_norm: x must be a tensor".into(),
            line: span.line, col: span.col,
        })?.clone();
        let gt = g_ty.as_tensor().ok_or_else(|| JitError {
            msg: "rms_norm: g must be a tensor".into(),
            line: span.line, col: span.col,
        })?.clone();
        // #276: normalize over the LAST axis. x is [outer..., D]; g is the
        // rank-1 gain of length D, broadcast across each row. (1D x is the
        // single-row case, unchanged.)
        let d_size = *xt.shape.last().unwrap();
        if gt.rank() != 1 || gt.nelems() != d_size {
            return err(span, format!(
                "rms_norm: gain must be rank-1 of length {} (x's last axis), got shape {:?}",
                d_size, gt.shape));
        }
        let outer = xt.nelems() / d_size;
        let out_ty = xt.clone();
        let out_ptr = self.forge_alloc(out_ty.nbytes());

        // Outer loop over rows; each row is normalized over its D elements.
        let zero = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, 0);
        let one = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, 1);
        let d_c = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, d_size);
        let outer_c = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, outer);
        let oh = self.builder.create_block();
        let ob = self.builder.create_block();
        let oe = self.builder.create_block();
        self.builder.append_block_param(oh, cl::I64);
        self.jump(oh, &[zero]);
        self.enter(oh);
        let r = self.builder.block_params(oh)[0];
        let oc = self.builder.ins().icmp(IntCC::SignedLessThan, r, outer_c);
        self.brif(oc, ob, oe);
        self.builder.seal_block(oe);

        self.enter(ob);
        let row_base = self.builder.ins().imul(r, d_c);
        self.rms_norm_one_row(x_ptr, g_ptr, out_ptr, row_base, d_size, eps);
        let rnext = self.builder.ins().iadd(r, one);
        self.jump(oh, &[rnext]);
        self.builder.seal_block(ob);
        self.builder.seal_block(oh);

        self.enter(oe);
        Ok((out_ptr, TyKind::Tensor(out_ty)))
    }

    /// #276: rms-normalize one row of `d` f32 elements starting at element offset
    /// `row_base`: `out[k] = x[k] * g[k] / sqrt(mean(x^2) + eps)`. Two passes over
    /// the row; `g` is indexed 0..d (broadcast across rows).
    fn rms_norm_one_row(&mut self, x_ptr: Value, g_ptr: Value, out_ptr: Value,
                        row_base: Value, d: i64, eps: Value) {
        let zero = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, 0);
        let one = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, 1);
        let eb = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, 4);
        let d_v = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, d);
        let d_f = self.builder.ins().f32const(d as f32);
        let zerof = self.builder.ins().f32const(0.0_f32);

        // Pass 1: acc = Σ x[row_base + k]^2
        let h1 = self.builder.create_block();
        let b1 = self.builder.create_block();
        let e1 = self.builder.create_block();
        self.builder.append_block_param(h1, cl::I64);
        self.builder.append_block_param(h1, cl::F32);
        self.builder.append_block_param(e1, cl::F32);
        self.jump(h1, &[zero, zerof]);
        self.enter(h1);
        let i = self.builder.block_params(h1)[0];
        let acc = self.builder.block_params(h1)[1];
        let c = self.builder.ins().icmp(IntCC::SignedLessThan, i, d_v);
        self.builder.ins().brif(c, b1, &[], e1, &[acc.into()]);
        self.block_filled = true;
        self.enter(b1);
        let elem = self.builder.ins().iadd(row_base, i);
        let off = self.builder.ins().imul(elem, eb);
        let xv = self.tensor_load_elem(x_ptr, off, ScalarKind::F32);
        let sq = self.builder.ins().fmul(xv, xv);
        let acc2 = self.builder.ins().fadd(acc, sq);
        let inext = self.builder.ins().iadd(i, one);
        self.jump(h1, &[inext, acc2]);
        self.builder.seal_block(b1);
        self.builder.seal_block(h1);
        self.enter(e1);
        let total = self.builder.block_params(e1)[0];
        self.builder.seal_block(e1);

        let ms = self.builder.ins().fdiv(total, d_f);
        let ms_eps = self.builder.ins().fadd(ms, eps);
        let sqrt_entry = self.fns.get("__dmc_sqrt_f32").expect("registered").clone();
        let sqrt_ref = self.module.declare_func_in_func(sqrt_entry.id, self.builder.func);
        let call = self.builder.ins().call(sqrt_ref, &[ms_eps]);
        let denom = self.builder.inst_results(call)[0];
        let onef = self.builder.ins().f32const(1.0_f32);
        let scale = self.builder.ins().fdiv(onef, denom);

        // Pass 2: out[row_base + k] = x[row_base + k] * g[k] * scale
        let h2 = self.builder.create_block();
        let b2 = self.builder.create_block();
        let e2 = self.builder.create_block();
        self.builder.append_block_param(h2, cl::I64);
        self.jump(h2, &[zero]);
        self.enter(h2);
        let k = self.builder.block_params(h2)[0];
        let c2 = self.builder.ins().icmp(IntCC::SignedLessThan, k, d_v);
        self.brif(c2, b2, e2);
        self.enter(b2);
        let xelem = self.builder.ins().iadd(row_base, k);
        let xoff = self.builder.ins().imul(xelem, eb);
        let goff = self.builder.ins().imul(k, eb);
        let xv2 = self.tensor_load_elem(x_ptr, xoff, ScalarKind::F32);
        let gv = self.tensor_load_elem(g_ptr, goff, ScalarKind::F32);
        let xg = self.builder.ins().fmul(xv2, gv);
        let res = self.builder.ins().fmul(xg, scale);
        self.tensor_store_elem(out_ptr, xoff, res);
        let knext = self.builder.ins().iadd(k, one);
        self.jump(h2, &[knext]);
        self.builder.seal_block(b2);
        self.builder.seal_block(h2);
        self.enter(e2);
        self.builder.seal_block(e2);
    }

    /// Per-row layer-norm statistics: returns `(mean, scale)` where
    /// `scale = 1/sqrt(var + eps)`, computed with the numerically-stable centered
    /// two-pass (mean, then `Σ(x−mean)²`) that the interpreter reference uses.
    /// Shared by the forward and backward so both recompute `std` identically.
    fn layer_norm_row_stats(&mut self, x_ptr: Value, row_base: Value, d: i64, eps: Value)
        -> (Value, Value)
    {
        let zero = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, 0);
        let one = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, 1);
        let eb = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, 4);
        let d_v = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, d);
        let d_f = self.builder.ins().f32const(d as f32);
        let zerof = self.builder.ins().f32const(0.0_f32);

        // Pass 1: sum_x → mean.
        let m_hdr = self.builder.create_block();
        let m_body = self.builder.create_block();
        let m_exit = self.builder.create_block();
        self.builder.append_block_param(m_hdr, cl::I64);
        self.builder.append_block_param(m_hdr, cl::F32);
        self.builder.append_block_param(m_exit, cl::F32);
        self.jump(m_hdr, &[zero, zerof]);
        self.enter(m_hdr);
        let mi = self.builder.block_params(m_hdr)[0];
        let macc = self.builder.block_params(m_hdr)[1];
        let mc = self.builder.ins().icmp(IntCC::SignedLessThan, mi, d_v);
        self.builder.ins().brif(mc, m_body, &[], m_exit, &[macc.into()]);
        self.block_filled = true;
        self.enter(m_body);
        let melem = self.builder.ins().iadd(row_base, mi);
        let moff = self.builder.ins().imul(melem, eb);
        let mxv = self.tensor_load_elem(x_ptr, moff, ScalarKind::F32);
        let macc2 = self.builder.ins().fadd(macc, mxv);
        let min = self.builder.ins().iadd(mi, one);
        self.jump(m_hdr, &[min, macc2]);
        self.builder.seal_block(m_body);
        self.builder.seal_block(m_hdr);
        self.enter(m_exit);
        let sum_x = self.builder.block_params(m_exit)[0];
        self.builder.seal_block(m_exit);
        let mean = self.builder.ins().fdiv(sum_x, d_f);

        // Pass 2: var = Σ(x − mean)² / d.
        let v_hdr = self.builder.create_block();
        let v_body = self.builder.create_block();
        let v_exit = self.builder.create_block();
        self.builder.append_block_param(v_hdr, cl::I64);
        self.builder.append_block_param(v_hdr, cl::F32);
        self.builder.append_block_param(v_exit, cl::F32);
        self.jump(v_hdr, &[zero, zerof]);
        self.enter(v_hdr);
        let vi = self.builder.block_params(v_hdr)[0];
        let vacc = self.builder.block_params(v_hdr)[1];
        let vc = self.builder.ins().icmp(IntCC::SignedLessThan, vi, d_v);
        self.builder.ins().brif(vc, v_body, &[], v_exit, &[vacc.into()]);
