        self.block_filled = true;
        self.enter(v_body);
        let velem = self.builder.ins().iadd(row_base, vi);
        let voff = self.builder.ins().imul(velem, eb);
        let vxv = self.tensor_load_elem(x_ptr, voff, ScalarKind::F32);
        let vd = self.builder.ins().fsub(vxv, mean);
        let vsq = self.builder.ins().fmul(vd, vd);
        let vacc2 = self.builder.ins().fadd(vacc, vsq);
        let vin = self.builder.ins().iadd(vi, one);
        self.jump(v_hdr, &[vin, vacc2]);
        self.builder.seal_block(v_body);
        self.builder.seal_block(v_hdr);
        self.enter(v_exit);
        let var_total = self.builder.block_params(v_exit)[0];
        self.builder.seal_block(v_exit);
        let var = self.builder.ins().fdiv(var_total, d_f);
        let var_eps = self.builder.ins().fadd(var, eps);
        let std = self.call_f32_math("__dmc_sqrt_f32", var_eps);
        let onef = self.builder.ins().f32const(1.0_f32);
        let scale = self.builder.ins().fdiv(onef, std);
        (mean, scale)
    }

    /// Forward `layer_norm` over one row `x[row_base .. row_base+d]` with rank-1
    /// `gain`/`bias` `[d]` (#368). Centered two-pass (mean, then Σ(x−mean)²) to
    /// match the interpreter reference, then affine:
    ///     out[k] = (x[k] - mean) / sqrt(var + eps) * gain[k] + bias[k]
    fn layer_norm_one_row(&mut self, x_ptr: Value, g_ptr: Value, b_ptr: Value,
                          out_ptr: Value, row_base: Value, d: i64, eps: Value) {
        let (mean, scale) = self.layer_norm_row_stats(x_ptr, row_base, d, eps);

        // Affine pass: out[k] = (x[k] − mean) * scale * g[k] + b[k]
        let zero = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, 0);
        let one = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, 1);
        let eb = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, 4);
        let d_v = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, d);
        let h2 = self.builder.create_block();
        let b2 = self.builder.create_block();
        let e2 = self.builder.create_block();
        self.builder.append_block_param(h2, cl::I64);
        self.jump(h2, &[zero]);
        self.enter(h2);
        let k = self.builder.block_params(h2)[0];
        let c2 = self.builder.ins().icmp(IntCC::SignedLessThan, k, d_v);
        self.brif(c2, b2, e2);
        self.enter(b2);
        let xelem = self.builder.ins().iadd(row_base, k);
        let xoff = self.builder.ins().imul(xelem, eb);
        let goff = self.builder.ins().imul(k, eb);
        let xv2 = self.tensor_load_elem(x_ptr, xoff, ScalarKind::F32);
        let gv = self.tensor_load_elem(g_ptr, goff, ScalarKind::F32);
        let bv = self.tensor_load_elem(b_ptr, goff, ScalarKind::F32);
        let cen = self.builder.ins().fsub(xv2, mean);
        let scaled = self.builder.ins().fmul(cen, scale);
        let ag = self.builder.ins().fmul(scaled, gv);
        let res = self.builder.ins().fadd(ag, bv);
        self.tensor_store_elem(out_ptr, xoff, res);
        let knext = self.builder.ins().iadd(k, one);
        self.jump(h2, &[knext]);
        self.builder.seal_block(b2);
        self.builder.seal_block(h2);
        self.enter(e2);
        self.builder.seal_block(e2);
    }

    /// `layer_norm(x, g, b, eps)` over the LAST axis of `x` (`[outer…, D]`),
    /// with rank-1 `g`/`b` of length D broadcast across rows (#368):
    ///     m     = mean(row)   v = variance(row)   scale = 1 / sqrt(v + eps)
    ///     out   = (row - m) * scale * g + b
    /// 1D x is the single-row case. One `layer_norm_one_row` call per row.
    fn lower_builtin_layer_norm(
        &mut self,
        args: &[CallArg],
        span: &Span,
    ) -> Result<(Value, TyKind), JitError> {
        if args.len() != 4 {
            return err(span, "`layer_norm` takes (x, g, b, eps)");
        }
        let (x_e, g_e, b_e, eps_e) = match (&args[0], &args[1], &args[2], &args[3]) {
            (CallArg::Positional(a), CallArg::Positional(b), CallArg::Positional(c),
             CallArg::Positional(d)) => (a, b, c, d),
            _ => return unsupported(span, "non-positional args"),
        };
        let (x_ptr, x_ty) = self.lower_expr(x_e)?;
        let (g_ptr, g_ty) = self.lower_expr(g_e)?;
        let (b_ptr, b_ty) = self.lower_expr(b_e)?;
        let (eps, eps_ty) = self.lower_expr(eps_e)?;
        let eps = self.coerce_to(eps, &eps_ty, &TyKind::Scalar(ScalarKind::F32), span)?;

        let xt = x_ty.as_tensor().ok_or_else(|| JitError {
            msg: "layer_norm: x must be a tensor".into(),
            line: span.line, col: span.col,
        })?.clone();
        let gt = g_ty.as_tensor().ok_or_else(|| JitError {
            msg: "layer_norm: g must be a tensor".into(),
            line: span.line, col: span.col,
        })?.clone();
        let bt = b_ty.as_tensor().ok_or_else(|| JitError {
            msg: "layer_norm: b must be a tensor".into(),
            line: span.line, col: span.col,
        })?.clone();
        // Normalize over the LAST axis. x is [outer…, D]; g and b are the rank-1
        // gain/bias of length D, broadcast across each row (matching the interp
        // and rms_norm). 1D x is the single-row case, unchanged (#368).
        let d_size = *xt.shape.last().unwrap();
        if gt.rank() != 1 || gt.nelems() != d_size || bt.rank() != 1 || bt.nelems() != d_size {
            return err(span, format!(
                "layer_norm: gain and bias must both be rank-1 of length {} (x's last axis), got g {:?} b {:?}",
                d_size, gt.shape, bt.shape));
        }
        let outer = xt.nelems() / d_size;
        let out_ty = xt.clone();
        let out_ptr = self.forge_alloc(out_ty.nbytes());

        // Outer loop over rows; each row is layer-normalized over its D elements.
        let zero = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, 0);
        let one = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, 1);
        let d_c = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, d_size);
        let outer_c = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, outer);
        let oh = self.builder.create_block();
        let ob = self.builder.create_block();
        let oe = self.builder.create_block();
        self.builder.append_block_param(oh, cl::I64);
        self.jump(oh, &[zero]);
        self.enter(oh);
        let r = self.builder.block_params(oh)[0];
        let oc = self.builder.ins().icmp(IntCC::SignedLessThan, r, outer_c);
        self.brif(oc, ob, oe);
        self.builder.seal_block(oe);

        self.enter(ob);
        let row_base = self.builder.ins().imul(r, d_c);
        self.layer_norm_one_row(x_ptr, g_ptr, b_ptr, out_ptr, row_base, d_size, eps);
        let rnext = self.builder.ins().iadd(r, one);
        self.jump(oh, &[rnext]);
        self.builder.seal_block(ob);
        self.builder.seal_block(oh);

        self.enter(oe);
        Ok((out_ptr, TyKind::Tensor(out_ty)))
    }

    /// Emit numerically-stable softmax over `n` f32 elements at `row_ptr`.
    /// Three passes: find max, exp-subtract-accumulate, normalize.
    /// `row_ptr` is modified in place.
    fn softmax_row_at(&mut self, row_ptr: Value, n: i64) {
        let exp_entry = self.fns.get("__dmc_exp_f32").expect("registered").clone();
        let exp_ref   = self.module.declare_func_in_func(exp_entry.id, self.builder.func);
        let eb   = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, 4);
        let one  = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, 1);
        let zero = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, 0);
        let n_v  = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, n);
        let neg_inf = self.builder.ins().f32const(f32::NEG_INFINITY);
        let zerof   = self.builder.ins().f32const(0.0_f32);

        // Pass 1: find max
        let m_hdr  = self.builder.create_block();
        let m_body = self.builder.create_block();
        let m_exit = self.builder.create_block();
        self.builder.append_block_param(m_hdr, cl::I64);
        self.builder.append_block_param(m_hdr, cl::F32);
        self.builder.append_block_param(m_exit, cl::F32);
        self.jump(m_hdr, &[zero, neg_inf]);
        self.enter(m_hdr);
        let mi  = self.builder.block_params(m_hdr)[0];
        let mx  = self.builder.block_params(m_hdr)[1];
        let cm  = self.builder.ins().icmp(IntCC::SignedLessThan, mi, n_v);
        self.builder.ins().brif(cm, m_body, &[], m_exit, &[mx.into()]);
        self.block_filled = true;
        self.enter(m_body);
        let off = self.builder.ins().imul(mi, eb);
        let v   = self.tensor_load_elem(row_ptr, off, ScalarKind::F32);
        let mx2 = self.builder.ins().fmax(mx, v);
        let min = self.builder.ins().iadd(mi, one);
        self.jump(m_hdr, &[min, mx2]);
        self.builder.seal_block(m_body);
        self.builder.seal_block(m_hdr);
        self.enter(m_exit);
        let max_val = self.builder.block_params(m_exit)[0];
        self.builder.seal_block(m_exit);

        // Pass 2: out[i] = exp(x[i] - max); acc = sum(out)
        let e_hdr  = self.builder.create_block();
        let e_body = self.builder.create_block();
        let e_exit = self.builder.create_block();
        self.builder.append_block_param(e_hdr, cl::I64);
        self.builder.append_block_param(e_hdr, cl::F32);
        self.builder.append_block_param(e_exit, cl::F32);
        self.jump(e_hdr, &[zero, zerof]);
        self.enter(e_hdr);
        let ei  = self.builder.block_params(e_hdr)[0];
        let acc = self.builder.block_params(e_hdr)[1];
        let ce  = self.builder.ins().icmp(IntCC::SignedLessThan, ei, n_v);
        self.builder.ins().brif(ce, e_body, &[], e_exit, &[acc.into()]);
        self.block_filled = true;
        self.enter(e_body);
        let off2 = self.builder.ins().imul(ei, eb);
        let v2   = self.tensor_load_elem(row_ptr, off2, ScalarKind::F32);
        let sh   = self.builder.ins().fsub(v2, max_val);
        let call = self.builder.ins().call(exp_ref, &[sh]);
        let ev   = self.builder.inst_results(call)[0];
        self.tensor_store_elem(row_ptr, off2, ev);
        let acc2 = self.builder.ins().fadd(acc, ev);
        let ein  = self.builder.ins().iadd(ei, one);
        self.jump(e_hdr, &[ein, acc2]);
        self.builder.seal_block(e_body);
        self.builder.seal_block(e_hdr);
        self.enter(e_exit);
        let total = self.builder.block_params(e_exit)[0];
        self.builder.seal_block(e_exit);

        // Pass 3: out[i] /= total
        let d_hdr  = self.builder.create_block();
        let d_body = self.builder.create_block();
        let d_exit = self.builder.create_block();
        self.builder.append_block_param(d_hdr, cl::I64);
        self.jump(d_hdr, &[zero]);
        self.enter(d_hdr);
        let di = self.builder.block_params(d_hdr)[0];
        let cd = self.builder.ins().icmp(IntCC::SignedLessThan, di, n_v);
        self.brif(cd, d_body, d_exit);
        self.enter(d_body);
        let off3 = self.builder.ins().imul(di, eb);
        let v3   = self.tensor_load_elem(row_ptr, off3, ScalarKind::F32);
        let q    = self.builder.ins().fdiv(v3, total);
        self.tensor_store_elem(row_ptr, off3, q);
        let din  = self.builder.ins().iadd(di, one);
        self.jump(d_hdr, &[din]);
        self.builder.seal_block(d_body);
        self.builder.seal_block(d_hdr);
        self.enter(d_exit);
        self.builder.seal_block(d_exit);
    }

    /// Allocate a fresh DynTensor with the same dynamic shape as `src` and copy
    /// its data region element-by-element. Used so softmax over a DynTensor
    /// argument doesn't mutate the caller's buffer.
    fn dyn_copy(&mut self, src: Value, dt: &DynTensorTy) -> Value {
        // Gather the dynamic extents (in axis order) to size the new buffer.
        let mut dyn_ext: Vec<Value> = Vec::with_capacity(dt.n_dyn());
        for axis in 0..dt.rank() {
            if dt.dims[axis].is_none() {
                dyn_ext.push(self.dyn_extent(src, dt, axis));
            }
        }
        let out = self.dyn_alloc(dt, &dyn_ext);
        let src_data = self.dyn_data_ptr(src, dt);
        let out_data = self.dyn_data_ptr(out, dt);
        let n = self.dyn_total_elems(src, dt);

        let zero = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, 0);
        let one = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, 1);
        let four = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, 4);
        let hdr = self.builder.create_block();
        let body = self.builder.create_block();
        let exit = self.builder.create_block();
        self.builder.append_block_param(hdr, cl::I64);
        self.jump(hdr, &[zero]);
        self.enter(hdr);
        let i = self.builder.block_params(hdr)[0];
        let cont = self.builder.ins().icmp(IntCC::SignedLessThan, i, n);
        self.brif(cont, body, exit);
        self.enter(body);
        let off = self.builder.ins().imul(i, four);
        let v = self.tensor_load_elem(src_data, off, ScalarKind::F32);
        self.tensor_store_elem(out_data, off, v);
        let inext = self.builder.ins().iadd(i, one);
        self.jump(hdr, &[inext]);
        self.builder.seal_block(body);
        self.builder.seal_block(hdr);
        self.enter(exit);
        self.builder.seal_block(exit);
        out
    }

    /// In-place numerically-stable softmax over the *last* (possibly runtime)
    /// axis of a contiguous DynTensor `out`. Validates the optional axis arg
    /// (only the last axis is supported) and dispatches to the runtime-bounded
    /// per-row kernel.
    fn softmax_dyn_last_axis(
        &mut self,
        out: Value,
        dt: &DynTensorTy,
        args: &[CallArg],
        span: &Span,
    ) -> Result<(), JitError> {
        let rank = dt.rank();
        if rank == 0 {
            return err(span, "softmax: tensor must have at least 1 axis");
        }
        // Optional axis: must be the last axis (-1 or rank-1).
        if let Some(a) = args.get(1) {
            let axis_e = match a {
                CallArg::Positional(e) => e,
                _ => return unsupported(span, "softmax: non-positional axis arg"),
            };
            let axis = const_int_axis(axis_e).ok_or_else(|| JitError {
                msg: "softmax over a dynamic/KV tensor requires a constant axis".into(),
                line: span.line, col: span.col,
            })?;
            let norm = if axis < 0 { axis + rank as i64 } else { axis };
            if norm != (rank as i64 - 1) {
                return err(span, "softmax over a dynamic/KV tensor only supports the last axis");
            }
        }

        let l = self.dyn_extent(out, dt, rank - 1);          // runtime last-axis length
        let total = self.dyn_total_elems(out, dt);           // runtime element count
        let rows = self.builder.ins().sdiv(total, l);        // outer row count
        let data = self.dyn_data_ptr(out, dt);
        self.softmax_rows_v(data, rows, l);
        Ok(())
    }

    /// In-place numerically-stable softmax over `rows` contiguous rows of `l`
    /// f32 each (both runtime values) starting at `data`. Mirrors
    /// `softmax_row_at` (max → exp(x-max) → divide by sum) but with runtime
    /// loop bounds, wrapped in an outer row loop. The data layout is row-major
    /// contiguous, so row `r` begins at element `r*l`.
    fn softmax_rows_v(&mut self, data: Value, rows: Value, l: Value) {
        let exp_entry = self.fns.get("__dmc_exp_f32").expect("registered").clone();
        let exp_ref = self.module.declare_func_in_func(exp_entry.id, self.builder.func);
        let zero = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, 0);
        let one = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, 1);
        let four = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, 4);
        let neg_inf = self.builder.ins().f32const(f32::NEG_INFINITY);
        let zerof = self.builder.ins().f32const(0.0_f32);

        // Outer loop over rows.
        let r_hdr = self.builder.create_block();
        let r_body = self.builder.create_block();
        let r_exit = self.builder.create_block();
        self.builder.append_block_param(r_hdr, cl::I64);
        self.jump(r_hdr, &[zero]);
        self.enter(r_hdr);
        let r = self.builder.block_params(r_hdr)[0];
        let r_cont = self.builder.ins().icmp(IntCC::SignedLessThan, r, rows);
        self.brif(r_cont, r_body, r_exit);

        self.enter(r_body);
        // row base element index = r * l ; byte offset = base * 4.
        let base_elem = self.builder.ins().imul(r, l);
        let base_off = self.builder.ins().imul(base_elem, four);
        let row_ptr = self.builder.ins().iadd(data, base_off);

        // Pass 1: max over the row.
        let m_hdr = self.builder.create_block();
        let m_body = self.builder.create_block();
        let m_exit = self.builder.create_block();
        self.builder.append_block_param(m_hdr, cl::I64);
        self.builder.append_block_param(m_hdr, cl::F32);
        self.builder.append_block_param(m_exit, cl::F32);
        self.jump(m_hdr, &[zero, neg_inf]);
        self.enter(m_hdr);
        let mi = self.builder.block_params(m_hdr)[0];
        let mx = self.builder.block_params(m_hdr)[1];
        let cm = self.builder.ins().icmp(IntCC::SignedLessThan, mi, l);
        self.builder.ins().brif(cm, m_body, &[], m_exit, &[mx.into()]);
        self.block_filled = true;
        self.enter(m_body);
        let moff = self.builder.ins().imul(mi, four);
        let mv = self.tensor_load_elem(row_ptr, moff, ScalarKind::F32);
        let mx2 = self.builder.ins().fmax(mx, mv);
        let min = self.builder.ins().iadd(mi, one);
        self.jump(m_hdr, &[min, mx2]);
        self.builder.seal_block(m_body);
        self.builder.seal_block(m_hdr);
        self.enter(m_exit);
        let max_val = self.builder.block_params(m_exit)[0];
        self.builder.seal_block(m_exit);

        // Pass 2: x[i] = exp(x[i] - max); acc = sum.
        let e_hdr = self.builder.create_block();
        let e_body = self.builder.create_block();
        let e_exit = self.builder.create_block();
        self.builder.append_block_param(e_hdr, cl::I64);
        self.builder.append_block_param(e_hdr, cl::F32);
        self.builder.append_block_param(e_exit, cl::F32);
        self.jump(e_hdr, &[zero, zerof]);
        self.enter(e_hdr);
        let ei = self.builder.block_params(e_hdr)[0];
        let acc = self.builder.block_params(e_hdr)[1];
        let ce = self.builder.ins().icmp(IntCC::SignedLessThan, ei, l);
        self.builder.ins().brif(ce, e_body, &[], e_exit, &[acc.into()]);
        self.block_filled = true;
        self.enter(e_body);
        let eoff = self.builder.ins().imul(ei, four);
        let ev_in = self.tensor_load_elem(row_ptr, eoff, ScalarKind::F32);
        let sh = self.builder.ins().fsub(ev_in, max_val);
        let call = self.builder.ins().call(exp_ref, &[sh]);
        let ev = self.builder.inst_results(call)[0];
        self.tensor_store_elem(row_ptr, eoff, ev);
        let acc2 = self.builder.ins().fadd(acc, ev);
        let ein = self.builder.ins().iadd(ei, one);
        self.jump(e_hdr, &[ein, acc2]);
        self.builder.seal_block(e_body);
        self.builder.seal_block(e_hdr);
        self.enter(e_exit);
        let total = self.builder.block_params(e_exit)[0];
        self.builder.seal_block(e_exit);

        // Pass 3: x[i] /= total.
        let d_hdr = self.builder.create_block();
        let d_body = self.builder.create_block();
        let d_exit = self.builder.create_block();
        self.builder.append_block_param(d_hdr, cl::I64);
        self.jump(d_hdr, &[zero]);
        self.enter(d_hdr);
        let di = self.builder.block_params(d_hdr)[0];
        let cd = self.builder.ins().icmp(IntCC::SignedLessThan, di, l);
        self.brif(cd, d_body, d_exit);
        self.enter(d_body);
        let doff = self.builder.ins().imul(di, four);
        let dv = self.tensor_load_elem(row_ptr, doff, ScalarKind::F32);
        let q = self.builder.ins().fdiv(dv, total);
        self.tensor_store_elem(row_ptr, doff, q);
        let din = self.builder.ins().iadd(di, one);
        self.jump(d_hdr, &[din]);
        self.builder.seal_block(d_body);
        self.builder.seal_block(d_hdr);
        self.enter(d_exit);
        self.builder.seal_block(d_exit);

        // Advance outer row loop.
        let rnext = self.builder.ins().iadd(r, one);
        self.jump(r_hdr, &[rnext]);
        self.builder.seal_block(r_body);
        self.builder.seal_block(r_hdr);
        self.enter(r_exit);
        self.builder.seal_block(r_exit);
    }

    fn lower_builtin_attn(
        &mut self,
        args: &[CallArg],
        span: &Span,
    ) -> Result<(Value, TyKind), JitError> {
        if args.len() < 3 || args.len() > 4 {
            return err(span, "`attn` takes (q, k, v) or (q, k, v, mask)");
        }
        let q_e = match &args[0] {
            CallArg::Positional(e) => e,
            _ => return err(span, "non-positional arg to `attn`"),
        };
        let k_e = match &args[1] {
            CallArg::Positional(e) => e,
            _ => return err(span, "non-positional arg to `attn`"),
        };
        let v_e = match &args[2] {
            CallArg::Positional(e) => e,
            _ => return err(span, "non-positional arg to `attn`"),
        };

        let (q_ptr, q_ty) = self.lower_expr(q_e)?;
        let (k_ptr, k_ty) = self.lower_expr(k_e)?;
        let (v_ptr, v_ty) = self.lower_expr(v_e)?;

        // Optional mask (4th arg): a contiguous [S,S] bool tensor, or `nil` for
        // none — same contract as `attn_gqa`. This used to be silently DROPPED
        // (the arg was accepted but never applied), so a masked `attn` under
        // the JIT computed unmasked attention while the interpreter masked —
        // a silent divergence. Routing through the shared per-head kernel
        // applies it before softmax.
        let mask: Option<Value> = match args.get(3) {
            None => None,
            Some(CallArg::Positional(e)) => {
                let (m_ptr, m_ty) = self.lower_expr(e)?;
                match m_ty {
                    TyKind::Scalar(ScalarKind::Nil) => None,
                    TyKind::Tensor(mt) if mt.elem == ScalarKind::Bool && mt.rank() == 2 => {
                        Some(m_ptr)
                    }
                    other => return err(span, format!(
                        "attn mask must be a bool [S,S] tensor or nil, got `{}`", other.render())),
                }
            }
            Some(_) => return err(span, "non-positional mask arg to `attn`"),
        };

        let qt = q_ty.as_tensor().ok_or_else(|| JitError {
            msg: "attn: q must be a tensor".into(), line: span.line, col: span.col })?.clone();
        let kt_in = k_ty.as_tensor().ok_or_else(|| JitError {
            msg: "attn: k must be a tensor".into(), line: span.line, col: span.col })?.clone();
        let vt = v_ty.as_tensor().ok_or_else(|| JitError {
            msg: "attn: v must be a tensor".into(), line: span.line, col: span.col })?.clone();

        if qt.rank() != 4 || kt_in.rank() != 4 || vt.rank() != 4 {
            return err(span, "attn: q/k/v must all be rank-4 [B,H,S,D]");
        }
        if qt.elem != ScalarKind::F32 {
            return err(span, "attn: f32 only");
        }
        let b = qt.shape[0]; let h = qt.shape[1];
        let s = qt.shape[2]; let d = qt.shape[3];
        if kt_in.shape != [b, h, s, d] || vt.shape != [b, h, s, d] {
            return err(span, "attn: q/k/v must have identical shapes [B,H,S,D]");
        }

        // Plain MHA is the h_kv == h_q case of the shared per-head kernel.
        let out_ty = TensorTy { elem: ScalarKind::F32, shape: vec![b, h, s, d] };
        let out_ptr = self.forge_alloc(out_ty.nbytes());
        self.emit_attn_gqa_kernel(q_ptr, k_ptr, v_ptr, mask, out_ptr,
                                  b, h, h, s, d, None, span)?;
        Ok((out_ptr, TyKind::Tensor(out_ty)))
    }

    fn lower_builtin_rope(
        &mut self,
        args: &[CallArg],
        span: &Span,
    ) -> Result<(Value, TyKind), JitError> {
        if args.len() != 3 {
            return err(span, "`rope` takes (x, cos, sin)");
        }
        let x_e = match &args[0] {
            CallArg::Positional(e) => e,
            _ => return err(span, "non-positional arg to `rope`"),
        };
        let cos_e = match &args[1] {
            CallArg::Positional(e) => e,
            _ => return err(span, "non-positional arg to `rope`"),
        };
        let sin_e = match &args[2] {
            CallArg::Positional(e) => e,
            _ => return err(span, "non-positional arg to `rope`"),
        };

        let (x_ptr,   x_ty)   = self.lower_expr(x_e)?;
        let (cos_ptr, cos_ty) = self.lower_expr(cos_e)?;
        let (sin_ptr, sin_ty) = self.lower_expr(sin_e)?;

        let xt = x_ty.as_tensor().ok_or_else(|| JitError {
            msg: "rope: x must be a tensor".into(), line: span.line, col: span.col })?.clone();
        let ct = cos_ty.as_tensor().ok_or_else(|| JitError {
            msg: "rope: cos must be a tensor".into(), line: span.line, col: span.col })?.clone();
        let st = sin_ty.as_tensor().ok_or_else(|| JitError {
            msg: "rope: sin must be a tensor".into(), line: span.line, col: span.col })?.clone();

        if xt.rank() < 2 {
            return err(span, "rope: x must be at least rank-2 [..., S, D]");
        }
        if xt.elem != ScalarKind::F32 {
            return err(span, "rope: f32 only");
        }
        let rank = xt.rank();
        let s_dim = xt.shape[rank - 2];
        let d_dim = xt.shape[rank - 1];
        if d_dim % 2 != 0 {
            return err(span, format!("rope: D must be even, got {}", d_dim));
        }
        let d2 = d_dim / 2;
        if ct.shape != [s_dim, d2] || st.shape != [s_dim, d2] {
            return err(span, format!(
                "rope: cos/sin must be [S={}, D/2={}]", s_dim, d2));
        }

        let out_ptr = self.forge_alloc(xt.nbytes());
        // Copy x to out first, then rotate in place.
        self.emit_memcpy_loop(out_ptr, x_ptr, xt.nelems(), 4);
        self.rope_rotate_inplace(out_ptr, cos_ptr, sin_ptr, &xt, false);
        Ok((out_ptr, TyKind::Tensor(xt)))
    }

    /// Rotate `buf` in place by the RoPE tables `cos`/`sin` over the last two
    /// axes (`[..., S, D]`, D even). Each pair `(x_even, x_odd)` at position
    /// `(si, di)` becomes `(xe·c − xo·s, xo·c + xe·s)`. `negate_sin` flips the
    /// rotation direction (`s → −s`): the forward uses `false`; the VJP uses
    /// `true`, since RoPE is an orthogonal rotation whose backward is the
    /// inverse (transpose) rotation, `dx = rope(adj, cos, −sin)` (#368).
    fn rope_rotate_inplace(
        &mut self,
        buf: Value,
        cos_ptr: Value,
        sin_ptr: Value,
        xt: &TensorTy,
        negate_sin: bool,
    ) {
        let rank  = xt.rank();
        let s_dim = xt.shape[rank - 2];
        let d_dim = xt.shape[rank - 1];
        let d2    = d_dim / 2;
        // batch_size = product of all dims before the last two.
        let batch: i64 = xt.shape[..rank-2].iter().product();
        let eb  = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, 4);
        let one = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, 1);
        let zero = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, 0);
        let batch_v = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, batch);
        let s_v     = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, s_dim);
        let d2_v    = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, d2);
        let d_dim_v = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, d_dim);

        // for bk in 0..batch
        let bk_hdr  = self.builder.create_block();
        let bk_body = self.builder.create_block();
        let bk_exit = self.builder.create_block();
        self.builder.append_block_param(bk_hdr, cl::I64);
        self.jump(bk_hdr, &[zero]);
        self.enter(bk_hdr);
        let bk = self.builder.block_params(bk_hdr)[0];
        let cbk = self.builder.ins().icmp(IntCC::SignedLessThan, bk, batch_v);
        self.brif(cbk, bk_body, bk_exit);

        self.enter(bk_body);
        // x offset for this batch: bk * S * D
        let sd_v    = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, s_dim * d_dim);
        let bk_off  = self.builder.ins().imul(bk, sd_v);

        // for si in 0..S
        let si_hdr  = self.builder.create_block();
        let si_body = self.builder.create_block();
        let si_exit = self.builder.create_block();
        self.builder.append_block_param(si_hdr, cl::I64);
        self.jump(si_hdr, &[zero]);
        self.enter(si_hdr);
        let si = self.builder.block_params(si_hdr)[0];
        let csi = self.builder.ins().icmp(IntCC::SignedLessThan, si, s_v);
        self.brif(csi, si_body, si_exit);

        self.enter(si_body);
        // for di in 0..D/2
        let di_hdr  = self.builder.create_block();
        let di_body = self.builder.create_block();
        let di_exit = self.builder.create_block();
        self.builder.append_block_param(di_hdr, cl::I64);
        self.jump(di_hdr, &[zero]);
        self.enter(di_hdr);
        let di = self.builder.block_params(di_hdr)[0];
        let cdi = self.builder.ins().icmp(IntCC::SignedLessThan, di, d2_v);
        self.brif(cdi, di_body, di_exit);

        self.enter(di_body);
        // x_even at bk_off + si*D + 2*di
        let si_d    = self.builder.ins().imul(si, d_dim_v);
        let two_di  = self.builder.ins().iadd(di, di);
        let x_even_f = {
            let f = self.builder.ins().iadd(bk_off, si_d);
            self.builder.ins().iadd(f, two_di)
        };
        let x_odd_f  = self.builder.ins().iadd(x_even_f, one);

        let x_even_o = self.builder.ins().imul(x_even_f, eb);
        let x_odd_o  = self.builder.ins().imul(x_odd_f, eb);
        let xe = self.tensor_load_elem(buf, x_even_o, ScalarKind::F32);
        let xo = self.tensor_load_elem(buf, x_odd_o, ScalarKind::F32);

        // cos/sin at [si, di] = si*D2 + di
        let si_d2   = self.builder.ins().imul(si, d2_v);
        let cs_f    = self.builder.ins().iadd(si_d2, di);
        let cs_o    = self.builder.ins().imul(cs_f, eb);
        let cv     = self.tensor_load_elem(cos_ptr, cs_o, ScalarKind::F32);
        let sv_raw = self.tensor_load_elem(sin_ptr, cs_o, ScalarKind::F32);
        // Backward is the inverse rotation: negate sin.
        let sv_val = if negate_sin { self.builder.ins().fneg(sv_raw) } else { sv_raw };

        // out_even = xe*cos - xo*sin
        let xe_c = self.builder.ins().fmul(xe, cv);
        let xo_s = self.builder.ins().fmul(xo, sv_val);
        let out_even = self.builder.ins().fsub(xe_c, xo_s);
        // out_odd  = xo*cos + xe*sin
        let xo_c = self.builder.ins().fmul(xo, cv);
        let xe_s = self.builder.ins().fmul(xe, sv_val);
        let out_odd = self.builder.ins().fadd(xo_c, xe_s);

        self.tensor_store_elem(buf, x_even_o, out_even);
        self.tensor_store_elem(buf, x_odd_o, out_odd);

        let din = self.builder.ins().iadd(di, one);
        self.jump(di_hdr, &[din]);
        self.builder.seal_block(di_body);
        self.builder.seal_block(di_hdr);

        self.enter(di_exit);
        let sin_next = self.builder.ins().iadd(si, one);
        self.jump(si_hdr, &[sin_next]);
        self.builder.seal_block(di_exit);
        self.builder.seal_block(si_body);
        self.builder.seal_block(si_hdr);

        self.enter(si_exit);
        let bkn = self.builder.ins().iadd(bk, one);
        self.jump(bk_hdr, &[bkn]);
        self.builder.seal_block(si_exit);
        self.builder.seal_block(bk_body);
        self.builder.seal_block(bk_hdr);

        self.enter(bk_exit);
        self.builder.seal_block(bk_exit);
    }

    /// VJP of `rope` over its `x` input: `dx = rope(adj, cos, −sin)` (#368).
    /// RoPE is a per-pair orthogonal rotation, so the backward is the inverse
    /// rotation applied to the incoming adjoint — the same kernel with `sin`
    /// negated. `cos`/`sin` are read-only position tables (no gradient flows to
    /// them). Allocates and returns the `dx` buffer.
    fn tensor_rope_backward(&mut self, adj: Value, cos_ptr: Value, sin_ptr: Value, xt: &TensorTy) -> Value {
        let out = self.forge_alloc(xt.nbytes());
        self.emit_memcpy_loop(out, adj, xt.nelems(), 4);
        self.rope_rotate_inplace(out, cos_ptr, sin_ptr, xt, true);
        out
    }

    /// VJP of fused attention over q, k, and v (#368). `p_buf` holds the
    /// [B,H_q,S,S] post-softmax weights saved by the @grad forward
    /// (`emit_attn_gqa_kernel` with `save_p`). Per (batch, query head), with
    /// P = p_buf[b, hq] and adj the incoming [S,D] adjoint slice:
    ///   dV[b,hkv] += Pᵀ·adj           dP = adj·V[b,hkv]ᵀ
    ///   dS = P ∘ (dP − rowsum(dP ∘ P)) · (1/√D)    (softmax VJP + scaling)
    ///   dQ[b,hq] = dS·K[b,hkv]        dK[b,hkv] += dSᵀ·Q[b,hq]
    /// GQA (h_kv < h_q) accumulates dK/dV across each KV head's query group;
    /// masked positions have P = 0, so dS is 0 there and the mask needs no
    /// gradient. Returns freshly allocated (dq, dk, dv) in q/k/v's shapes.
    #[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
    fn tensor_attn_backward(
        &mut self,
        adj: Value,
        q: Value,
        k: Value,
        v: Value,
        p_buf: Value,
        out_t: &TensorTy,
        k_t: &TensorTy,
        span: &Span,
    ) -> Result<(Value, Value, Value), JitError> {
        let b    = out_t.shape[0];
        let h_q  = out_t.shape[1];
        let s    = out_t.shape[2];
        let d    = out_t.shape[3];
        let h_kv = k_t.shape[1];
        let g    = h_q / h_kv;
        let scale = 1.0_f32 / (d as f32).sqrt();
        let scale_v = self.builder.ins().f32const(scale);

        let dq = self.forge_alloc(out_t.nbytes());
        let dk = self.forge_alloc(k_t.nbytes());
        let dv = self.forge_alloc(k_t.nbytes());
        // dk/dv accumulate across each KV head's query group — zero-fill
        // first (the arena hands back dirty memory after a reset). Every dq
        // slice is written exactly once by its matmul, so dq needs no fill.
        self.fill_const(dk, k_t.nbytes() / 4, 0.0);
        self.fill_const(dv, k_t.nbytes() / 4, 0.0);

        // Per-head scratch, reused each iteration: dP [S,S]; dV/dK group
        // contributions [S,D] (accumulated into the dv/dk slices).
        let ss_bytes = s.checked_mul(s).and_then(|x| x.checked_mul(4))
            .expect("attn backward: S*S*4 overflows i64");
        let sd_bytes = s.checked_mul(d).and_then(|x| x.checked_mul(4))
            .expect("attn backward: S*D*4 overflows i64");
        let dp_s  = self.forge_alloc(ss_bytes);
        let dvc_s = self.forge_alloc(sd_bytes);
        let dkc_s = self.forge_alloc(sd_bytes);
        let ss_ty = TensorTy { elem: ScalarKind::F32, shape: vec![s, s] };
        let sd_ty = TensorTy { elem: ScalarKind::F32, shape: vec![s, d] };

        let zero = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, 0);
        let one  = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, 1);
        let eb   = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, 4);
        let b_v  = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, b);
        let hq_v = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, h_q);
        let g_v  = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, g);
        let sd4  = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, sd_bytes);
        let ss4  = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, ss_bytes);
        let hkv_v = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, h_kv);

        // for bi in 0..B
        let bi_hdr  = self.builder.create_block();
        let bi_body = self.builder.create_block();
        let bi_exit = self.builder.create_block();
        self.builder.append_block_param(bi_hdr, cl::I64);
        self.jump(bi_hdr, &[zero]);
        self.enter(bi_hdr);
        let bi = self.builder.block_params(bi_hdr)[0];
        let cb = self.builder.ins().icmp(IntCC::SignedLessThan, bi, b_v);
        self.brif(cb, bi_body, bi_exit);
        self.enter(bi_body);

        // for hqi in 0..H_q
        let hqi_hdr  = self.builder.create_block();
        let hqi_body = self.builder.create_block();
        let hqi_exit = self.builder.create_block();
        self.builder.append_block_param(hqi_hdr, cl::I64);
        self.jump(hqi_hdr, &[zero]);
        self.enter(hqi_hdr);
        let hqi = self.builder.block_params(hqi_hdr)[0];
        let chq = self.builder.ins().icmp(IntCC::SignedLessThan, hqi, hq_v);
        self.brif(chq, hqi_body, hqi_exit);
        self.enter(hqi_body);

        // Head base offsets: (bi*H_q + hqi)·S·D·4 for q-shaped buffers,
        // (bi*H_kv + hqi/G)·S·D·4 for kv-shaped, (bi*H_q + hqi)·S·S·4 for P.
        let hkvi  = self.builder.ins().udiv(hqi, g_v);
        let bhq   = self.builder.ins().imul(bi, hq_v);
        let bhq   = self.builder.ins().iadd(bhq, hqi);
        let bhkv  = self.builder.ins().imul(bi, hkv_v);
        let bhkv  = self.builder.ins().iadd(bhkv, hkvi);
        let q_off  = self.builder.ins().imul(bhq, sd4);
        let kv_off = self.builder.ins().imul(bhkv, sd4);
        let p_off  = self.builder.ins().imul(bhq, ss4);
        let q_head   = self.builder.ins().iadd(q, q_off);
        let adj_head = self.builder.ins().iadd(adj, q_off);
        let dq_head  = self.builder.ins().iadd(dq, q_off);
        let k_head   = self.builder.ins().iadd(k, kv_off);
        let v_head   = self.builder.ins().iadd(v, kv_off);
        let dk_head  = self.builder.ins().iadd(dk, kv_off);
        let dv_head  = self.builder.ins().iadd(dv, kv_off);
        let p_head   = self.builder.ins().iadd(p_buf, p_off);

        // dV[b,hkv] += Pᵀ · adj   ([S,S]ᵀ @ [S,D] → [S,D])
        let (pt, _) = self.raw_transpose(p_head, &ss_ty, span)?;
        self.emit_2d_matmul_at(pt, adj_head, dvc_s, s, s, d);
        self.tensor_add_inplace(dv_head, dvc_s, &sd_ty);

        // dP = adj · Vᵀ   ([S,D] @ [D,S] → [S,S])
        let (vt, _) = self.raw_transpose(v_head, &sd_ty, span)?;
        self.emit_2d_matmul_at(adj_head, vt, dp_s, s, d, s);

        // dS = P ∘ (dP − rowsum(dP ∘ P)), then · 1/√D for the score scaling.
        let ds = self.tensor_softmax_backward(dp_s, p_head, &ss_ty);
        let nss = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, s * s);
        let sc_hdr  = self.builder.create_block();
        let sc_body = self.builder.create_block();
        let sc_exit = self.builder.create_block();
        self.builder.append_block_param(sc_hdr, cl::I64);
        self.jump(sc_hdr, &[zero]);
        self.enter(sc_hdr);
        let sci = self.builder.block_params(sc_hdr)[0];
        let csc = self.builder.ins().icmp(IntCC::SignedLessThan, sci, nss);
        self.brif(csc, sc_body, sc_exit);
        self.enter(sc_body);
        let sco = self.builder.ins().imul(sci, eb);
        let dsv = self.tensor_load_elem(ds, sco, ScalarKind::F32);
        let dsv = self.builder.ins().fmul(dsv, scale_v);
        self.tensor_store_elem(ds, sco, dsv);
        let scin = self.builder.ins().iadd(sci, one);
        self.jump(sc_hdr, &[scin]);
        self.builder.seal_block(sc_body);
        self.builder.seal_block(sc_hdr);
        self.enter(sc_exit);
        self.builder.seal_block(sc_exit);

        // dQ[b,hq] = dS · K   ([S,S] @ [S,D] → [S,D], written once)
        self.emit_2d_matmul_at(ds, k_head, dq_head, s, s, d);

        // dK[b,hkv] += dSᵀ · Q   ([S,S]ᵀ @ [S,D] → [S,D])
        let (dst, _) = self.raw_transpose(ds, &ss_ty, span)?;
        self.emit_2d_matmul_at(dst, q_head, dkc_s, s, s, d);
        self.tensor_add_inplace(dk_head, dkc_s, &sd_ty);

        let hqin = self.builder.ins().iadd(hqi, one);
        self.jump(hqi_hdr, &[hqin]);
        self.builder.seal_block(hqi_body);
        self.builder.seal_block(hqi_hdr);
        self.enter(hqi_exit);
        let bin = self.builder.ins().iadd(bi, one);
        self.jump(bi_hdr, &[bin]);
        self.builder.seal_block(hqi_exit);
        self.builder.seal_block(bi_body);
        self.builder.seal_block(bi_hdr);
        self.enter(bi_exit);
        self.builder.seal_block(bi_exit);

        Ok((dq, dk, dv))
    }

    fn lower_builtin_attn_gqa(
        &mut self,
        args: &[CallArg],
        span: &Span,
    ) -> Result<(Value, TyKind), JitError> {
        if args.len() < 3 || args.len() > 4 {
            return err(span, "`attn_gqa` takes (q, k, v) or (q, k, v, mask)");
        }
        let q_e = match &args[0] {
            CallArg::Positional(e) => e,
            _ => return err(span, "non-positional arg to `attn_gqa`"),
        };
        let k_e = match &args[1] {
            CallArg::Positional(e) => e,
            _ => return err(span, "non-positional arg to `attn_gqa`"),
        };
        let v_e = match &args[2] {
            CallArg::Positional(e) => e,
            _ => return err(span, "non-positional arg to `attn_gqa`"),
        };

        let (q_ptr, q_ty) = self.lower_expr(q_e)?;
        let (k_ptr, k_ty) = self.lower_expr(k_e)?;
        let (v_ptr, v_ty) = self.lower_expr(v_e)?;

        // Optional causal mask (4th arg): a contiguous [S,S] bool tensor; masked
        // positions are forced to -inf before softmax (#292 — required for a
        // correct causal forward). `nil` means no mask. A range-slice mask like
        // `causal_mask[0..S, 0..S]` materializes contiguous, so element [i,j] is
        // at `(i*S + j)` (i8).
        let mask: Option<(Value, TensorTy)> = match args.get(3) {
            None => None,
            Some(CallArg::Positional(e)) => {
                let (m_ptr, m_ty) = self.lower_expr(e)?;
                match m_ty {
                    TyKind::Scalar(ScalarKind::Nil) => None,
                    TyKind::Tensor(mt) if mt.elem == ScalarKind::Bool && mt.rank() == 2 => {
                        Some((m_ptr, mt))
                    }
                    other => return err(span, format!(
                        "attn_gqa mask must be a bool [S,S] tensor or nil, got `{}`", other.render())),
                }
            }
            Some(_) => return err(span, "non-positional mask arg to `attn_gqa`"),
        };

        // Cached-attention path (#277): k/v read from per-layer KV caches (or
        // already-materialized DynTensors) — attend over a *runtime* history
        // length rather than a compile-time S. The static `[B,H,S,D]` kernel
        // below requires dense tensors; route KV/DynTensor k/v to the dynamic
        // kernel. The 4th `mask` arg (if any) is applied before softmax.
        if matches!(k_ty, TyKind::KV(_) | TyKind::DynTensor(_))
            || matches!(v_ty, TyKind::KV(_) | TyKind::DynTensor(_))
        {
            return self.lower_attn_gqa_cached(q_ptr, &q_ty, k_ptr, &k_ty, v_ptr, &v_ty, mask, span);
        }

        let qt = q_ty.as_tensor().ok_or_else(|| JitError {
            msg: "attn_gqa: q must be a tensor".into(), line: span.line, col: span.col })?.clone();
        let kt = k_ty.as_tensor().ok_or_else(|| JitError {
            msg: "attn_gqa: k must be a tensor".into(), line: span.line, col: span.col })?.clone();
        let vt = v_ty.as_tensor().ok_or_else(|| JitError {
            msg: "attn_gqa: v must be a tensor".into(), line: span.line, col: span.col })?.clone();

        if qt.rank() != 4 || kt.rank() != 4 || vt.rank() != 4 {
            return err(span, "attn_gqa: q/k/v must be rank-4 [B,H_q,S,D] / [B,H_kv,S,D]");
        }
        if qt.elem != ScalarKind::F32 {
            return err(span, "attn_gqa: f32 only");
        }
        let b    = qt.shape[0];
        let h_q  = qt.shape[1];
        let s    = qt.shape[2];
        let d    = qt.shape[3];
        let h_kv = kt.shape[1];
        if kt.shape[0] != b || kt.shape[2] != s || kt.shape[3] != d {
            return err(span, "attn_gqa: k must be [B, H_kv, S, D]");
        }
        if vt.shape != kt.shape {
            return err(span, "attn_gqa: v must have same shape as k [B, H_kv, S, D]");
        }
        if h_q % h_kv != 0 {
            return err(span, format!(
                "attn_gqa: H_q ({}) must be divisible by H_kv ({})", h_q, h_kv));
        }
        // Output: [B, H_q, S, D]
        let out_ty = TensorTy { elem: ScalarKind::F32, shape: vec![b, h_q, s, d] };
        let out_ptr = self.forge_alloc(out_ty.nbytes());
        let mask_ptr = mask.map(|(p, _)| p);
        self.emit_attn_gqa_kernel(q_ptr, k_ptr, v_ptr, mask_ptr, out_ptr,
                                  b, h_q, h_kv, s, d, None, span)?;
        Ok((out_ptr, TyKind::Tensor(out_ty)))
    }

    /// Emit the dense per-head GQA/MHA attention kernel: for each (batch,
    /// query head), `scores = (q_head @ k_headᵀ)·(1/√D)` → optional bool mask
    /// (masked → −1e9) → row softmax → `@ v_head` into `out_ptr[b, hq]`.
    /// `h_kv == h_q` is plain multi-head attention; otherwise each KV head
    /// serves `h_q / h_kv` query heads. When `save_p` is `Some(pbuf)`, the
    /// post-softmax `[S, S]` weights of every head are written to that
    /// `[B, H_q, S, S]` buffer — the `@grad` forward saves them so the
    /// backward can replay `P` without recomputing scores (#368).
    #[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
    fn emit_attn_gqa_kernel(
        &mut self,
        q_ptr: Value,
        k_ptr: Value,
        v_ptr: Value,
        mask: Option<Value>,
        out_ptr: Value,
        b: i64, h_q: i64, h_kv: i64, s: i64, d: i64,
        save_p: Option<Value>,
        span: &Span,
    ) -> Result<(), JitError> {
        let g = h_q / h_kv; // group size

        let scale = 1.0_f32 / (d as f32).sqrt();
        let scale_v = self.builder.ins().f32const(scale);

        // Scratch buffers for per-head computation (reused each iteration).
        // scores_scratch: [S, S];  head_out_scratch: [S, D]
        let scores_bytes = s.checked_mul(s).and_then(|x| x.checked_mul(4))
            .expect("attn: S*S*4 overflows i64 (sequence length too large)");
        let head_bytes = s.checked_mul(d).and_then(|x| x.checked_mul(4))
            .expect("attn: S*D*4 overflows i64");
        let scores_scratch = self.forge_alloc(scores_bytes);
        let head_out_scratch = self.forge_alloc(head_bytes);

        // Strides (in bytes):
        // q[b, h_q, :, :] base = (b * H_q * S * D + h_q * S * D) * 4
        // k[b, h_kv, :, :] base = (b * H_kv * S * D + h_kv * S * D) * 4
        let q_slice_bytes = s * d * 4;
        let k_slice_bytes = s * d * 4;
        let o_slice_bytes = s * d * 4;

        let eb       = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, 4);
        let one      = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, 1);
        let zero     = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, 0);
        let b_v      = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, b);
        let hq_v     = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, h_q);
        let g_v      = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, g);
        let q_hstride = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, q_slice_bytes);
        let k_hstride = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, k_slice_bytes);
        let o_hstride = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, o_slice_bytes);
        let q_bstride = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, h_q * q_slice_bytes);
        let k_bstride = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, h_kv * k_slice_bytes);
        let o_bstride = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, h_q * o_slice_bytes);

        // for bi in 0..B
        let bi_hdr  = self.builder.create_block();
        let bi_body = self.builder.create_block();
        let bi_exit = self.builder.create_block();
        self.builder.append_block_param(bi_hdr, cl::I64);
        self.jump(bi_hdr, &[zero]);
        self.enter(bi_hdr);
        let bi = self.builder.block_params(bi_hdr)[0];
        let cb = self.builder.ins().icmp(IntCC::SignedLessThan, bi, b_v);
        self.brif(cb, bi_body, bi_exit);

        self.enter(bi_body);
        let qb_off = self.builder.ins().imul(bi, q_bstride);
        let kb_off = self.builder.ins().imul(bi, k_bstride);
        let ob_off = self.builder.ins().imul(bi, o_bstride);
        let q_batch = self.builder.ins().iadd(q_ptr, qb_off);
        let k_batch = self.builder.ins().iadd(k_ptr, kb_off);
        let o_batch = self.builder.ins().iadd(out_ptr, ob_off);

        // for hqi in 0..H_q
        let hqi_hdr  = self.builder.create_block();
        let hqi_body = self.builder.create_block();
        let hqi_exit = self.builder.create_block();
        self.builder.append_block_param(hqi_hdr, cl::I64);
        self.jump(hqi_hdr, &[zero]);
        self.enter(hqi_hdr);
        let hqi = self.builder.block_params(hqi_hdr)[0];
        let chq = self.builder.ins().icmp(IntCC::SignedLessThan, hqi, hq_v);
        self.brif(chq, hqi_body, hqi_exit);

        self.enter(hqi_body);
        // KV head index = hqi / G
        let hkvi = self.builder.ins().udiv(hqi, g_v);

        // Score buffer for this head: the reused scratch, or — when the @grad
        // forward saves P — this head's [S,S] slice of the [B,H_q,S,S] buffer.
        let scores_buf = match save_p {
            Some(pbuf) => {
                let bh   = self.builder.ins().imul(bi, hq_v);
                let bh   = self.builder.ins().iadd(bh, hqi);
                let ss4  = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, scores_bytes);
                let poff = self.builder.ins().imul(bh, ss4);
                self.builder.ins().iadd(pbuf, poff)
            }
            None => scores_scratch,
        };

        let qh_off = self.builder.ins().imul(hqi,  q_hstride);
        let kh_off = self.builder.ins().imul(hkvi, k_hstride);
        let oh_off = self.builder.ins().imul(hqi,  o_hstride);
        let q_head = self.builder.ins().iadd(q_batch, qh_off);
        let k_head = self.builder.ins().iadd(k_batch, kh_off);
        let o_head = self.builder.ins().iadd(o_batch, oh_off);

        // k_head_t = transpose([S,D] slice of k) -> [D,S]
        let k_slice_ty = TensorTy { elem: ScalarKind::F32, shape: vec![s, d] };
        let (kt_ptr, _kt_ty) = self.raw_transpose(k_head, &k_slice_ty, span)?;

        // scores_buf[0..S*S] = q_head @ kt_ptr  ([S,D] @ [D,S] -> [S,S])
        self.emit_2d_matmul_at(q_head, kt_ptr, scores_buf, s, d, s);

        // scale scores_buf
        let ns_v = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, s * s);
        let sc_hdr  = self.builder.create_block();
        let sc_body = self.builder.create_block();
        let sc_exit = self.builder.create_block();
        self.builder.append_block_param(sc_hdr, cl::I64);
        self.jump(sc_hdr, &[zero]);
        self.enter(sc_hdr);
        let sci = self.builder.block_params(sc_hdr)[0];
        let csc = self.builder.ins().icmp(IntCC::SignedLessThan, sci, ns_v);
        self.brif(csc, sc_body, sc_exit);
        self.enter(sc_body);
        let sco = self.builder.ins().imul(sci, eb);
        let scv = self.tensor_load_elem(scores_buf, sco, ScalarKind::F32);
        let scv2 = self.builder.ins().fmul(scv, scale_v);
        // Apply the optional causal mask. scores_buf and the mask are both
        // contiguous [S,S], so the flat index `sci` addresses both; bool is 1
        // byte so the element index is the byte offset.
        let scv2 = if let Some(m_ptr) = &mask {
            let mv = self.tensor_load_elem(*m_ptr, sci, ScalarKind::Bool);
            let mzero = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I8, 0);
            let allowed = self.builder.ins().icmp(IntCC::NotEqual, mv, mzero);
            let neg_inf = self.builder.ins().f32const(-1.0e9_f32);
            self.builder.ins().select(allowed, scv2, neg_inf)
        } else {
            scv2
        };
        self.tensor_store_elem(scores_buf, sco, scv2);
        let scin = self.builder.ins().iadd(sci, one);
        self.jump(sc_hdr, &[scin]);
        self.builder.seal_block(sc_body);
        self.builder.seal_block(sc_hdr);
        self.enter(sc_exit);
        self.builder.seal_block(sc_exit);

        // softmax per row of scores_buf (S rows of length S)
        let row_bytes = s * 4;
        let row_bytes_v = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, row_bytes);
        let nr_v = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, s);
        let r_hdr  = self.builder.create_block();
        let r_body = self.builder.create_block();
        let r_exit = self.builder.create_block();
        self.builder.append_block_param(r_hdr, cl::I64);
        self.jump(r_hdr, &[zero]);
        self.enter(r_hdr);
        let ri = self.builder.block_params(r_hdr)[0];
        let cr = self.builder.ins().icmp(IntCC::SignedLessThan, ri, nr_v);
        self.brif(cr, r_body, r_exit);
        self.enter(r_body);
        let row_off = self.builder.ins().imul(ri, row_bytes_v);
        let row_ptr_gqa = self.builder.ins().iadd(scores_buf, row_off);
        self.softmax_row_at(row_ptr_gqa, s);
        let rin = self.builder.ins().iadd(ri, one);
        self.jump(r_hdr, &[rin]);
        self.builder.seal_block(r_body);
        self.builder.seal_block(r_hdr);
        self.enter(r_exit);
        self.builder.seal_block(r_exit);

        // head_out_scratch = scores_buf @ v_head  ([S,S] @ [S,D] -> [S,D])
        // Note: v_head pointer is at the same KV head offset as k_head
        let vh_off = self.builder.ins().imul(hkvi, k_hstride);
        let vb_off = self.builder.ins().imul(bi, k_bstride);
        let v_batch_base = self.builder.ins().iadd(v_ptr, vb_off);
        let v_head = self.builder.ins().iadd(v_batch_base, vh_off);
        self.emit_2d_matmul_at(scores_buf, v_head, head_out_scratch, s, s, d);

        // Copy head_out_scratch into o_head
        self.emit_memcpy_loop(o_head, head_out_scratch, s * d, 4);

        let hqin = self.builder.ins().iadd(hqi, one);
        self.jump(hqi_hdr, &[hqin]);
        self.builder.seal_block(hqi_body);
        self.builder.seal_block(hqi_hdr);

        self.enter(hqi_exit);
        let bin = self.builder.ins().iadd(bi, one);
        self.jump(bi_hdr, &[bin]);
        self.builder.seal_block(hqi_exit);
        self.builder.seal_block(bi_body);
        self.builder.seal_block(bi_hdr);

        self.enter(bi_exit);
        self.builder.seal_block(bi_exit);

        Ok(())
    }

    /// Cached GQA attention (#277): `q` is a dense `[B,H_q,S,D]` tensor, `k`/`v`
    /// are KV caches (or already-materialized DynTensors) whose streaming axis
    /// is a **runtime** history length `len`. Result is a dense `[B,H_q,S,D]`
    /// tensor. For each (batch, query head) we read the KV head `hq / G`, form
    /// `scores[i,j] = scale * q[i,·]·k[j,·]` over `i in 0..S`, `j in 0..len`,
    /// softmax each row over `len`, then `out[i,·] = Σ_j probs[i,j] · v[j,·]`.
    /// `len`, the score buffer, and both contractions span the dynamic axis.
    /// An optional `mask` (contiguous [S,S] bool) forces masked score positions
    /// to -inf before softmax — required for a correct causal forward (#292).
    #[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
    fn lower_attn_gqa_cached(
        &mut self,
        q_ptr: Value, q_ty: &TyKind,
        k_ptr: Value, k_ty: &TyKind,
        v_ptr: Value, v_ty: &TyKind,
        mask: Option<(Value, TensorTy)>,
        span: &Span,
    ) -> Result<(Value, TyKind), JitError> {
        let qt = q_ty.as_tensor().ok_or_else(|| JitError {
            msg: "attn_gqa: q must be a dense tensor".into(),
            line: span.line, col: span.col })?.clone();
        // Materialize KV caches to contiguous DynTensors [B,H_kv,len,D]; a
        // DynTensor arg is already in that form.
        let (k_ptr, kdt) = match k_ty {
            TyKind::KV(kv) if kv.elem == ScalarKind::F32 => self.kv_materialize(k_ptr, kv),
            TyKind::DynTensor(dt) if dt.elem == ScalarKind::F32 => (k_ptr, dt.clone()),
            _ => return err(span, format!(
                "attn_gqa: k cache must be an f32 KV/DynTensor, got `{}`", k_ty.render())),
        };
        let (v_ptr, vdt) = match v_ty {
            TyKind::KV(kv) if kv.elem == ScalarKind::F32 => self.kv_materialize(v_ptr, kv),
            TyKind::DynTensor(dt) if dt.elem == ScalarKind::F32 => (v_ptr, dt.clone()),
            _ => return err(span, format!(
                "attn_gqa: v cache must be an f32 KV/DynTensor, got `{}`", v_ty.render())),
        };

        if qt.rank() != 4 || kdt.rank() != 4 || vdt.rank() != 4 {
            return err(span, "attn_gqa: q/k/v must be rank-4 [B,H,*,D]");
        }
        if qt.elem != ScalarKind::F32 {
            return err(span, "attn_gqa: f32 only");
        }
        let b   = qt.shape[0];
        let h_q = qt.shape[1];
        let s   = qt.shape[2];
        let d   = qt.shape[3];
        // KV static dims: [B,H_kv,?,D]; axis 2 (history len) is the runtime axis.
        let h_kv = match kdt.dims[1] { Some(h) => h, None => return err(span,
            "attn_gqa: k cache head dim (axis 1) must be static") };
        if kdt.dims[0] != Some(b) || kdt.dims[3] != Some(d) {
            return err(span, "attn_gqa: k cache must be [B, H_kv, len, D]");
        }
        if kdt.dims[2].is_some() {
            return err(span, "attn_gqa: k cache streaming axis (2) must be runtime");
        }
        if vdt.dims[0] != Some(b) || vdt.dims[1] != Some(h_kv) || vdt.dims[3] != Some(d) {
            return err(span, "attn_gqa: v cache must match k [B, H_kv, len, D]");
        }
        if vdt.dims[2].is_some() {
            return err(span, "attn_gqa: v cache streaming axis (2) must be runtime");
        }
        if h_q % h_kv != 0 {
            return err(span, format!(
                "attn_gqa: H_q ({}) must be divisible by H_kv ({})", h_q, h_kv));
        }
        let g = h_q / h_kv; // GQA group size

        let scale = 1.0_f32 / (d as f32).sqrt();
        let scale_v = self.builder.ins().f32const(scale);

        // len: runtime history length (k and v share it). Validate they agree?
        // They are appended together in lockstep; trust k's extent.
        let len = self.dyn_extent(k_ptr, &kdt, 2);
        let k_data = self.dyn_data_ptr(k_ptr, &kdt);
        let v_data = self.dyn_data_ptr(v_ptr, &vdt);

        // Output [B,H_q,S,D] dense f32.
        let out_ty = TensorTy { elem: ScalarKind::F32, shape: vec![b, h_q, s, d] };
        let out_ptr = self.forge_alloc(out_ty.nbytes());

        // Scratch score buffer [S, len] (runtime), reused per (batch, head):
        // fully overwritten each time before softmax + the value matmul.
        let four = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, 4);
        let s_v  = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, s);
        let scores_nelems = self.builder.ins().imul(s_v, len);
        let scores_bytes = self.builder.ins().imul(scores_nelems, four);
        let scores = self.forge_alloc_v(scores_bytes);

        let zero = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, 0);
        let one  = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, 1);
        let zerof = self.builder.ins().f32const(0.0_f32);
        let b_v  = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, b);
        let hq_v = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, h_q);
        let d_v  = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, d);
        let g_v  = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, g);

        // for bi in 0..B
        let bi_l = self.loop_begin(b_v);
        let bi = bi_l.iv;
        // for hqi in 0..H_q
        let hqi_l = self.loop_begin(hq_v);
        let hqi = hqi_l.iv;
        let hkvi = self.builder.ins().udiv(hqi, g_v);

        // ── Phase 1: scores[i,j] = scale * Σ_d q[bi,hqi,i,d] * k[bi,hkvi,j,d] ──
        let si_l = self.loop_begin(s_v);
        let si = si_l.iv;
        let sj_l = self.loop_begin(len);
        let sj = sj_l.iv;
        // d-contraction loop carrying an f32 accumulator.
        let d_hdr  = self.builder.create_block();
        let d_body = self.builder.create_block();
        let d_exit = self.builder.create_block();
        self.builder.append_block_param(d_hdr, cl::I64);
        self.builder.append_block_param(d_hdr, cl::F32);
        self.builder.append_block_param(d_exit, cl::F32);
        self.jump(d_hdr, &[zero, zerof]);
        self.enter(d_hdr);
        let dd = self.builder.block_params(d_hdr)[0];
        let dacc = self.builder.block_params(d_hdr)[1];
        let cd = self.builder.ins().icmp(IntCC::SignedLessThan, dd, d_v);
        self.builder.ins().brif(cd, d_body, &[], d_exit, &[dacc.into()]);
        self.block_filled = true;
        self.enter(d_body);
        let q_off = self.tensor_byte_offset(&qt, &[bi, hqi, si, dd]);
        let qv = self.tensor_load_elem(q_ptr, q_off, ScalarKind::F32);
        let k_off = self.dyn_byte_offset(k_ptr, &kdt, &[bi, hkvi, sj, dd]);
        let kv = self.tensor_load_elem(k_data, k_off, ScalarKind::F32);
        let prod = self.builder.ins().fmul(qv, kv);
        let dacc2 = self.builder.ins().fadd(dacc, prod);
        let dn = self.builder.ins().iadd(dd, one);
        self.jump(d_hdr, &[dn, dacc2]);
        self.builder.seal_block(d_body);
        self.builder.seal_block(d_hdr);
        self.enter(d_exit);
        let dot = self.builder.block_params(d_exit)[0];
        let scaled = self.builder.ins().fmul(dot, scale_v);
        // Apply the optional causal mask: scaled = mask[si,sj] ? scaled : -inf.
        // mask is contiguous [S, S] bool (i8), element [si,sj] at (si*S_cols+sj).
        let scaled = if let Some((m_ptr, m_ty)) = &mask {
            let s_cols = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, m_ty.shape[1]);
            let m_elem = self.builder.ins().imul(si, s_cols);
            let m_elem = self.builder.ins().iadd(m_elem, sj);
            // bool is 1 byte (I8): offset == element index.
            let mv = self.tensor_load_elem(*m_ptr, m_elem, ScalarKind::Bool);
            let mzero = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I8, 0);
            let allowed = self.builder.ins().icmp(IntCC::NotEqual, mv, mzero);
            let neg_inf = self.builder.ins().f32const(-1.0e9_f32);
            self.builder.ins().select(allowed, scaled, neg_inf)
        } else {
            scaled
        };
        // scores[si*len + sj]
        let s_elem = self.builder.ins().imul(si, len);
        let s_elem = self.builder.ins().iadd(s_elem, sj);
        let s_off = self.builder.ins().imul(s_elem, four);
        self.tensor_store_elem(scores, s_off, scaled);
        self.builder.seal_block(d_exit);
        self.loop_end(sj_l);
        self.loop_end(si_l);

        // ── Phase 2: softmax each of the S rows over the runtime length `len`. ──
        self.softmax_rows_v(scores, s_v, len);

        // ── Phase 3: out[bi,hqi,i,di] = Σ_j scores[i,j] * v[bi,hkvi,j,di] ──
        let oi_l = self.loop_begin(s_v);
        let oi = oi_l.iv;
        let od_l = self.loop_begin(d_v);
        let odi = od_l.iv;
        // j-contraction loop carrying an f32 accumulator.
        let j_hdr  = self.builder.create_block();
        let j_body = self.builder.create_block();
        let j_exit = self.builder.create_block();
        self.builder.append_block_param(j_hdr, cl::I64);
        self.builder.append_block_param(j_hdr, cl::F32);
        self.builder.append_block_param(j_exit, cl::F32);
        self.jump(j_hdr, &[zero, zerof]);
        self.enter(j_hdr);
        let jj = self.builder.block_params(j_hdr)[0];
        let jacc = self.builder.block_params(j_hdr)[1];
        let cj = self.builder.ins().icmp(IntCC::SignedLessThan, jj, len);
        self.builder.ins().brif(cj, j_body, &[], j_exit, &[jacc.into()]);
        self.block_filled = true;
        self.enter(j_body);
        let p_elem = self.builder.ins().imul(oi, len);
        let p_elem = self.builder.ins().iadd(p_elem, jj);
        let p_off = self.builder.ins().imul(p_elem, four);
        let pv = self.tensor_load_elem(scores, p_off, ScalarKind::F32);
        let v_off = self.dyn_byte_offset(v_ptr, &vdt, &[bi, hkvi, jj, odi]);
        let vv = self.tensor_load_elem(v_data, v_off, ScalarKind::F32);
        let prodv = self.builder.ins().fmul(pv, vv);
        let jacc2 = self.builder.ins().fadd(jacc, prodv);
        let jn = self.builder.ins().iadd(jj, one);
        self.jump(j_hdr, &[jn, jacc2]);
        self.builder.seal_block(j_body);
        self.builder.seal_block(j_hdr);
        self.enter(j_exit);
        let oval = self.builder.block_params(j_exit)[0];
        let o_off = self.tensor_byte_offset(&out_ty, &[bi, hqi, oi, odi]);
        self.tensor_store_elem(out_ptr, o_off, oval);
        self.builder.seal_block(j_exit);
        self.loop_end(od_l);
        self.loop_end(oi_l);

        self.loop_end(hqi_l);
        self.loop_end(bi_l);

        Ok((out_ptr, TyKind::Tensor(out_ty)))
    }

    fn lower_builtin_print_tensor(
        &mut self,
        args: &[CallArg],
        span: &Span,
    ) -> Result<(Value, TyKind), JitError> {
        if args.len() != 1 {
            return err(span, "`print_tensor` takes exactly 1 argument");
        }
        let e = match &args[0] {
            CallArg::Positional(e) => e,
            _ => return unsupported(span, "non-positional arg to `print_tensor`"),
        };
        let (ptr, ty) = self.lower_expr(e)?;
        let t = ty.as_tensor().ok_or_else(|| JitError {
            msg: "`print_tensor` requires a tensor argument".into(),
            line: span.line, col: span.col,
        })?.clone();
        if t.elem != ScalarKind::F32 {
            return err(span, "`print_tensor` is f32-only in slice 2");
        }
        let (sym, dim_args) = match t.rank() {
            1 => ("__dmc_print_tensor_1d_f32",
                  vec![self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, t.shape[0])]),
            2 => ("__dmc_print_tensor_2d_f32",
                  vec![self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, t.shape[0]),
                       self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, t.shape[1])]),
            _ => unreachable!(),
        };
        let entry = self.fns.get(sym).expect("print_tensor sym not registered").clone();
        let func_ref = self.module.declare_func_in_func(entry.id, self.builder.func);
        let mut call_args = vec![ptr];
        call_args.extend(dim_args);
        self.builder.ins().call(func_ref, &call_args);
        let z = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I8, 0);
        Ok((z, TyKind::Scalar(ScalarKind::Nil)))
    }

    fn lower_unop(
        &mut self,
        op: &UnOp,
        operand: &Expr,
        span: &Span,
    ) -> Result<(Value, TyKind), JitError> {
        let (v, k) = self.lower_expr(operand)?;
        let sk = match &k {
            TyKind::Scalar(s) => *s,
            TyKind::Tensor(tt) => {
                // `\>T` (ReLU = max(T, 0)) is the one unary op defined on a
                // tensor; everything else stays elementwise/scalar.
                return match op {
                    UnOp::ReLU  => self.lower_tensor_relu(v, tt, span),
                    UnOp::GeLU  => self.lower_tensor_gelu(v, tt, span),
                    _ => unsupported(span,
                        "only `\\>` (ReLU) and `\\<` (GeLU) are defined on tensors; \
                         use elementwise ops otherwise"),
                };
            }
            TyKind::KV(_) => {
                return unsupported(span, "unary operators are not supported on KV caches");
            }
            TyKind::DynTensor(_) => {
                return unsupported(span, "unary operators on dynamic-shape tensors are not yet lowered");
            }
            TyKind::Model(_, _) => {
                return unsupported(span, "unary operators are not supported on model instances");
            }
            TyKind::Str => {
                return unsupported(span, "unary operators are not defined on str");
            }
            TyKind::Map => {
                return unsupported(span, "unary operators are not supported on map values");
            }
            TyKind::KvArray(_, _) => {
                return unsupported(span, "unary operators are not supported on KV-cache arrays");
            }
            TyKind::ModelArray(_, _, _) => {
                return unsupported(span, "unary operators are not supported on model arrays");
            }
            TyKind::Fn(_, _) => {
                return unsupported(span, "unary operators are not supported on function pointers");
            }
            TyKind::TritTensor(_) => {
                return unsupported(span, "unary operators are not supported on trit tensors");
            }
            TyKind::Bf16Tensor(_) => {
                return unsupported(span, "unary operators are not supported on bf16 tensors; upconvert to f32 first");
            }
            TyKind::Enum(_) => {
                return unsupported(span, "unary operators are not defined on enums; cast to `i64` first");
            }
        };
        match op {
            UnOp::Neg => {
                if sk.is_int()       { Ok((self.builder.ins().ineg(v), TyKind::Scalar(sk))) }
                else if sk.is_float(){ Ok((self.builder.ins().fneg(v), TyKind::Scalar(sk))) }
                else { err(span, "unary `-` requires a numeric operand") }
            }
            UnOp::Not => {
                if sk.is_bool() {
                    let one = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I8, 1);
                    Ok((self.builder.ins().bxor(v, one), TyKind::Scalar(ScalarKind::Bool)))
                } else {
                    err(span, "unary `!` requires `bool`")
                }
            }
            UnOp::BitNot => {
                if sk.is_int() { Ok((self.builder.ins().bnot(v), TyKind::Scalar(sk))) }
                else { err(span, "unary `~` requires an int") }
            }
            UnOp::Deref => unsupported(span, "pointer deref (no raw pointers in slice 2)"),
            UnOp::ReLU => {
                // max(x, 0) on a scalar f32.
                if !sk.is_float() {
                    return err(span, "`\\>` (ReLU) requires a float operand");
                }
                let v = self.coerce_scalar(v, sk, ScalarKind::F32, span)?;
                let z = self.builder.ins().f32const(0.0);
                let c = self.builder.ins().fcmp(FloatCC::GreaterThan, v, z);
                Ok((self.builder.ins().select(c, v, z), TyKind::Scalar(ScalarKind::F32)))
            }
            UnOp::GeLU => {
                if !sk.is_float() {
                    return err(span, "`\\<` (GeLU) requires a float operand");
                }
                let v = self.coerce_scalar(v, sk, ScalarKind::F32, span)?;
                let gv = self.emit_gelu_f32(v);
                Ok((gv, TyKind::Scalar(ScalarKind::F32)))
            }
        }
    }

    /// `\>T` — elementwise ReLU `max(T, 0)` over an f32 tensor.
    /// When the element count is a multiple of 4, uses the F32X4 `fmax`
    /// vector instruction (4 lanes per iteration). Falls back to scalar
    /// `select(x > 0, x, 0)` otherwise.
    fn lower_tensor_relu(
        &mut self,
        t_val: Value, t_ty: &TensorTy,
        span: &Span,
    ) -> Result<(Value, TyKind), JitError> {
        if t_ty.elem != ScalarKind::F32 {
            return err(span, "`\\>` (ReLU) on tensors is f32-only");
        }
        let out_ty = t_ty.clone();
        let out_ptr = self.forge_alloc(out_ty.nbytes());
        let n = out_ty.nelems();

        // SIMD path: F32X4 load/store with per-lane NaN-safe ReLU.
        // fmax(NaN, 0) propagates NaN; extractlane + select(x > 0, x, 0) zeroes it.
        if n % 4 == 0 && n >= 4 {
            let flags = cranelift::codegen::ir::MemFlagsData::new();
            let zc = self.builder.func.dfg.constants.insert(vec![0u8; 16].into());
            let zero_vec = self.builder.ins().vconst(cl::F32X4, zc);
            let fzero = self.builder.ins().f32const(0.0);

            let step = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, 16); // 4 * 4 bytes
            let byte_count = n.checked_mul(4).expect("relu: byte count overflows i64");
            let cap_b = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, byte_count);
            let byte_zero = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, 0);

            let hdr = self.builder.create_block();
            let body = self.builder.create_block();
            let exit = self.builder.create_block();
            self.builder.append_block_param(hdr, cl::I64);

            self.jump(hdr, &[byte_zero]);
            self.enter(hdr);
            let off = self.builder.block_params(hdr)[0];
            let cont = self.builder.ins().icmp(IntCC::SignedLessThan, off, cap_b);
            self.brif(cont, body, exit);

            self.enter(body);
            let src = self.builder.ins().iadd(t_val, off);
            let dst = self.builder.ins().iadd(out_ptr, off);
            let v = self.builder.ins().load(cl::F32X4, flags, src, 0);
            let mut rv = zero_vec;
            for lane in 0u8..4 {
                let lv = self.builder.ins().extractlane(v, lane);
                let c  = self.builder.ins().fcmp(FloatCC::GreaterThan, lv, fzero);
                let lo = self.builder.ins().select(c, lv, fzero);
                rv     = self.builder.ins().insertlane(rv, lo, lane);
            }
            self.builder.ins().store(flags, rv, dst, 0);
            let noff = self.builder.ins().iadd(off, step);
            self.jump(hdr, &[noff]);

            self.builder.seal_block(body);
            self.builder.seal_block(hdr);
            self.enter(exit);
            self.builder.seal_block(exit);

            return Ok((out_ptr, TyKind::Tensor(out_ty)));
        }

        // Scalar fallback: select(x > 0, x, 0) per element.
        let zero = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, 0);
        let one = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, 1);
        let cap = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, n);
        let eb = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, 4);
        let fzero = self.builder.ins().f32const(0.0);

        let hdr = self.builder.create_block();
        let body = self.builder.create_block();
        let exit = self.builder.create_block();
        self.builder.append_block_param(hdr, cl::I64);

        self.jump(hdr, &[zero]);
        self.enter(hdr);
        let i = self.builder.block_params(hdr)[0];
        let cont = self.builder.ins().icmp(IntCC::SignedLessThan, i, cap);
        self.brif(cont, body, exit);

        self.enter(body);
        let off = self.builder.ins().imul(i, eb);
        let tv = self.tensor_load_elem(t_val, off, t_ty.elem);
        let c = self.builder.ins().fcmp(FloatCC::GreaterThan, tv, fzero);
        let ov = self.builder.ins().select(c, tv, fzero);
        self.tensor_store_elem(out_ptr, off, ov);
        let inext = self.builder.ins().iadd(i, one);
        self.jump(hdr, &[inext]);

        self.builder.seal_block(body);
        self.builder.seal_block(hdr);
        self.enter(exit);
        self.builder.seal_block(exit);

        Ok((out_ptr, TyKind::Tensor(out_ty)))
    }

    /// Emit the GeLU approximation for a single f32 value `x`:
    ///   0.5 * x * (1 + tanh(sqrt(2/π) * (x + 0.044715 * x³)))
    fn emit_gelu_f32(&mut self, x: Value) -> Value {
        // sqrt(2/π) constant
        let c = (2.0f64 / std::f64::consts::PI).sqrt() as f32;
        let c_v      = self.builder.ins().f32const(c);
        let k_v      = self.builder.ins().f32const(0.044715_f32);
        let half     = self.builder.ins().f32const(0.5_f32);
        let one      = self.builder.ins().f32const(1.0_f32);

        let x2       = self.builder.ins().fmul(x, x);
        let x3       = self.builder.ins().fmul(x2, x);
        let kx3      = self.builder.ins().fmul(k_v, x3);
        let inner    = self.builder.ins().fadd(x, kx3);
        let scaled   = self.builder.ins().fmul(c_v, inner);
        let tanh_val = self.call_f32_math("__dmc_tanh_f32", scaled);
        let one_plus = self.builder.ins().fadd(one, tanh_val);
        let half_x   = self.builder.ins().fmul(half, x);
        self.builder.ins().fmul(half_x, one_plus)
    }

    /// Call a registered f32→f32 math function (e.g. `__dmc_tanh_f32`).
    fn call_f32_math(&mut self, sym: &str, arg: Value) -> Value {
        let entry = self.fns.get(sym).expect("f32 math sym registered").clone();
        let func_ref = self.module.declare_func_in_func(entry.id, self.builder.func);
        let call = self.builder.ins().call(func_ref, &[arg]);
        self.builder.inst_results(call)[0]
    }

    /// `\<T` — elementwise GeLU over an f32 tensor (scalar loop).
    fn lower_tensor_gelu(
        &mut self,
        t_val: Value, t_ty: &TensorTy,
        span: &Span,
    ) -> Result<(Value, TyKind), JitError> {
        let _ = span;
        if t_ty.elem != ScalarKind::F32 {
            return err(span, "`\\<` (GeLU) on tensors is f32-only");
        }
        let out_ty  = t_ty.clone();
        let out_ptr = self.forge_alloc(out_ty.nbytes());
        let n = out_ty.nelems();

        let zero = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, 0);
        let one  = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, 1);
        let cap  = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, n);
        let eb   = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, 4);

        let hdr  = self.builder.create_block();
        let body = self.builder.create_block();
        let exit = self.builder.create_block();
        self.builder.append_block_param(hdr, cl::I64);

        self.jump(hdr, &[zero]);
        self.enter(hdr);
        let i    = self.builder.block_params(hdr)[0];
        let cont = self.builder.ins().icmp(IntCC::SignedLessThan, i, cap);
        self.brif(cont, body, exit);

        self.enter(body);
        let off  = self.builder.ins().imul(i, eb);
        let x    = self.tensor_load_elem(t_val, off, t_ty.elem);
        let gx   = self.emit_gelu_f32(x);
        self.tensor_store_elem(out_ptr, off, gx);
        let inext = self.builder.ins().iadd(i, one);
        self.jump(hdr, &[inext]);

        self.builder.seal_block(body);
        self.builder.seal_block(hdr);
        self.enter(exit);
        self.builder.seal_block(exit);

        Ok((out_ptr, TyKind::Tensor(out_ty)))
    }

    /// Elementwise activation via a registered f32->f32 runtime symbol.
    fn lower_tensor_activation(
        &mut self,
        t_val: Value,
        t_ty: &TensorTy,
        sym: &str,
        span: &Span,
    ) -> Result<(Value, TyKind), JitError> {
        if t_ty.elem != ScalarKind::F32 {
            return err(span, format!("`{}` on tensors is f32-only", sym));
        }
        let out_ty = t_ty.clone();
        let out_ptr = self.forge_alloc(out_ty.nbytes());
        let n = out_ty.nelems();
        let entry = self.fns.get(sym)
            .ok_or_else(|| JitError {
                msg: format!("activation symbol `{}` not registered", sym),
                line: span.line, col: span.col,
            })?.clone();
        let zero = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, 0);
        let one  = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, 1);
        let cap  = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, n);
        let eb   = self.builder.ins().iconst(cl::I64, 4);
        let hdr  = self.builder.create_block();
        let body = self.builder.create_block();
        let exit = self.builder.create_block();
        self.builder.append_block_param(hdr, cl::I64);
        self.jump(hdr, &[zero]);
        self.enter(hdr);
        let i = self.builder.block_params(hdr)[0];
        let cont = self.builder.ins().icmp(IntCC::SignedLessThan, i, cap);
        self.brif(cont, body, exit);
        self.enter(body);
        let off = self.builder.ins().imul(i, eb);
        let xv = self.tensor_load_elem(t_val, off, ScalarKind::F32);
        let func_ref = self.module.declare_func_in_func(entry.id, self.builder.func);
        let call = self.builder.ins().call(func_ref, &[xv]);
        let ov = self.builder.inst_results(call)[0];
        self.tensor_store_elem(out_ptr, off, ov);
        let inext = self.builder.ins().iadd(i, one);
        self.jump(hdr, &[inext]);
        self.builder.seal_block(body);
        self.builder.seal_block(hdr);
        self.enter(exit);
        self.builder.seal_block(exit);
        Ok((out_ptr, TyKind::Tensor(out_ty)))
    }

    fn lower_builtin_activation(
        &mut self,
        name: &str,
        args: &[CallArg],
        span: &Span,
    ) -> Result<(Value, TyKind), JitError> {
        if args.len() != 1 {
            return err(span, format!("`{}` takes exactly 1 argument", name));
        }
        let e = match &args[0] {
            CallArg::Positional(e) => e,
            _ => return unsupported(span, "non-positional arg to activation"),
        };
        let (v, k) = self.lower_expr(e)?;
        match k.clone() {
            TyKind::Tensor(tt) => {
                if tt.elem != ScalarKind::F32 {
